scripts.text:
[????]
Are you {0}?
I've been waiting for you.
^6B8E23Priest Bamph^000000 is expecting
your arrival at ^6B8E23Prontera
Church^000000. Please visit him
as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[????]
你是{0}吗？
我一直在等你。
^6B8E23牧师巴姆夫^000000正在
^6B8E23普隆德拉教堂^000000等你。
请尽快去见他。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Damn it, I lost again!
This game is rigged!
No matter what I try,
I can never seem to win!
But Comodo Hold 'Em
is so... It's so addicting!
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
该死，我又输了！
这游戏肯定有诈！
不管我怎么试，
就是赢不了！
但是科摩多德州扑克
真是...太让人上瘾了！

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Argh, I lost at this game
so many times that I've
completely lost track!
I've got to win sometime...
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
唉，我在这游戏里
输得太多次了，
完全记不清了！
总有一天我会赢的...

scripts.text: Excuse me.
scripts.translation: 打扰一下

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Oh! Uh... Hmm...
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
哦！呃...嗯...
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: ^6B8E23Priest Bamph^000000 sent me.
scripts.translation: ^6B8E23牧师巴姆夫^000000派我来的。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Oh, I see. I apologize
if my screaming and yelling
made you a bit uncomfortable.
I'm just here to kill some
time... I now see firsthand
that gambling is truly evil!
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
哦，原来如此。抱歉，
我的大喊大叫
可能让你感到不适了。
我只是在这里消磨时间...
我现在亲眼见识到
赌博真是万恶之源！

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Er, would you come
over this way? I don't
want anyone else to
overhear us talking.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
呃，你能过来这边吗？
我不想让别人
听到我们的谈话。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
What?! I lost again?
How does... How does
this game even work?!
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
什么？！我又输了？
这...这游戏到底
是怎么玩的？！

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
This isn't good at all.
I don't know what to do...

[Larjes]
Good, no one should be
able to hear us from here.
After I sent a message to
the place, I found some
new information that should
really help my investigation.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
很好，这里应该
没人能听到我们说话。
在我给那边发了消息后，
我发现了一些
对新调查很有帮助的信息。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
I learned that two details
about the night when that
high ranking man vanished.
Firstly, he left the guards for
a bit to meet a woman. It's
always a woman, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
我了解到关于那位
高官失踪那晚的两个细节。
首先，他暂时离开了卫兵，
去见一个女人。
总是女人，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Secondly, after he left to
meet that woman, some other
people came in, and then they
carried some really large
baggage with them when
they left to the west.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
其次，在他离开去见那个女人后，
其他人进来了，
然后他们带着一些
非常大的行李
往西边离开了。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Those bags were so big,
it's suspicious. It seems
like some organization has
kidnapped him, and wants to
bring him west for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
那些袋子太大了，
很可疑。看起来像是
某个组织绑架了他，
并想把他带到西边去。

scripts.text: Why to the west?
scripts.translation: 为什么是西边？

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
This is just a guess, but
I think whoever kidnapped
him are from ^2F4F2FArunafeltz^000000.
I'm prohibited from entering
Arunafeltz so I wasn't able
to investigate any further.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
这只是我的猜测，
但我认为绑架他的人
来自^2F4F2F阿鲁纳菲兹^000000。
我被禁止进入阿鲁纳菲兹，
所以无法进一步调查。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
I gambled away
this much money?
How am I gonna pay
off all of this debt?!
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
我赌掉了
这么多钱？
我该怎么还清
这些债务？！

scripts.text:
[Waiter]
Welcome to
Rachel's Palate, one
of Rachel's finest and
most exquisite restraunts.
scripts.translation:
[服务员]
欢迎光临
拉赫的味觉，
拉赫最精致、
最优雅的餐厅之一。

scripts.text:
[Waiter]
Welcome to
Rachel's Palate, one
of Rachel's finest and
most exquisite restraunts.
[Waiter]
The food in this
restaurant is the
best in Rachel--no,
it is the best in all
of Arunafeltz!
scripts.translation:
[服务员]
欢迎光临
拉赫的味觉，
拉赫最精致、
最优雅的餐厅之一。
[服务员]
这家餐厅的食物
是拉赫最好的——不，
它是整个阿鲁纳菲兹
最好的！

scripts.text:
[Waiter]
What would you like
to order? Or... If I'm
not mistaken, you're
here for something else?
scripts.translation:
[服务员]
您想点什么？或者...
如果我没看错的话，
您是来办别的事的？

scripts.text: I'd like to order.
scripts.translation: 我想点餐。

scripts.text: Yes, I've come for another reason.
scripts.translation: 是的，我有别的事。

scripts.text:
[Waiter]
Sure, no problem.
Did you come alone?
scripts.translation:
[服务员]
没问题。
您是独自来的吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Waiter]
Right this way.
scripts.translation:
[服务员]
请这边走。

scripts.text:
[Waiter]
Hm, okay. Well, whatever
it is, I hope you enjoy your
stay at Rachel's Palate.
scripts.translation:
[服务员]
嗯，好的。无论您是为了什么而来，
希望您能在拉赫的味觉度过愉快的时光。

scripts.text:
[Waiter]
The food in this
restaurant is the
best in Rachel--no,
it is the best in all
of Arunafeltz!
scripts.translation:
[服务员]
这家餐厅的食物
是拉赫最好的——不，
它是整个阿鲁纳菲兹
最好的！

scripts.text:
[Normal-Looking Man]
Mmm-Mmm!
I love the food in
this restaurant!
They don't serve
anything this this
good anywhere else!
scripts.translation:
[外表普通的男子]
嗯...嗯！
我太喜欢这家餐厅的食物了！
别的地方可吃不到
这么好吃的东西！

scripts.text:
[Common-Looking Man]
The food here isn't bad,
but my favorite restaurants
are over in Hugel. The food
over there is definitely best.
scripts.translation:
[相貌平常的男子]
这里的食物还不错，
但我更喜欢的餐厅在毁葛。
那里的食物绝对是最好的。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious-Looking Man]
Each dish has its own
unique taste that you must
learn to relish. Of course,
unhealthy junk food is the
exception to this rule.
scripts.translation:
[形迹可疑的男子]
每道菜都有独特的风味，
你需要学会去品味它。当然，
不健康的垃圾食品是例外。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务
将部分物品存入仓库，
然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Waiter]
What would you like to order?
Our special today is Fried
Veins Stripe Stickleback
since we received some
high quality fish from Veins
just this morning.
scripts.translation:
[服务员]
您想点什么？
今天的特色菜是炸伯仁斯条纹刺鱼，
因为今天早上我们刚收到
一批来自伯仁斯的高品质鱼。

scripts.text: ...Yes, that sounds good.
scripts.translation: ...是的，听起来不错。

scripts.text:
[Waiter]
Excellent choice.
Just to let you know,
that dish is ^9932CD3,000 zeny^000000.
I'll be right back.
scripts.translation:
[服务员]
很好的选择。
提醒您一下，
那道菜是^9932CD3,000 Zeny^000000。
我马上回来。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe waiter took your
order, and left to go to
the kitchen. You decide to
eavesdrop on the people
talking at the next table
while you're waiting.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF服务员记下您的订单，
去厨房了。在等待的间隙，
您决定偷听邻桌的人
在聊什么。^000000

scripts.text:
[Husky Male Voice]
...............................
I really saw it, the greatest
fish in the world! Last time
I went to Veins, I glimpsed
the Veins Golden Stripe
Stickleback! It's true!
scripts.translation:
[沙哑的男声]
...............................
我真的看到了，
世界上最棒的鱼！
上次我去伯仁斯时，
瞥见了伯仁斯金纹刺鱼！
是真的！

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Male Voice]
So were you able to taste
that Veins Golden Stripe
Stickleback juice?
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的男声]
那你尝到
伯仁斯金纹刺鱼汁了吗？

scripts.text:
[Average Male Voice]
Aw man, if I did, that
would've been a once
in a lifetime experience!
Veins Golden Stripe
Sticklebacks are only
caught once a decade!
scripts.translation:
[普通的男声]
天哪，如果尝到了，
那绝对是一生一次的体验！
伯仁斯金纹刺鱼
十年才捕获一次！

scripts.text:
[Husky Male Voice]
Oh yeah, that juice is
incredible. My voice even
changed after I drank it!
It was just... So profound.
scripts.translation:
[沙哑的男声]
哦对，那种汁液
不可思议。我喝了之后
连声音都变了！
那感觉...太深邃了。

scripts.text:
[Average Male Voice]
Oh! So that's why
you sound different.
scripts.translation:
[普通的男声]
哦！原来你声音
不一样是因为这个。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Male Voice]
How did you get to drink
such rare juice? I mean,
there must be tons of people
in line with reservations,
just waiting to drink it!
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的男声]
你是怎么喝到
这么稀有的汁液的？
我是说，肯定有
很多人预约排队等着喝吧！

scripts.text:
[Husky Male Voice]
I got damn lucky: I went
to this tavern in Veins, and
overheard that ^DB7093a group of
smugglers were arrested
by the guards at the
southeast beach^000000.
scripts.translation:
[沙哑的男声]
我运气好得离谱：
我去了伯仁斯的一家酒馆，
无意中听到^DB7093一群走私犯
在东南海滩被卫兵逮捕了^000000。

scripts.text:
[Husky Male Voice]
Then I started thinking:
maybe the smugglers were
fishing. So I checked the
beach to see if I could
find their fishing boat.
scripts.translation:
[沙哑的男声]
然后我就想：
也许那些走私犯是在捕鱼。
于是我去海滩看了看，
看能不能找到他们的渔船。

scripts.text:
[Average Male Voice]
Man, you must be obsessed
with food. I mean, how else
would you figure out that the
smugglers were illegally
fishing so quickly?
scripts.translation:
[普通的男声]
天哪，你肯定是个
吃货。不然你怎么能
这么快就猜到那些走私犯
是在非法捕鱼？

scripts.text:
[Husky Male Voice]
Ha, I guess you're right!
Anyway, there was only one
fishing boat, and the guards
were inspecting it. I was about
to turn back in disappointment
but then... I saw a fisherman!
scripts.translation:
[沙哑的男声]
哈哈，你说得对！
总之，那里只有一艘渔船，
卫兵正在检查它。我本来
都准备失望地转身离开了，
结果...我看到了一个渔夫！

scripts.text:
[Husky Male Voice]
Out of the corner of my eye,
I saw him bringing in his
catch for the day, Veins
Golden Strip Stickleback!
I bought all of his fish
right then and there.
scripts.translation:
[沙哑的男声]
我余光瞥见他正把当天的
渔获收上来，是伯仁斯金带刺鱼！
我当场就把他的鱼全买下来了。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Male Voice]
Boy, were you lucky.
And you never hesitate
to splurge when it comes
to food, do you? Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[阴郁的男声]
哇，你运气真好。
而且你在吃的方面
从来都不吝啬花钱，对吧？
嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Husky Male Voice]
Oh, that wasn't even a
splurge. I'm sure you guys
would do the same thing
if you were in my situation.
I'm just grateful that I was
able to taste such rare fish.
scripts.translation:
[沙哑的男声]
哦，那根本不算挥霍。
我相信如果换成你们，
遇到这种情况也会这么做的。
我只是很庆幸能尝到
这么稀有的鱼。

scripts.text:
^3355FF...............................
Then, the men started
to compliment each other.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF......
然后，男人们开始
互相吹捧起来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Waiter]
Ah, here's your Fried
Veins Stripe Stickleback.
Please enjoy your meal.
scripts.translation:
[服务员]
啊，您的炸伯仁斯条纹刺鱼
来了。请慢用。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^ff0000Veins^000000, huh? I might want
to check that place one
of these days to see if
I can find more of this fish.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^ff0000伯仁斯^000000，是吗？
也许哪天我想去那里看看，
找找看能不能找到
更多的这种鱼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa, this fish tastes...
I've never tasted anything
like it! It's almost like
a dessert. God, it's good!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇，这鱼的味道...
我从来没吃过这么好吃的！
简直就像甜点一样。
天哪，太美味了！

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
Argh! Why must this
happen to me, especially
just when I'm about to
retire! A-ah! My ulcer...
Just all of a sudden, it--!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔·哈马德]
啊！为什么偏偏
发生在我身上，尤其是
在我即将退休的时候！
啊！我的溃疡...
突然之间，它--！

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
Man, this is probably
the biggest hassle of my
career. Why does this have
to happen now? Retirement
is so close, yet so far.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔·哈马德]
天哪，这大概是我
职业生涯中最大的麻烦。
为什么偏偏在这个时候发生？
退休近在咫尺，却又遥不可及。

scripts.text: Are you in trouble?
scripts.translation: 你遇到麻烦了？

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
Huh? You don't look like
you're from around here.
Listen, I appreciate your
concern, but I'm really not
comfortable talking to complete
strangers about my problems.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔·哈马德]
嗯？你看起来
不像本地人。
听着，我很感激你的关心，
但我真的不习惯
跟陌生人谈论我的问题。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
Unless you've got special
business here, you're not
allowed to enter this place.
We're here to keep the public
peace, and letting anyone
in here will cause trouble.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔·哈马德]
除非你有特别的公务，
否则不允许进入这里。
我们负责维护公共秩序，
让任何人进来都会造成麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
I thought I told you
that you weren't allowed
to come in here. Why do
you keep coming back?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔·哈马德]
我刚才不是说了
你不允许进来吗？
你为什么一直回来？

scripts.text: I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 对不起。

scripts.text: I want to know about the smugglers.
scripts.translation: 我想知道关于走私犯的事。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
It's fine. Just leave,
and don't come back
unless you've got a
really good reason.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔·哈马德]
没关系。快离开，
除非你有非常充分的理由，
否则不要再回来了。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
Hey, how'd you find out
about the smugglers? Did
word spread around town?
Well, I'm sorry, but I can't
disclose any details about
an ongoing investigation.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔·哈马德]
嘿，你是怎么知道
走私犯的事的？消息
在城里传开了吗？
抱歉，但我不能透露
正在进行的调查细节。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
^9370DBIf you insist on learning
more, then you'd need to
bring me a written order
from a higher ranking officer.^000000
Oh, and you're prohibited
asking anyone else, so behave.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔·哈马德]
^9370DB如果你坚持要了解更多，
那你需要给我带来
上级军官的书面命令。^000000
哦，而且禁止你询问其他人，
请守规矩。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
I don't blame you for
being curious, but getting
involved when you're not
supposed to will just cause
trouble. Be careful, got it?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔·哈马德]
我理解你的好奇心，但插手不该管的事只会惹麻烦。小心点，听到了吗？

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
Huh, that's weird. You're not
even a citizen of Arunafeltz,
but somehow you know such
a high ranking priest. Alright,
I guess I can tell you more
about our investigation.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔·哈马德]
嗯，这很奇怪。你甚至不是阿鲁纳菲兹的市民，却认识一位地位如此崇高的牧师。好吧，我想我可以告诉你更多关于我们调查的情况。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
I should let you know that
what I tell you might not be
worth all that trouble. This
information probably isn't
as valuable as you think.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔·哈马德]
我得提醒你，我告诉你的信息可能并不值得你费这么大劲。这些情报可能没有你想象的那么有价值。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
The smugglers we caught are
the worst kind of scoundrels:
they deal in human trafficking, but we caught them this time when they
were crossing the ocean. Their background info is pretty typical.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔·哈马德]
我们抓到的那些走私犯是最恶劣的一群人：他们从事人口贩卖。这次我们是在他们渡海时抓住了他们。他们的背景资料相当典型。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
Let's see... They kidnapped
some man from Comodo.
That's a place in the southwest
part of Rune-Midgarts. Anyway,
the smugglers thought he'd be
wealthy, so they set a trap.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔·哈马德]
让我看看...他们绑架了克魔岛的一个男人。那是卢恩·米德加兹西南部的地方。总之，走私犯以为他很有钱，所以设下了陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
They lured him away from his
guards by sending a woman,
but when they captured him,
they found that he was not only
rich, he was also a high ranked
official of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔·哈马德]
他们派了一名女子将他的卫兵引开，但在抓住他后，他们发现他不仅富有，还是卢恩·米德加兹的高官。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
That's when they got sloppy:
they were so scared that the
kingdom's troops might pursue
them that they crossed the
ocean that we patrol. That's
where we caught them.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔·哈马德]
就在那时他们变得慌乱起来：他们太害怕王国的军队会追捕他们，以至于穿越了我们巡逻的海域。我们就是在那里抓住了他们。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
What I don't understand is
why they were so scared.
I mean, they mainly deal
in human trafficking so...
Kidnapping an official isn't
that big a difference, is it?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔·哈马德]
我不明白的是，他们为什么那么害怕。我是说，他们主要做人口贩卖生意...绑架一个高官，这差别也没那么大吧？

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
We contacted the temple,
and reported the smugglers,
our investigation, and the
high ranking man from the
Rune-Midgarts kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔·哈马德]
我们联系了神殿，报告了走私犯、我们的调查情况，以及那位来自卢恩·米德加兹王国的高官。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
Then, some people from
the temple interrupted our
investigation, took away the
smugglers before we finished
our interrogations, and we
haven't seen them since.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔·哈马德]
然后，神殿的一些人打断了我们的调查，在我们完成审讯之前就把走私犯带走了，从那以后我们就再也没见过他们。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
I asked an acquaintance that
works at the temple, but he
doesn't know what's going
on either. The ^32CD32Rune-Midgarts
official^000000 has gone missing too.
It's all very frustrating.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔·哈马德]
我问了一位在神殿工作的熟人，但他也不知道发生了什么。那位^32CD32卢恩·米德加兹的高官^000000也不见了。这一切让人非常沮丧。

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
That happens to be all
I know. Does this mean
we have to capture the
smugglers again? I don't
know what's going on...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔·哈马德]
我知道的就只有这些了。这难道意味着我们要再次抓捕那些走私犯吗？我不知道发生了什么...

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
Even if I could make headway
into the investigation, I've
been ordered to stop by upper
management. It looks like
this case is more trouble
than it's worth to them?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔·哈马德]
即使我能推进调查，我也被上级命令停止了。看来这个案子对他们来说麻烦大于价值？

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
I don't want to be involved
in this anymore. I should be
retired already! If you want to
learn more, your only choice
would be to find out on your
own. Fat chance, right?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔·哈马德]
我不想再卷入这件事了。我本该已经退休了！如果你想了解更多，你唯一的办法就是自己去查。希望渺茫，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Al Hamad]
I've suffered enough
already! Why can't this
case just be done?!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔·哈马德]
我已经受够了！为什么这个案子就不能结束呢？！

scripts.text:
[Himus]
Huh. The magistrate
still seems pretty upset
over the case that happened
at least a few months ago...
scripts.translation:
[希姆斯]
嗯。法官似乎对几个月前发生的那个案子还是很生气...

scripts.text:
[Himus]
Hm? Oh, the magistrate
gave you the brush-off?
Well, he hasn't really been
himself ever since we arrested
those ^32CD32smugglers coming from
the south^000000 a few months ago.
scripts.translation:
[希姆斯]
嗯？哦，法官把你打发走了？嗯，自从几个月前我们逮捕了那些^32CD32来自南方的走私犯^000000之后，他就一直不太对劲。

scripts.text:
[Himus]
Once we reported the arrest
to the temple, the pope's
soldiers came and took the
smugglers away. We have no
clue what happened to them
or where they even are now.
scripts.translation:
[希姆斯]
一旦我们将逮捕情况报告给神殿，教皇的士兵就来了，把走私犯带走了。我们完全不知道他们后来怎么样了，甚至不知道他们现在在哪里。

scripts.text:
[Himus]
It might not seem like
a big deal to you, but
the magistrate is pretty
meticulous, and he hates
it when people interfere
with his job, you know?
scripts.translation:
[希姆斯]
对你来说这可能不算什么大事，但法官做事非常严谨，他讨厌别人干涉他的工作，你知道吗？

scripts.text: Who are the smugglers?
scripts.translation: 那些走私犯是谁？

scripts.text:
[Himus]
Well, I don't really know.
Maybe the magistrate would
know if he was able to finish
interrogating the smugglers.
I'm not sure if he did since the smugglers were taken away.
scripts.translation:
[希姆斯]
嗯，我也不太清楚。
也许法官能知道，如果他能完成对走私犯的审讯的话。
不过我不确定他是否做到了，毕竟走私犯已经被带走了。

scripts.text:
[Himus]
The magistrate is about
to retire, so I hope he can
finally quit work and just
forget about this whole
business. He does nothing
but stress out about it!
scripts.translation:
[希姆斯]
法官快要退休了，我希望他终于可以卸下工作，忘掉这整件事。他整天为此烦恼不已！

scripts.text:
[Himus]
Nice day, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[希姆斯]
今天天气不错，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Drunkard]
Man, I feel great! Hah hah!
Hey, gimme one more drink!
scripts.translation:
[酒鬼]
嘿，我感觉棒极了！哈哈！
喂，再给我来一杯！

scripts.text:
[Drunkard]
So--*Hic* What I was...
Oog, dizzy... I say sayin',
that guy that ^32CD32snuck out to
sea on a boat^000000? You know
*Hic* why he came back
so early? You won't believe it!
scripts.translation:
[酒鬼]
所...所... *打嗝* 我刚才说...
呕，头晕... 我是说，那个^32CD32偷偷出海的人^000000？你知道*打嗝*他为什么这么早回来吗？你绝对猜不到！

scripts.text:
[Drunkard]
Hah hah! He--*Hic*
He thought he saw a ^DBDB70ghost^000000!
Bwah hah hah! Oooog... Hey...
scripts.translation:
[酒鬼]
哈哈！他... *打嗝*
他以为看到了^DBDB70幽灵^000000！
哇哈哈！呕... 嘿...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's right!
Maybe I should check
on ^32CD32Kurdi's father since
he's a fisherman^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没错！
也许我应该去看看^32CD32库尔迪的父亲^000000，毕竟他是个渔夫。

scripts.text:
[Drunkard]
Zzzz...
Umm... Zzz...
scripts.translation:
[酒鬼]
呼呼呼...
唔... 呼呼...

scripts.text:
[Drunkard]
Why?! Why can't I take
my boat out to sea? I hafta
catch fish to make a living!
What, they expect me to starve
to death or something?! Huh?!
scripts.translation:
[酒鬼]
为什么？！为什么我不能出海？我必须捕鱼才能谋生！
难道他们想让我饿死吗？！哼？！

scripts.text:
[Drunkard]
Hohohoho~
Oh~ Hohohoho~
scripts.translation:
[酒鬼]
呵呵呵~
噢~ 呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She's kind of strange...

^3355FFThis boat seems to 
be in decent condition.
Who could its owner be?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这艘船看起来状况还不错。
它的主人会是谁呢？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis must be the boat that
Karyn was talking about.
It seems to be in pretty
good shape. Now, the
monastery should be
southwest from here...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这一定是卡琳说的那艘船。
看起来保养得相当好。那么，修道院应该在南边...^000000

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Long time no see,
{0}.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
好久不见，
{0}。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Larjes!

[Larjes]
I had a tough time following
you, you know? I actually
almost lost you once. You
must be wondering why
I'm here. If you'll listen,
I'll explain everything.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
跟着你真是费了不少劲，你知道吗？我差点就跟你走散了。你肯定在想我为什么在这里。如果你愿意听，我会把一切都解释清楚。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
According to our investigation, Arunafeltz is definitely involved
in this case. We've been watching you since you're somehow related
to that high ranked official from Arunafeltz. I apologize for that.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
根据我们的调查，阿鲁纳菲兹肯定与此事有关。因为我们发现你与阿鲁纳菲兹的一位高官有某种联系，所以一直在监视你。对此我深表歉意。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
This is an international
incident, so to prevent any
intel leaks to Arunafeltz,
we've had to be much stricter
with securing and protecting
all information for this case.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
这是一起国际事件，为了防止情报泄露给阿鲁纳菲兹，我们不得不更加严格地保护此案的所有信息。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Anyway, I've decided to
reveal myself to you since
I'm the only one that can help
you right now. You're thinking
of using that boat, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
总之，既然我是目前唯一能帮你的人，我决定向你表明身份。你正打算用那艘船，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
If you don't have the skills,
knowledge, and preparation
to sail those waters ahead,
you'll probably wreck the
boat. You'll make it if you're lucky but... That's a lot of luck.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
如果你没有足够的技术、知识和准备来航行前方的水域，你很可能船毁人亡。如果你运气好或许能活下来，但...那需要极大的运气。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
I'll help you sail this
boat to get where you're
going. But if you fail, there's
a chance you might have to
sail this boat on your own if I'm not here. So, you ready to go?
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
我会帮你驾驶这艘船到达目的地。但如果你失败了，而且我不在的话，你可能得自己驾驶这艘船。所以，你准备好了吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I'm ready.
scripts.translation: 是的，我准备好了。

scripts.text: Give me more time.
scripts.translation: 再给我一点时间。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Alright, let's go.
Hold on to something:
this will probably be
a pretty rocky ride...
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
好，我们出发。
抓紧点：
这趟旅程可能会相当颠簸...

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Alright. Just let me know
whenever you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
好的。随时告诉我，你准备好了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the boat that
can take you to the
monastery.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这艘船可以带你前往修道院。^000000

scripts.text: Go to Monastery
scripts.translation: 前往修道院

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou set sail for
the monastery...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你扬帆起航，驶向修道院...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide to
stay ashore.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你决定留在岸上。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the boat that
can take you to the
monastery.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这艘船可以带你前往修道院。^000000

scripts.text: Go to Monastery
scripts.translation: 前往修道院

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou set sail for
the monastery...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你扬帆起航，驶向修道院...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide to
stay ashore.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你决定留在岸上。^000000

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Are you ready to go
aboard? I'll help you
sail to that monastery,
but if you fail while you're
there, I might not be here
when you come back.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
你准备好登船了吗？我会帮你航行到那座修道院，但如果你在那里失败了，等你回来时我可能不在。

scripts.text: Yes, I'm ready.
scripts.translation: 是的，我准备好了。

scripts.text: Give me more time.
scripts.translation: 再给我一点时间。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Alright, let's go.
Hold on to something:
this will probably be
a pretty rocky ride...
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
好，我们出发。
抓紧点：
这趟旅程可能会相当颠簸...

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Alright. Just let me know
whenever you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
好的。随时告诉我，你准备好了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe village is totally
silent, as if all life had
abandoned it. You look
around and see that something
was here a few hours ago, but
it's somewhere else now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF村庄一片死寂，仿佛所有生命都已离去。你环顾四周，发现几个小时前这里还有某种东西，但现在它已经不在这里了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWhatever it was,
it definitely wasn't
human. What kind of
creature could it be?^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF无论那是什么，肯定不是人类。那会是什么生物呢？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are traces of
humans around here,
along with some kind
of creature that you
can't clearly identify.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这里有人类的踪迹，还有一些你无法明确辨认的生物。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFA strange scent strikes
you as you enter this field of
grass. A few ^32CD32animal corpses^3355FF
are strewn around the ground.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF当你进入这片草地时，一股奇怪的气味扑面而来。地上散落着几具^32CD32动物尸体^3355FF。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFThere is a dead crow on the ground.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF地上有一只死乌鸦。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe sight of this ^32CD32dead
crow^3355FF makes you feel
uneasy for some reason.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这只^32CD32死乌鸦^3355FF的景象让你感到莫名的不安。^000000

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text: Investigate
scripts.translation: 调查

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide not to touch
the animal's carcass.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你决定不碰这具动物尸体。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou notice some grass sap
on the crow's beak, so it
must have been nibbling on
some grass. Some feathers
are missing, revealing
scaly, snake-like skin.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你注意到乌鸦的喙上沾着一些草汁，看来它一直在啃食草叶。有些羽毛脱落了，露出了鳞片状、类似蛇皮的皮肤。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait...
Did this grass...?

^3355FFThis grass must be the
main ingredient of the
poison used to kill the
Geoborg family princes.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这种草一定是用来毒杀吉奥伯格家族王子的毒药的主要成分。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Looks like I just hit
the jackpot. Huh?
Someone behi--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看来我真是走运了。咦？
身后有人——

scripts.text:
^3355FFA sharp, throbbing pain
assails the back of your
head as you fall into
unconsciousness...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF一阵剧烈的刺痛袭来，你感到后脑勺一阵眩晕，随即失去了意识...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe pressure on your
stomach and the blood
rushing to your head tells
you someone is carrying you
over his shoulder. He stops,
and you hear a faint voice.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF腹部的压迫感和涌向头部的血液告诉你，有人正把你扛在肩上。他停了下来，你听到一个微弱的声音。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe faint voice steadily
grows stronger and more
distinct--someone's calling
your name. You feel cold water
trickle through your lips, and
then you regain your senses.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF那微弱的声音逐渐变得清晰——有人在呼唤你的名字。你感到冷水流过嘴唇，随后恢复了知觉。^000000

scripts.text:
That was too close...
For a second there,
I thought I lost you.
scripts.translation:
太危险了...
刚才那一瞬间，
我差点以为你没了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Larjes...? What...
What happened?
Ugh, my head...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
拉杰斯...？
怎...怎么回事？
啊，头好痛...

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Try not to move for a while.
I had a bad feeling waiting
for you on the boat. Lucky
thing. When I found you,
these strange creatures
were savagely attacking you!
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
先别动，休息一会儿。
我在船上等你时总觉得不对劲。幸好。当我找到你时，那些奇怪的生物正在疯狂地攻击你！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You saved me?
Thank you. Do you
happen to know what
those creatures were?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是你救了我？
谢谢你。你知道
那些生物是什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
No clue. They looked
like humans, but... They
definitely weren't. Once
I killed them, they all
turned into sand.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
完全不知道。它们看起来像人类，但...肯定不是。我一杀掉它们，它们就全变成了沙子。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
It seems it's just like the
creatures that kidnapped
you, but... I wonder why
he's not attacking us.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
看来它和那些绑架你的生物很像，但...我想知道为什么它没有攻击我们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I guess you'll have to go
right up to him and ask.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看来你得直接上去
问问它了。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Be careful. That guy
looks pretty dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
小心点。这家伙
看起来很危险。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe door won't budge:
you can't go through.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF门纹丝不动：
你无法通过。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What the hell...!?

[Larjes]
So... This is the
island's true nature.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
原来...这就是
这座岛的真面目。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Someone like me won't
survive long in a place
like this. I'm going to wait
for you in the boat. Learn
what you need to learn, and then come back safe, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
像我这样的人，在这种地方活不了多久。我会在船上等你。查清楚你需要知道的事，然后平安回来，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
I don't like this place.
You'd be better be careful
around here with those weird
creatures running around.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
我不喜欢这个地方。
这里到处都跑着那些奇怪的生物，
你最好小心点。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Good, you're back
I know that there's still
things on this island that
you want to investigate,
but did you want to leave
this place for a while?
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
很好，你回来了。
我知道岛上还有你想调查的事情，
但你想暂时离开这里吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Alight, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
好吧，我们走。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Alright, but becareful.
Those creatures almost
got you once, you know.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
好吧，但小心点。
那些生物差点就抓住你了，你知道吗。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Did you still want to
investigate the island?
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
你还想继续调查这座岛吗？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Alright, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
好吧，我们走。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Alright, but be careful.
Those creatures almost
got you once, you know.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
好吧，但小心点。
那些生物差点就抓住你了，你知道吗。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Good, you're back.
I know that there's still
things on this island that
you want to investigate,
but did you want to leave
this place for a while?
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
很好，你回来了。
我知道岛上还有你想调查的事情，
但你想暂时离开这里吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Alright, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
好吧，我们走。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Alright, but becareful.
Those creatures almost
got you once, you know.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
好吧，但小心点。
那些生物差点就抓住你了，你知道吗。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
I don't believe it...
That guy was Tristam III?!
This explains a lot, I suppose.
I'll report this along with the
voucher. So Arunafeltz was
behind that poison grass too...
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
难以置信...
那个人是特里斯坦三世？！
这解释了很多事情，我想。
我会连同凭证一起汇报此事。所以阿鲁纳菲兹也参与了那些毒草的事...

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
I'm shocked over this
whole debacle. I'm sure
the Rune-Midgarts royal family
will be in an uproar over this.
To think that we're involved
in something this huge...
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
我对这整件事感到震惊。卢恩·米德加兹的皇室肯定会为此大动干戈。
没想到我们会卷入如此巨大的事件...

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Anyway, we better get
going... This is huge!
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
总之，我们最好快点走...这件事太大了！

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Did you still want to
investigate the island?
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
你还想继续调查这座岛吗？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Alright, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
好吧，我们走。

scripts.text:
[Larjes]
Alright, but becareful.
Those creatures almost
got you once, you know.
scripts.translation:
[拉杰斯]
好吧，但小心点。
那些生物差点就抓住你了，你知道吗。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务
将部分物品存入仓库，
然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's just a bunch
of old, moldy books.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF只是一堆发霉的旧书。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's a book stained
with blood amongst all
these old, moldy books.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF在这些发霉的旧书中，有一本沾满了血迹。^000000

scripts.text: Examine Book
scripts.translation: 检查书籍

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text:
^3355FFThat book was probably
worthless to you anyway.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF那本书对你来说大概毫无价值。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are old books
scattered all over here.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这里到处散落着旧书。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a man lying on
the floor, wearing torn
yet luxurious clothing.
He doesn't seem to be
breathing at all...^000000.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现一名男子躺在地上，
穿着破烂却华贵的衣服。
他似乎已经停止呼吸了...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a man lying on
the floor, wearing torn
yet luxurious clothing.
He doesn't seem to be
breathing at all...^000000.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你发现一名男子躺在地上，
穿着破烂却华贵的衣服。
他似乎已经停止呼吸了...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou bring your ears more
closely to his mouth: it
seems that he really is
still barely alive.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你把耳朵凑近他的嘴边：
似乎他还有微弱的呼吸。^000000

scripts.text: Touch Him
scripts.translation: 触碰他

scripts.text: Ignore Him
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This man...
He's so familiar
for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这名男子...
不知为何，
我觉得他很面熟。

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you touch him, the
man suddenly jumps
up with a crazed yowl.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF当你触碰他时，
那男子突然发出一声疯狂的嚎叫，
猛地跳了起来。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou don't feel
comfortable enough
to touch this man.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你还没有足够的勇气
去触碰这名男子。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务
将部分物品存入仓库，
然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have no idea why
this dead man is moving
around, so you decided to
examine him. In his jacket,
you find a shining medal...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你完全不明白
为什么这具尸体还会动，
于是决定检查他。在他的夹克里，
你发现了一枚闪闪发光的勋章...^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This medal...
This means that
this man is...!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这枚勋章...
这意味着
这名男子是...！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There is a low wall here against the other wall, if I climb it I could reach the resting place of Tristan III...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这里有一堵矮墙靠着另一堵墙，如果我爬上去，就能到达特里斯坦三世的安息之地了...

scripts.text: Stay here
scripts.translation: 留在这里

scripts.text: Climb the wall
scripts.translation: 爬上矮墙

scripts.text:
[Patch]
Input.
scripts.translation:
[帕奇]
输入。

scripts.text: Now
scripts.translation: 现在

scripts.text: How much?
scripts.translation: 多少钱？

scripts.text: P- How much?
scripts.translation: P- 多少钱？

scripts.text: Others
scripts.translation: 其他

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务
将部分物品存入仓库，
然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
So you wanted to talk to me?
I'm pretty tired right now, but
I can spare a moment or two.
What would you like to ask?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
原来你想和我谈谈？
我现在有点累，
但还能抽出一点时间。
你想问什么？

scripts.text: Ask About Veins Smugglers
scripts.translation: 询问关于伯仁斯走私者

scripts.text: Ask About Zhed
scripts.translation: 询问关于泽德

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Veins smugglers...
Would you explain
exactly what you mean
by Veins smugglers?
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
伯仁斯的走私者...
你能具体解释一下
你所说的“伯仁斯走私者”
是什么意思吗？

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Oh, them. Yes, I know
a little bit about them.
I'm afraid that I can't really
disclose certain information
about them since they're
a classified case...
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
哦，他们啊。是的，我
对他们了解一些。
恐怕我无法透露
关于他们的某些信息，
因为这是一个机密案件...

scripts.text:
[Niren]
I'm afraid that I cannot give you information about them easily
as they mean a lot to us.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
恐怕我不能轻易给你
关于他们的信息，
因为他们对我们很重要。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, I was curious
about who they kidnapped.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实，我很好奇
他们绑架了谁。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Oh, well, I suppose
I can tell you more
about their captive.
But first, I'd like to
ask you for a favor.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
哦，好吧，我想
我可以多告诉你一些
关于他们俘虏的事。
但首先，我想
请你帮个忙。

scripts.text: Accept
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Do Not Refuse
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text:
[Niren]
When we realized the
kind of hostage the
smugglers captured, we
didn't know what to do with
him. We've had too many
internal problems to handle...
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
当我们意识到走私者绑架的是什么人时，我们完全不知所措。我们内部的问题已经够多了...

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Still, we felt that we
could use him in our plan,
so we held him in a secret
place whose location is only
known to a few people. But
then... We lost all contact.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
尽管如此，我们还是觉得可以利用他来达成我们的计划，所以将他关押在一个只有少数人知道地点的秘密场所。但是后来...我们失去了所有联系。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
We sent investigators, but
we still have no idea what
happened. All they found was
a message left by one survivor:
''They're all demons.'' The
hostage is probably dead.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
我们派出了调查员，但仍然不知道发生了什么。他们只发现了一条由一名幸存者留下的信息：
“他们全是恶魔。”
那个人质大概已经死了。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
He may have been a high
ranking official, but we
were too preoccupied
with other matters. In fact,
I haven't gotten the chance
to think of what to do with him...
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
他可能是一位高官，但我们当时太忙于其他事务了。事实上，我甚至还没来得及思考该如何处置他...

scripts.text:
[Niren]
I want to ask you to
go to that place, and
figure out what happened
there, and if that high ranking
official from Rune-Midgarts is
still alive. I doubt it, but...
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
我想请你去那个地方，查明那里发生了什么，以及那位来自卢恩·米德加兹的高官是否还活着。虽然我不抱希望，但是...

scripts.text:
[Niren]
The investigators we employ
in our temple usually pale
in comparison to you foreign
adventurers, so I have faith
that you can do it. Still,
it'll be quite dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
我们在修道院雇佣的调查员通常远不如你们这些外国冒险者，所以我相信你能做到。不过，那里会很危险。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
If you can do this, I'll
tell you the location of
that place: we usually call
it the monastery. It used to
be an actual monastery, but we
use it to hold captives now.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
如果你能完成这件事，我会告诉你那个地方的位置：我们通常称之为修道院。它曾经是一座真正的修道院，但现在我们用它来关押俘虏。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
I'm sorry, but I can't tell
you anything else about that
old place. It's located to the
southwest of Veins across the
sea. You should be able to find
a boat at South Veins Beach.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
很抱歉，关于那个古老的地方，我无法透露更多。它位于伯仁斯西南方的海上。你应该能在伯仁斯南海滩找到船。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
However... Never mind.
I'd like to help you more,
but I'd be compromising my
position. I'm sorry. Please
come back and tell me if
you learn anything there.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
但是...算了。
我想帮你更多，但这会损害我的地位。很抱歉。
如果你在那里了解到什么，请回来告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
I'll send a message to the
magistrate of Veins. If you
talk to him, he'll provide you
with some useful information
for your journey. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
我会给伯仁斯的行政官发一封消息。如果你和他交谈，他会为你提供一些有用的旅行信息。祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Going to the monastery
isn't the problem: coming
back here alive will probably
be the real challenge for you.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
去修道院不是问题：活着回来这里，可能才是你真正的挑战。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
We can't send any troops
there until we understand
what they'd be confronting
there. That's why we need
you to investigate the area.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
在弄清楚那里有什么之前，我们无法派遣军队。这就是为什么我们需要你去调查那个区域。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Still investigating the
monastery? Perhaps if
you found any records
left behind by one of
the residents over there...
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
还在调查修道院吗？也许如果你能找到那里居民留下的记录...

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Still investigating the
monastery? Perhaps if
you found any records
left behind by one of
the residents over there...
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
还在调查修道院吗？也许如果你能找到那里居民留下的记录...

scripts.text:
[Niren]
You found this journal
in the monastery? Perfect.
Let me read it, and see
what we can learn...
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
你在修道院找到了这本日记？太好了。
让我读一读，看看我们能从中得知什么...

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Hmm, this sounds really
bad. This is tragic, especially
we kept so many important
people over there. I'll request
to dispatch troops there right
away. Something must be done.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
嗯，这听起来很糟糕。这太悲剧了，尤其是我们在那里关押了许多重要人物。我会立即申请派遣军队过去。必须做点什么。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
There are too many problems
we have to confront now, but
this monastery issue needs
top priority. We won't be able
to handle it if another threat
comes from that place.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
我们现在有太多问题要面对，但修道院的问题需要最高优先级。如果那个地方再次出现威胁，我们将无法应对。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
I suppose that Arunafeltz
and Rune-Midgarts will be too
busy with their own internal
issues to commit to war.
High Priest Zhed will be
glad to know about this.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
我想阿鲁纳菲兹和卢恩·米德加兹会忙于各自的内部问题，无暇参战。
大祭司 泽德会很高兴知道这件事。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I'm sorry...
I really don't want
to think about Zhed
right now. He's just...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
对不起...
我真的不想现在去想泽德。他只是...

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
You wanted to ask me about
Beken--High Priest Zhed?
I can't do anything for him.
He dug his own grave by
allowing you into the
holy ground, didn't he?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
你想问我关于贝肯——大祭司 泽德的事？
我帮不了他。
他让你进入圣地，不是自己挖了坟墓吗？

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I thought I warned you
before to stay out of trouble.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
我早就警告过你，让你远离麻烦。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm not here to discuss
that. But I happened to
hear that you're the only
person that can help him now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是来讨论这个的。但我听说，现在只有你能帮到他。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
It's true that Zhed and
I used to work well together,
but we no longer share the
same dream. You'd better find
someone else. Unlike him,
I actually want a war.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
确实，泽德和我过去配合得很好，但我们不再拥有相同的梦想。你最好去找别人。不像他，我其实渴望战争。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Weren't you guys friends?
Besides, you don't seem as
aggressive as those other
hard liner priests.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你们不是朋友吗？而且，你看起来并不像那些强硬派牧师那样好战。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Aggressive? Hmpf. If you
take a good look at those
moderates, you'll see that
they oppose war, but they're
also totally corrupt. In fact, they committed worse atrocities!
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
好战？哼。如果你仔细观察那些温和派，你会发现他们虽然反对战争，但也极度腐败。事实上，他们犯下了更可怕的暴行！

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
The moderates conducted
inhumane testing on living
creatures, even humans!
And Zhed and I... Could do
nothing but pray to Freya.
Only war can this this chaos!
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
温和派曾对活物，甚至人类进行非人道实验！而泽德和我...除了向芙蕾雅祈祷，什么也做不了。只有战争才能终结这场混乱！

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
We need to start all
over again. I can't help
Zhed. Please leave...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
我们需要重新开始。我帮不了泽德。请离开...

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt doesn't look like
you can change High
Priestess Niren's mind.
For now, you'd better talk
to High Priest Zhed.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF看来你无法改变大祭司 尼伦的想法。
目前，你最好去和大祭司 泽德谈谈。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I already told you
how I feel about Zhed.
We were wrong all along...
This time, war is the answer.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
我已经告诉过你我对泽德的感觉。
我们一直错了...
这一次，战争才是答案。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I already told you
how I feel about Zhed.
We were wrong all along...
This time, war is the answer.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
我已经告诉过你我对泽德的感觉。
我们一直错了...
这一次，战争才是答案。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Fine. If you're so sure
of yourself, then you won't
mind reading this letter
from High Priest Zhed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧。如果你这么自信，那你应该不介意读一下大祭司 泽德的这封信。

scripts.text:
^3355FFNiren angrily grabbed the
letter, ripped the envelope
open, and began to read his
message. Her stern face slowly
softened as she slowly scanned
what Zhed had to tell her.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF尼伦愤怒地抓起信，撕开信封，开始阅读他的留言。随着她慢慢扫过泽德写下的内容，她严厉的面容逐渐柔和下来。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
That Zhed... He always
did have a way with words.
I suppose the old saying is
true: the pen truly is mightier
than the sword. *Sigh...*
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
那个泽德...他总是很会说话。
我想那句老话是对的：笔确实比剑更有力。*叹息...*

scripts.text:
[Sippie]
High Priestess
Niren? Are you okay?
scripts.translation:
[西皮]
大祭司 尼伦？你没事吧？

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Oh, I'm fine,
thank you. I guess
I'm just a little tired.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
哦，我没事，谢谢。
我想我只是有点累了。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
...............................
I have to admit, there's truth
in what Zhed's saying. We
have a duty to protect our
people, the pope, our holy
ground. But I need to think...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
...............................
我必须承认，泽德说得有道理。
我们有责任保护我们的人民、教皇和圣地。但我需要思考一下...

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Would you give me some
time to myself? I'll let you
know once I've made a decision.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
能给我一点独处的时间吗？
一旦我做出决定，我会通知你。

scripts.text:
[Sippie]
High Priestess Niren,
you must be really tired.
You look pale for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[西皮]
大祭司 尼伦，
你一定很累吧。
不知道为什么，你看起来脸色很苍白。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I do feel rather drained.
I don't know why I've been
holding on to this hatred for
so long. I guess I can finally
just cast it to the winds...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
我感到有些精疲力竭。
我不知道自己为何
要执着于这份仇恨这么久。
我想，我终于可以
将其抛诸脑后了...

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Adventurer...
What was your name?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
冒险者...
你叫什么名字来着？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
My name is {1}.

[High Priestess Niren]
Adventurer...
You had the chance to talk
with our pope once, but I doubt
you'll be able to do so again
^3311FFin private^000000. You'll definitely
need our help for that end.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
冒险者...
你曾有机会与我们的教皇交谈，
但我怀疑你无法再次
^3311FF私下^000000见到她。
要做到这一点，
你肯定需要我们的帮助。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Does this mean that
you've decided to work
with Zhed again?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是意味着你决定
再次与泽德合作吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FFNiren quietly nodded
her head, and then
resumed talking.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF尼伦轻轻点了点头，
然后继续说道。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I'm still not sure if
I can join him in the long
run. I mean, talking to the
pope might not result in
anything, actually. But
it's still worth a try.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
我仍不确定自己
能否长期与他合作。我是说，
与教皇交谈可能
实际上不会有任何结果。
但尝试一下也无妨。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
However, I've never
doubted Zhed's dedication
to Arunafeltz. He deserves
another chance from me.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
然而，我从未怀疑过
泽德对阿鲁纳菲兹的忠诚。
他值得我再给他一次机会。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Our pope is always surrounded 
by priests and followers sent
by High Priest Vildt. He always
manages to keep his eyes and
ears on her. We need to get
those spies away somehow...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
我们的教皇总是被
神官维尔德派来的牧师和信徒包围。
她总是设法监视着他们。
我们需要想办法赶走那些间谍...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What can we do
about them, then?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我们该怎么做？

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
For now, just approach
the pope as if you just
wanted to leisurely chat.
While you're doing that,
try to gather information
from the priests around her.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
目前，只需假装
只是想随意聊聊去接近教皇。
在此期间，
试着从她身边的牧师那里
收集情报。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sure thing. You
can count on me!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没问题。你可以
指望我！

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Ugh, this is giving me
a headache. There's
too much to consider...
Too much at stake here...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
唉，这让我头疼。
要考虑的事情太多了...
这里的利害关系太重了...

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Just approach the pope
for a chat, and see what
you can learn from the
other priests around her.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
只需去和教皇聊聊天，
看看你能从她身边的
其他牧师那里了解到什么。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
How is the pope?
I haven't had the chance
to meet her recently, so...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
教皇最近怎么样？
我最近没机会见她，所以...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, she doesn't seem
very well, just like the
last time I saw her. I didn't
learn anything about all those
priests. Just that they've been
working in the temple non-stop.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，她看起来不太好，
就像我上次见她时一样。
我没有从那些牧师那里
了解到什么。只知道他们
一直在神殿没日没夜地工作。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Yes, they've been by her
side twenty-fours a day.
It's been like that for years.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
是的，他们日夜守护在她身边。
这种情况已经持续多年了。

scripts.text:
[Sippie]
Oh, High Priestess Niren,
I love working for you, but
sometimes I wish I could leave
just to see my family. Even
just once a year would be nice.
scripts.translation:
[西皮]
哦，大祭司 尼伦，
我很乐意为您工作，但
有时候我真希望能离开，
去看看我的家人。哪怕一年一次也好。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
...............................
You're absolutely right.
That gives me an idea.

[Sippie]
Huh? What is it?
scripts.translation:
[西皮]
嗯？什么主意？

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
You all need a vacation.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
你们都需要休假。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
{0}.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
{0}。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I should reward everyone
in the Sky Garden for their
contribution. However,
they were hired by Vildt,
so I can't directly give them
leave for vacation. Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
我应该奖励天空花园里的每一个人，感谢他们的贡献。但是，他们是受雇于维尔德的，所以我不能直接给他们放假。嗯...

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Sippie...
I'll need a pen
and some paper.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
西皮...
我需要一支笔和一些纸张。

scripts.text:
[Sippie]
Yes, ma'am.
There you go!
scripts.translation:
[西皮]
好的，女士。
给您！

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Scribble Scribble*^000000
^3355FF*Scribble Scribble*^000000
^3355FF*Scribble Scribble*^000000
^3355FF*Scribble Scribble*^000000

[High Priestess Niren]
I administered a blessing
for a child from a native
family, and they were very
grateful since most of the
priests shun the natives.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
我为一个原住民家庭的孩子施了天使之赐福，他们非常感激，因为大多数牧师都回避原住民。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
It turns out that this
child is gifted at forgery.
She doesn't like being too
close to other people, but
that's beside the point.
Here, take this letter.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
原来这个孩子很有伪造的天赋。她不喜欢与人走得太近，但这不是重点。拿着，把这封信带走。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Ah, and take this file that
contains a sample of Vildt's
handwriting. Bring them to
a girl named Ishmael in a
village in North Rachel.
I hope she'll help us...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
啊，还有这份包含维尔德笔迹样本的文件。把它们带到拉赫北部的一个村庄，交给一个叫伊什梅尔的女孩。希望她会帮我们的忙...

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Please deliver my letter
and that file to Ishmael in
North Rachel. Hopefully,
she can use her talents
to help us out.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
请把我的信和那份文件送到拉赫北部的伊什梅尔那里。希望她能利用她的天赋帮上忙。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Have you met with Ishmael?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
你见过伊什梅尔了吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou handed Niren the
file forged by Ishmael.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你把伊什梅尔伪造的文件交给了尼伦。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Perfect! This forgery is
so well done, I'm sure
that even Vildt won't be
know if he wrote it or not.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
完美！这份伪造品做得太好了，我确信连维尔德自己都不知道这是他写的。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
{0}...
I'm going to use this to
send the priests and followers
on vacation. Then me and Zhed
can talk to the pope without
any unecessary interruptions.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
{0}...
我要用这个让牧师和信徒们去休假。这样我和泽德就可以在没有不必要打扰的情况下与教皇交谈了。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I really don't want to burden
our pope with what Zhed and I
have to say... But that's much
preferable to doing nothing
and experiencing the downfall
of our beloved Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
我真的不想把泽德和我要说的话给教皇添麻烦...但比起什么都不做，看着我们深爱的阿鲁纳菲兹走向毁灭，这样做要好得多。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Sippie, please
deliver this vacation
approval to the priests and
followers in the Sky Garden.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
西皮，请把这份休假批准书送到天空花园的牧师和信徒那里。

scripts.text:
[Sippie]
Yes, ma'am!
scripts.translation:
[西皮]
好的，女士！

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
{0},
please go back to Zhed,
and let him know everything
is ready. Then I want you to
meet us in the ^3131FFSky Garden^000000.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
{0}，
请回去告诉泽德，一切都准备好了。然后我要你在^3131FF天空花园^000000与我们会面。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
We need to hurry and
do this before High
Priest Vildt realizes
what we are doing.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
我们需要抓紧，在大祭司维尔德意识到我们在做什么之前完成这件事。

scripts.text:
^3131FFYou seem to have
misplaced Ishmael's file.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3131FF你似乎弄丢了伊什梅尔的文件。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Please hurry back
to High Priest Zhed.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
请赶快回去找大祭司 泽德。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I'm so proud of our pope!
Did you hear her wonderful
speech? Well, I should say
those are the words of Freya,
but... Well, you know. Hohoho!
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
我真为我们的教皇感到骄傲！
你听到她那精彩的演讲了吗？
嗯，应该说那是芙蕾雅的话语，
不过... 你知道的。呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Our priests may have acted
selfishly, but they are still
committed to Arunafeltz's
welfare. Things should
change for the better now.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
我们的牧师们虽然有些自私，
但他们仍然致力于阿鲁纳菲兹的福祉。
现在情况应该会好转了。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I'm ashamed that I strayed
from the path of peace and
almost endangered my country.
I'm glad Zhed brought me back
my senses. From now on, I'll
repent for my sins with Zhed.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
我为自己偏离和平之道，
几乎危及国家而感到羞愧。
很高兴泽德让我恢复了理智。
从现在起，我将与泽德一起赎罪。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I hope the goddess can
forgive me. Ah, and you
should know that Zhed is
waiting for you. Why don't
you go see him now?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
希望女神能原谅我。
啊，对了，你应该知道泽德在等你。
你不妨现在去见见他？

scripts.text:
^3355FFNiren softly smiles
at you, and you realize
that it's the first time
that you've seen that
expression on her face.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF尼伦对你温柔地微笑，
你意识到这是你第一次
在她脸上看到这种表情。^000000

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Thanks to you and
Bekento, I think I've
finally found my way.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
多亏了你和贝克托，
我想我终于找到了方向。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I'm sorry...
I really don't want
to think about Zhed
right now. He's just...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼伦]
对不起...
我真的不想现在去想泽德。他只是...

scripts.text:
[Sippie]
Now I finally have some
time to take a break.
Too many followers are
crowding High Priestess
Niren, and they're giving
me so much work to do!
scripts.translation:
[西皮]
现在我终于有时间休息一下了。
太多信徒围着大祭司 尼伦，
他们给了我太多工作要做！

scripts.text:
[Sippie]
Excuse me, but are you
a friend of our pope?
I think I saw you talk
to her a while ago...
scripts.translation:
[西皮]
请问，你是我们教皇的朋友吗？
我刚才好像看到你在和她说话...

scripts.text:
[Sippie]
I don't understand why
High Priestess Niren wants
to go to war. I actually think
that in her heart, she doesn't
want it. She's sweet and kind
once you get to know her.
scripts.translation:
[西皮]
我不明白大祭司 尼伦为什么想发动战争。
我其实觉得，在她心里，她并不想这么做。
只要你了解她，就会发现她既温柔又善良。

scripts.text:
[Sippie]
She loves children...
She's like a mother to
all the kids in Arunafeltz.
She even brought our pope to
Rachel when she was a baby,
raising her like her own child.
scripts.translation:
[西皮]
她喜欢孩子们...
她是阿鲁纳菲兹所有孩子的母亲。
她甚至在我们教皇还是婴儿时，
就把她带到拉赫，像亲生女儿一样抚养她。

scripts.text:
[Sippie]
If you didn't know she
was our pope, it'd be easy
to mistake her for High
Priestess Niren's daughter.
scripts.translation:
[西皮]
如果你不知道她是我们的教皇，
很容易把她误认为是大祭司 尼伦的女儿。

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
I never thought the desert
would be this hot! They built
a town here?! How can they call
this place inhabitable! What's
more, the crowds make things
around here so much hotter!
scripts.translation:
[外来商人]
我从没想过沙漠会这么热！
他们居然在这里建了一座城镇？！
怎么能说这个地方适合居住呢！
而且，人群让这里变得更热了！

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
I heard that I could make
a killing in Morocc, which is
why I moved my business here.
But it looks like the weather
is going to kill me first!
scripts.translation:
[外来商人]
我听说在摩洛哥可以大赚一笔，
所以我把生意搬到了这里。
但看起来天气会先把我热死！

scripts.text: How did you hear of Morocc?
scripts.translation: 你是怎么听说摩洛哥的？

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
I... I just told you.
I heard that Morocc is
full customers willing to
buy things at premium prices.
Ugh, but it's a burning hell!
scripts.translation:
[外来商人]
我... 我刚才不是告诉你了吗。
我听说摩洛哥有很多顾客，
愿意以高价购买东西。
唉，但这地方简直是个燃烧的地狱！

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
I don't even care about making
money anymore! I just want to
be somewhere cool, drinking
a nice, frosty drink! You know,
I might just leave this town
tomorrow. Forget this desert!
scripts.translation:
[外来商人]
我现在甚至不在乎赚钱了！
我只想去个凉快的地方，
喝杯冰镇饮料！
你知道吗，我可能明天就离开这个城镇。
忘掉这片沙漠吧！

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
Ah, that's right. Don't they
sell some sweet, heavenly
drink around here? You know,
near the pond in the middle
of Morocc? Before I leave,
I want to taste that drink...
scripts.translation:
[外来商人]
啊，对了。这里附近不卖一种甜美的、
天堂般的饮料吗？
你知道，在摩洛哥中间的池塘附近？
在我离开之前，我想尝尝那种饮料...

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
Say, isn't there a wandering
drink merchant near the pond
in the middle of Morocc. Oh,
what I would do to have that
delicious drink he's selling...
scripts.translation:
[外来商人]
喂，摩洛哥中间的池塘附近
是不是有个流浪的饮料商人？
哦，我多么想喝到他卖的那种美味饮料啊...

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
Oh, the heat's getting to me...
And I'm running out of sweat
to sweat... I think I'm going
to faint soon! I need a drink!
scripts.translation:
[外来商人]
热得受不了了...
汗水都快流干了...我感觉快要晕倒了！我需要喝点东西！

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
*Pant Pant*
*Sweat*
scripts.translation:
[外来商人]
*喘气 喘气*
*流汗*

scripts.text: Give Fruit Wine
scripts.translation: 给予水果酒

scripts.text: Quietly Watch Him
scripts.translation: 静静地看着他

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
Oh, thank you! This
smells so heavenly...
Is this that famous drink
that I keep hearing about?
scripts.translation:
[外来商人]
哦，谢谢你！
这闻起来太美妙了...
这就是我一直听说的那种著名饮料吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Gulp Gulp Gulp Gulp*^000000
^3355FF*Gulp Gulp Gulp Gulp*^000000
^3355FF*Gulp Gulp Gulp Gulp*^000000
^3355FF*Gulp Gulp Gulp Gulp*^000000
^3355FF*Gulp Gulp Gulp Gulp*^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*咕咚 咕咚 咕咚 咕咚*^000000
^3355FF*咕咚 咕咚 咕咚 咕咚*^000000
^3355FF*咕咚 咕咚 咕咚 咕咚*^000000
^3355FF*咕咚 咕咚 咕咚 咕咚*^000000
^3355FF*咕咚 咕咚 咕咚 咕咚*^000000

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
Ahhh! That hit the spot!
It's so refreshing and so
exotic, like... Like... Those
dancers in Comodo! Ahhhh!
Thank you so much, friend!
scripts.translation:
[外来商人]
啊哈！太解渴了！
既清爽又独特，就像...就像...
克魔岛的那些舞娘一样！啊哈！
非常感谢你，朋友！

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
There must be some
way I can repay you.
Ah, here we go. Take it.
Isn't your name, {0}?
scripts.translation:
[外来商人]
我得想办法报答你。
啊，就是这个。拿着吧。
你的名字是{0}，对吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What th--?
How did you know?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什...什么？
你怎么知道我的名字？

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe merchant giggled,
note from under his sleeve.
You open the note, and
read its message.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF商人咯咯笑着，
从袖子里拿出一张纸条。
你打开纸条，
读上面的内容。^000000

scripts.text:
^666666{0}.
 
The time for us to act
has come once again.
Please come see me
once you get the chance.
 
 - Bekento^000000
scripts.translation:
^666666{0}。
 
我们行动的时间
再次到来了。
请找机会来见我。
 
 - 贝肯托^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So... This means...
You're not really a
merchant, are you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以...这意味着...
你其实不是商人，对吧？

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe merchant quietly
looks at you with a
mischievous grin.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF商人静静地注视着你，
脸上带着顽皮的微笑。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So you asked me to get
you a drink as an excuse
just to talk to you?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以你让我给你带饮料，
只是为了找个借口跟我说话？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh well, thanks for
bringing me the note.
But I'm not buying you
any more drinks, got it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
算了，谢谢你把纸条带给我。
但我不会再给你买饮料了，明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
Heh, understood.
Now why don't you
speak to him now?
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[外来商人]
嘿，明白了。
那你现在去和他对话吧。
祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
Wha-- Do you just
enjoy watching me
slowly sweat to death?
scripts.translation:
[外来商人]
什...什么？
你就喜欢看着我慢慢热死吗？

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
Well, I'm already here.
I guess I may as well go
sightseeing around Morocc.
*Pant Pant* But it's so hot!
scripts.translation:
[外来商人]
既然我已经在这里了。
那我也许可以顺便在摩洛哥逛逛。
*喘气 喘气* 但这里太热了！

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
I never thought the desert
would be this hot! They built
a town here?! How can they call
this place inhabitable! What's
more, the crowds make things
around here so much hotter!
scripts.translation:
[外来商人]
我从没想过沙漠会这么热！
他们居然在这里建了一座城镇？！
怎么能说这个地方适合居住呢！
而且，人群让这里变得更热了！

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
*Pant Pant*
Man, I think I'm going
to die from all this heat!
scripts.translation:
[外来商人]
*喘气 喘气*
天哪，我觉得我要被热死了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but I heard
that I could buy some
good drinks around here.
Would you happen to be
the one selling them?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下，我听说
这里附近可以买到不错的饮料。
请问你是卖饮料的那个人吗？

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
Oh, you mean my fruit wine?
I'm afraid it's not as good
as people chalk it up to be.
It's just a little something
I brew at home, and share
with my friends after dinner.
scripts.translation:
[外来商人]
哦，你说的是我的果酒吗？
恐怕它并没有人们吹捧得那么好。
这只是我在家自酿的一点小酒，
饭后和朋友们分享而已。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I ran into this
merchant that really wants
to have a taste of that wine.
Do you think that you'd be
able to sell me some?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我遇到了一个商人，
他很想尝尝那酒。
你觉得你能卖给我一些吗？

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
Oh, I'm sorry, but I'm
all sold out for today.
scripts.translation:
[外来商人]
哦，抱歉，今天的酒已经卖光了。

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
You know, I save a small
bottle of wine for myself
so I'll just give that to you.
I can always brew more, and
I'm flattered that your friend
is so interested in my wine.
scripts.translation:
[外来商人]
你知道吗，我给自己留了一小瓶酒，
我就把那瓶给你吧。
我可以再酿一些，
而且你的朋友对我的酒这么感兴趣，
我感到很荣幸。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Really? Thank you!
I'm sure that he's really
appreciate your generosity.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真的吗？谢谢你！
我相信他一定会非常感激你的慷慨。

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
Oh, don't mention it.
Well, I should head back
home now. I'll be sure to
keep an extra bottle in case
you want more next time. Take
care, and I'll see you later!
scripts.translation:
[外来商人]
哦，别客气。
好了，我该回家了。
下次如果你还想喝，
我会多留一瓶的。
保重，回头见！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received a bottle
of the famous fruit wine
from the old man. That
guy's pretty nice!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你从老人那里得到了一瓶
著名的果酒。
那个家伙人真好！^000000

scripts.text:
[Foreign Merchant]
I'm sorry, but I'm all
sold out of fruit wine.
I hope that's not too
much of an inconvenience.
scripts.translation:
[外来商人]
抱歉，我的果酒已经卖光了。
希望这不会给你带来太多不便。

scripts.text:
[Sappie]
I work really hard to keep
this room clean and cozy so
that the High Priestess can
rest and refresh herself in
comfort. Take a deep breath:
smell that relaxing aroma?
scripts.translation:
[萨皮]
我非常努力地保持这个房间
干净舒适，
这样大祭司就能舒适地休息和恢复。
深呼吸：
闻到那股令人放松的香气了吗？

scripts.text:
[Sappie]
I work really hard to keep
this room clean and cozy so
that the High Priestess can
rest and refresh herself in
comfort. Take a deep breath:
smell that relaxing aroma?
scripts.translation:
[萨皮]
我非常努力地保持这个房间
干净舒适，
这样大祭司就能舒适地休息和恢复。
深呼吸：
闻到那股令人放松的香气了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, you're right, that
is a nice smell! So, is
Priestess Niren away
from her office today?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
噢，你说得对，
那味道真不错！
那么，尼伦女祭司今天不在办公室吗？

scripts.text:
[Sappie]
Oh, yes, she's out since
there are many followers
that wish to meet her,
even early in the morning.
scripts.translation:
[萨皮]
哦，是的，她出去了，
因为有很多信徒
希望见她，
甚至一大早就这样。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you know where
I could find her?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道我能在哪里找到她吗？

scripts.text:
[Sappie]
Hm... Sippie mentioned
something... Ah, right. Sippie
said that High Priestess Niren
decided to go to Cheshrumnir
Garden. That garden is very
large, and quite beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[萨皮]
嗯...西皮提到了什么...啊，对了。
西皮说大祭司 尼伦
决定去瑟斯隆尼勒花园。
那个花园非常大，
而且相当美丽。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The High Priestess
must be very busy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大祭司一定很忙。

scripts.text:
[Sappie]
Oh, you can't even imagine!
She's been passing her wisdom
to the people ever since she
was a baby, and crowds of
people still clamor for
her sage teachings.
scripts.translation:
[萨皮]
哦，你甚至无法想象！
她从婴儿时期就开始
向人们传授智慧，
而现在人群仍然渴望
聆听她贤者的教诲。

scripts.text:
[Sappie]
If you really want
to talk to her, it'd
be best if you catch her
before she's surrounded
by Freya's followers.
scripts.translation:
[萨皮]
如果你真的想和她谈谈，
最好在她被芙蕾雅的信徒
包围之前找到她。

scripts.text:
[Sappie]
High Priestess Niren must
be in Cheshrumnir Garden.
You should try to talk to her
before the crowds show up.
scripts.translation:
[萨皮]
大祭司 尼伦一定在瑟斯隆尼勒花园。
你应该在人群到来之前
试着和她谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Sappie]
It's rumored that the
Goddess Freya spoke to
our pope, giving her an
important message. Now
everyone wants to hear
what Freya told her...
scripts.translation:
[萨皮]
据说女神芙蕾雅
曾对我们的教皇说过话，
传达了一个重要的信息。
现在每个人都想听听
芙蕾雅对她说了什么...

scripts.text:
[Sappie]
I work really hard to keep
this room clean and cozy so
that the High Priestess can
rest and refresh herself in
comfort. Take a deep breath:
smell that relaxing aroma?
scripts.translation:
[萨皮]
我非常努力地保持这个房间
干净舒适，
这样大祭司就能舒适地休息和恢复。
深呼吸：
闻到那股令人放松的香气了吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务
将部分物品存入仓库，
然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
I-I don't know you, do I?
Sorry, but would you, um,
just step away? I... I don't
like being too close to
other people. Please!
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅尔]
我...我不认识你吧？
抱歉，那个，
请退后一点好吗？我...我不太喜欢
和别人靠得太近。拜托了！

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
I-I don't know you, do I?
Sorry, but would you, um,
just step away? Wait, you
don't have something you
need from me, do you?
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅尔]
我...我不认识你吧？
抱歉，那个，
请退后一点好吗？等等，
你该不会有什么事
需要我帮忙吧？

scripts.text: Give Her Niren's File
scripts.translation: 给她尼伦的文件

scripts.text: Leave Her Alone
scripts.translation: 别打扰她

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know High Priestess
Niren, right? This is from her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你认识大祭司 尼伦，对吧？
这是她给你的。

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
Oh, really? Okay, just...
Just toss the file over
to me. I-I don't want
you coming any closer.
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅尔]
哦，是吗？好的，那就...
直接把文件扔给我吧。我...我不想
让你靠得更近。

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
I'll be glad to help out
the priestess. Even though
we're natives, she's never
discriminated against us.
Hmm... What does she want?
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅尔]
我很乐意帮女祭司的忙。
虽然我们是原住民，
但她从未歧视过我们。
嗯...她想要什么？

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
Let's see... She wants
me to forge a copy of this
file? Piece of cake, I'm an
expert at forging writing!
Just give me a moment and--
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅尔]
让我看看...她想要我
伪造一份这份文件的副本？
小菜一碟，我伪造文书可是专家！
给我一点时间——

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
Dang it! I completely forgot!
Someone stole my pen yesterday!
Now how am I gonna do this...?
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅尔]
该死！我完全忘了！
昨天有人偷了我的笔！
这下我该怎么办...？

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
My pen was made of a very
rare gemstone called ^FF0000Sardonyx^000000.
*Sob* I don't think anyone
sells Sardonyx in Arunafeltz.
You can only get that in the
countries next to us...
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅尔]
我的笔是用一种非常稀有的宝石原石制成的，叫^FF0000红玉髓^000000。
*抽泣* 我觉得阿鲁纳菲兹
没人卖红玉髓。
你只能在我们邻国找到那种东西...

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
I really want to help
High Priestess Niren...
I can't let her down after
she's been so good to us...
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅尔]
我真的想帮大祭司 尼伦...
她对我们这么好，
我不能让她失望...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou seem to have
misplaced Niren's file...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你似乎弄丢了尼伦的文件...^000000

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
I... I don't see you
backing away. Stay back,
and don't you dare touch me!
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅尔]
我...我看你并没有
退后啊。站远点，
千万别碰我！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Would you be able to forge
a copy of High Priestess
Niren's file if you had
this gemstone?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你有了这块宝石原石，
你能伪造一份大祭司 尼伦
文件的副本吗？

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
Oh, you found
a Sardonyx for me?
It looks perfect!
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅尔]
哦，你帮我找到了一块
红玉髓？
看起来完美极了！

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
Er, but, um...
Would you please
not come any closer?
I still... Uh... I don't mean
to be rude... It's just...
I'm just not good with...
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅尔]
呃，那个，嗯...
你能不能
别再靠近了？
我还是...呃...我不是故意
要无礼的...只是...
我不太擅长...

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
If you just toss the
Sardonyx over here,
I'll be able to forge
your copy right away.
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅尔]
如果你把红玉髓
扔到这里，
我就能马上
帮你伪造副本。

scripts.text: Don't Give It to Her
scripts.translation: 不给她

scripts.text: Give It to Her
scripts.translation: 给她

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
Huh? I thought you
needed my help? I can't
do anything unless you
give me that gemstone.
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅尔]
咦？我以为你
需要我的帮助？
除非你把那块宝石原石给我，
否则我什么都做不了。

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
Yay, thank you so much!
Now I can get to work~
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅尔]
太好了，非常感谢！
现在我可以开始工作了~

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Scribble*
*Scribble*^000000

^3355FF*Scribble*
*Scribble*^000000

^3355FF*Scribble*
*Scribble*^000000
^3355FF*Scribble*
*Scribble*^000000

[Ishmael]
There you go! I made the
best quality copy I could for
you since High Priestess
Niren requested for it.
Would you please send
her my regards? Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅尔]
给您！既然大祭司 尼伦有求于我，
我就为您制作了最高品质的副本。
请帮我向她问好，好吗？嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received a file
containing a forged
written approval for
vacation from Ishmael.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF您收到了一份文件，
其中包含伊什梅尔伪造的
休假书面批准。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
If only I only had
my precious pen made
of Sardonyx! Waaaah~!
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅尔]
要是我有那支用红玉髓
制成的珍贵钢笔就好了！哇啊啊~！

scripts.text:
[Ishmael]
High Priestess Niren is
such a nice lady. I have to
help her out whenever I get
the chance. Er, do you mind
stepping back a bit? I just...
I don't like being near people!
scripts.translation:
[伊什梅尔]
大祭司 尼伦真是位好女士。
只要有机会，我一定要帮她。
呃，你介意稍微退后一点吗？我只是...
我不喜欢别人靠我太近！

scripts.text:
^3355FFHigh Priest Zhed and High
Priestess Niren have already
arrived, and are carefully
watching the pope's face.
They seem worried about
what will happen...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF大祭司 泽德和大祭司 尼伦已经
到达，正小心翼翼地观察着教皇的脸色。
他们似乎对即将发生的事感到担忧...^000000

scripts.text:
[Zhed]
How have you been, Your
Eminence? I apologize for
not visiting you sooner, but
I've been too ashamed about
my competency as a high priest.
scripts.translation:
[泽德]
您最近好吗，圣座大人？
抱歉没能早点来拜访您，
但作为神官，我因自己的无能而感到羞愧。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
High Priest Zhed...
You came... Thank you...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
大祭司 泽德...
你来了...谢谢你...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe pope faintly smiled
at High Priest Zhed, glad
to finally see him again.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF教皇对大祭司 泽德露出了
淡淡的微笑，很高兴终于再次见到他。^000000

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Your Eminence...
I hope you understand
that I've tried my best
to only show you what is
beautiful in this world...
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
圣座大人...
希望您能理解，
我一直尽力只向您展示
这个世界美丽的一面...

scripts.text:
[Niren]
However, today I must
reveal to you the world's
ugliness as well. I'm sorry...
I gave the Sky Garden people
a vacation today so that we
tell you something in private.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
然而，今天我必须向您
揭示这个世界丑陋的一面。对不起...
今天我给了天空花园的人们放假，
以便我们私下向您说明情况。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Niren... What is it?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
尼伦...是什么事？

scripts.text:
[Zhed]
You may want to brace
yourself, Your Eminence,
for what we are about to
tell you. You may very
well be shocked...
scripts.translation:
[泽德]
圣座大人，
请您做好心理准备，
因为我们即将告诉您的事，
可能会让您非常震惊...

scripts.text:
^3355FFHigh Priest Zhed explained
all of Arunafeltz's secrets
in detail. He revealed the
split between the moderates
and hard liners among the
priests, the corruption...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF大祭司 泽德详细解释了
阿鲁纳菲兹的所有秘密。他揭露了
牧师中温和派与强硬派之间的分裂，
以及腐败现象...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHe also explained the role
of the priests in the inhumane
testing conducted by the
Rekenber Corporation, and
the hard liner priests grab
for power at Thor Volcano.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF他还解释了牧师在雷肯贝尔公司
进行的人体实验中所扮演的角色，
以及强硬派牧师在火山争夺权力的行为。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe pope stared at
High Priest Zhed in
shock as he spoke.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF教皇震惊地凝视着
正在说话的大祭司 泽德。^000000

scripts.text:
[Zhed]
We all understand that
you're already burdened
enough with your duties
as pope, but we feel that
you should take action soon.
scripts.translation:
[泽德]
我们都理解，
您作为教皇已经背负了足够的重担，
但我们觉得您应该尽快采取行动。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
We don't mean to force
you, Your Eminence, but
we don't have much time.
We're facing the possibility
of war, and we must stop it
in order to save Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
圣座大人，
我们无意强迫您，
但时间不多了。
我们正面临战争的威胁，
为了拯救阿鲁纳菲兹，
我们必须阻止它。

scripts.text:
[Zhed, Niren]
Excuse me?
scripts.translation:
[泽德，尼伦]
抱歉，什么？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Niren, Zhed...
I'm glad that you all
finally came to me for
a solution to all this.
I'm young, but I remember
what I saw in the holy ground.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
尼伦，泽德...
我很高兴你们终于
来找我寻求解决这一切的办法。
虽然我年轻，
但我记得我在圣地看到的一切。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Don't you remember, Niren?
You found me in the holy
ground, and safely led me
out. But while I was there,
I saw ^3131FFYmir's Heart^000000.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
你不记得了吗，尼伦？
是你在圣地找到了我，
并安全地将我带了出来。
但就在我在那里的时候，
我看到了^3131FF伊米尔之心^000000。

scripts.text:
[Zhed]
How... How did you know
that was Ymir's Heart?
scripts.translation:
[泽德]
怎...怎么可能知道
那是伊米尔之心的？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
The priests in the Sky
Garden don't mind talking
freely around me. I guess
they looked at me more as
a child, rather than as pope.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
天空花园的牧师们
在我面前说话很随意。
我想在他们眼里，
我更像个孩子，而不是教皇。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I'm already aware of the
moderate priest group
conducting their cruel tests,
and of the hard liners building
their military power. However,
I couldn't really do anything.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
我已经知道温和派牧师
正在进行残酷的实验，
也知道强硬派正在建立军事力量。
然而，我什么也做不了。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Most people don't take my
position seriously because
of my age. Nobody believes
I can change the situation.
I've also heard everything
about what you did, Zhed.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
大多数人因为我的年龄
而不重视我的职位。
没有人相信我能改变现状。
我也听说了你做的所有事，泽德。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I'm sorry that you were
punished by the other priests
for allowing an outsider to
enter the holy ground, but
I understand your reasons.
Isn't this the adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
很抱歉，你因为允许外人
进入圣地而受到其他牧师的惩罚，
但我理解你的理由。
这位就是那位冒险者吧？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
{0}...
I'm very glad to see you
again. Not only did you
share news of the outside
world with me, but you've
been protecting our peace.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
{0}...
很高兴再次见到你。
你不仅与我分享了外界的消息，
还一直在守护我们的和平。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
I really didn't know...
How'd you feel about this,
or how much you actually
knew. I'm truly sorry, Your
Eminence. I'm ashamed
for underestimating you.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
我真的不知道...
您对此的感受，
或者您实际上知道多少。
圣座大人，我真的很抱歉。
我很惭愧，竟然低估了您。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Please don't apologize,
Niren. If it weren't for you,
I'd be drawn into the utter
foolishness of the selfish
people in this temple. Niren,
you're like a mother to me.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
请不要道歉，尼伦。
如果不是因为你，
我早就被这座寺庙里
那些自私之人的愚蠢行径
拖入深渊了。尼伦，
你对我来说就像母亲一样。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Your Eminence...
Thank you. I feel
the same way...
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
圣座大人...
谢谢您。
我也这么觉得...

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Zhed...?
I need you to do
something for me.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
泽德...
我需要你帮我做一件事。

scripts.text:
[Zhed]
Of course,
Your Eminence.
scripts.translation:
[泽德]
当然，
圣座大人。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Write a report about the
tests conducted by the
moderates in Arunafeltz and
the Schwarzwald Republic,
and their relationship with
that Schwarzwald Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
写一份报告，
关于温和派在阿鲁纳菲兹
和修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国
进行的实验，
以及他们与修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德公司的关系。

scripts.text:
[Zhed]
I'll get it done immediately,
Your Eminence. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[泽德]
我立刻去办，
圣座大人。谢谢您。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Niren.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
尼伦。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Yes, Your Eminence?
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
是，圣座大人？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Please collect the
evidence that proves
that the hard liners have
been gearing for war.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
请收集证据，
证明强硬派
正在为战争做准备。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Yes, Your Eminence.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
遵命，圣座大人。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I'll summon all the High
Priests and Priestesses
soon. I'd like the two of
you to stand by my side.
I won't let anyone disgrace
our holy ground with bloodshed.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
我很快就会召集
所有的高级牧师和女祭司。
我希望你们两人
能站在我身边。
我不会让任何人
用鲜血玷污我们的圣地。

scripts.text:
[Zhed]
As you command,
Your Eminence.
scripts.translation:
[泽德]
遵命，
圣座大人。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
{0}...
I appreciate all your work
on behalf of Arunafeltz.
My influence may still be
weak, but I'll do my best
with Zhed and Niren's support.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
{0}...
感谢你们为阿鲁纳菲兹
所做的一切。
我的影响力可能还很微弱，
但我会尽我所能，
在泽德和尼伦的支持下。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I would be expecting
too much to ask you to
stay by my side. But I'd like
to thank you for all you've
done. But if it is Freya's
will, we'll meet again...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
要求你们留在我身边
可能有些强人所难。但我还是想
感谢你们所做的一切。但如果这是
芙蕾雅女神的旨意，我们还会再见的...

scripts.text:
[Pope]
May Freya bless you...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
愿芙蕾雅保佑你...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe pope prayed in earnest
for you, and you feel a strong
aura of warmth and kindness
permeate your entire being.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF教皇为你虔诚地祈祷，
你感到一股强烈的温暖和善意
渗透了你的全身。^000000

scripts.text:
[Muff]
You're carrying way too
much stuff right now.
Come back after you put
your stuff in Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
你现在带的东西
实在太多了。
先把东西存到卡普拉仓库
再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
What th-?! Geez,
you didn't have to
scare me like that!
What is it that you want?
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
什-什么？！天哪，
你吓我一大跳！
你想干什么？

scripts.text: You look troubled.
scripts.translation: 你看起来很烦恼。

scripts.text: Nothing. Take care!
scripts.translation: 没什么。保重！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Oh. That's awfully
thoughtful of you.
I was thinking about
asking you for help,
but you don't look like
you could handle it. Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
哦。你真是
太体贴了。
我本来想找你帮忙，
但你看起来好像
应付不来。抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Well, I'm actually in
pretty big trouble.
I borrowed some money
from this loan shark
named ^0000FFBelder^000000 in Alberta.
It was a bad move!
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
其实，我遇到了
很大的麻烦。
我在艾尔贝塔向一个
叫^0000FF贝尔德^000000的高利贷者
借了钱。
这是个糟糕的决定！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
My business hasn't been
good, but I felt like I didn't
have a choice. I made enough
money to repay him now, but
then I lost my bond of debt.
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
我的生意一直不好，
但我感觉别无选择。我现在
有足够的钱还给他了，
但我弄丢了借据。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
When I asked Belder if
I could pay him back without
that bond, he insisted that
he didn't remember loaning
money to me. I bet he just
wants to keep my collateral!
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
当我问贝尔德
能不能不用那张借据
还钱时，他坚持说
他不记得借给我钱了。我敢打赌
他就是想吞掉我的抵押品！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
I knew that guy was shady!
Would you help me find my
lost bond of debt? You see,
the collateral I gave him
is really valuable to me.
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
我就知道那家伙不靠谱！
你能帮我找到
丢失的借据吗？你看，
我抵押给他的东西
对我来说非常有价值。

scripts.text: Do you know where you lost it?
scripts.translation: 你知道你把它丢在哪里了吗？

scripts.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Bye!
scripts.translation: 听到这个真遗憾。再见！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
If I knew where I lost
it, then it wouldn't be
lost now, would it? Well,
I remember going to a union
meeting, and I had a drink
or two. Okay, I had a lot.
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
要是我知道把它丢哪了，
它现在就不会丢了，对吧？
嗯，我记得我去参加了一个
工会会议，喝了两杯。
好吧，我喝了很多。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
On the way home,
I stumbled in a field
near Comodo... I remember
seeing some water... That
must be where I dropped my
wallet with the bond of debt.
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
回家的路上，
我在克魔岛附近的一片
田地里摔倒了... 我记得
看到了一些水... 那应该
就是我掉落钱包和借据的地方。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
If you can find my
wallet, I'll make sure
to repay you. Please
help me if you can!
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
如果你能找到我的钱包，
我一定会报答你的。
如果你能帮帮我，请帮帮我！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
H-hey! Where are you
going?! You can't just
leave me here! I need help!
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
嘿！你要去哪？！
你不能就这样丢下我！
我需要帮助！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
What, are you trying to
make me mad on purpose?
I get it. You're working for
Belder! I'm gonna get
my treasure from that
bastard, no matter what!
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
什么，你是故意想惹我生气吗？
我明白了。你是给贝尔德
工作的！不管发生什么，
我都要从那个混蛋手里
拿回我的宝物！

scripts.text: I don't understand.
scripts.translation: 我不明白。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, I was just kidding...
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我只是在开玩笑...

scripts.text:
[Muff]
You think you can
fool me?! Get lost!
I'm not telling you
anything, you snake!
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
你以为你能骗过我？！
滚开！
我不会告诉你任何事，
你这毒蛇！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
So you're not spying on
me for Belder? Well, then
why are you pestering me?
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
所以你不是在替贝尔德
监视我？那么，
你为什么还要纠缠我？

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Wait a second...
You're not as strong
as you were earlier.
You'd better train first
so you can be better
prepared to help me.
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
等一下...
你看起来不像刚才那么强了。
你最好先训练一下，
这样才能更好地帮助我。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Well, I'm actually in
pretty big trouble.
I borrowed some money
from this loan shark
named ^0000FFBelder^000000 in Alberta.
It was a bad move!
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
其实，我遇到了
很大的麻烦。
我在艾尔贝塔向一个
叫^0000FF贝尔德^000000的高利贷者
借了钱。
这是个糟糕的决定！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
My business hasn't been
good, but I felt like I didn't
have a choice. I made enough
money to repay him now, but
then I lost my bond of debt.
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
我的生意一直不好，
但我感觉别无选择。我现在
有足够的钱还给他了，
但我弄丢了借据。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
When I asked Belder if
I could pay him back without
that bond, he insisted that
he didn't remember loaning
money to me. I bet he just
wants to keep my collateral!
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
当我问贝尔德
能不能不用那张借据
还钱时，他坚持说
他不记得借给我钱了。我敢打赌
他就是想吞掉我的抵押品！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
I knew that guy was shady!
Would you help me find my
