lost bond of debt? You see,
the collateral I gave him
is really valuable to me.
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
我就知道那家伙不靠谱！
你能帮我找到
丢失的借据吗？你看，
我抵押给他的东西
对我来说非常有价值。

scripts.text: Do you know where you lost it?
scripts.translation: 你知道你把它丢在哪里了吗？

scripts.text: What was the collateral?
scripts.translation: 抵押品是什么？

scripts.text: Bye!
scripts.translation: 再见！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
If I knew where I lost
it, then it wouldn't be
lost now, would it? Well,
I remember going to a union
meeting, and I had a drink
or two. Okay, I had a lot.
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
要是我知道把它丢哪了，
它现在就不会丢了，对吧？
嗯，我记得我去参加了一个
工会会议，喝了两杯。
好吧，我喝了很多。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
I took this path in the
Papuchicha Forest to head
back home, and I must have
passed out near a river.
After that, my wallet with the
bond of debt was missing.
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
我走了普勒斯特森林的
这条路回家，
我一定是昏倒在河边了。
之后，我装有借据的钱包
就不见了。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
I don't care about the
other stuff in my wallet,
but I really need my bond
of debt to get my collateral
back from that Belder.
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
我不在乎钱包里的
其他东西，
但我真的需要我的借据，
才能从那个贝尔德手里
拿回我的抵押品。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Well, the collateral was
this huge, stunningly
beautiful jewel. It's really
precious to me. But well,
I don't want to tell you
more about it.
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
嗯，抵押品是一颗巨大的、
极其美丽的宝石。
它对我来说非常珍贵。
不过，我不想再告诉你
更多了。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
I understand if you don't
want to help me after
hearing that, but if you
change your mind, please
come talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
听到这些后如果你不想
帮我，我理解，
但如果你改变主意，
请再来找我谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
H-hey! Where are you
going?! You can't just
leave me here! I need help!
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
嘿！你要去哪？！
你不能就这样丢下我！
我需要帮助！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
You didn't leave to
look for my wallet yet?
I think it's somewhere
in the Papuchicha Forest.
Please find the bond of debt
inside as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
你还没去找我的钱包吗？
我想它在普勒斯特森林的
某个地方。
请尽快找到里面的借据。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is this wet, tattered
piece of paper the bond
of debt that you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这张湿透、破烂的纸
就是你需要的那张借据吗？

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Yes, that's it!
Ugh, but look at it...
It's ruined! You can't
even read what's written
on it! I need... I need
to fix this somehow!
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
是的，就是它！
唉，看看它...
它毁了！你甚至
都读不出上面写的字！
我需要... 我需要
想办法修复它！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you have any ideas?
I mean, if we dried the
paper, the letters would
still be faded, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你有什么主意吗？
我是说，如果我们把纸弄干，
字迹还是会褪色，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Muff]
I got it! There's this
famous inventor named
^FF0000Dorian^000000 in Izlude. I heard
he just invented something
like a Magic Dryer. Yeah,
that should work perfectly!
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
我想到了！依斯鲁得岛上
有位著名的发明家
^FF0000多里安^000000。
我听说他最近发明了一种
类似“魔法烘干机”的东西。
没错，那应该能完美解决问题！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
I don't know exactly
how it works, but it
should be able to restore
my bond of debt. I mean...
It's magic, right? Will you
ask Dorian to help me out?
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
我不太清楚它具体是怎么工作的，
但它应该能修复我的借据。
我是说...
这是魔法，对吧？
你能请多里安帮帮我吗？

scripts.text: Accept His Request
scripts.translation: 接受他的请求

scripts.text: Decline His Request
scripts.translation: 拒绝他的请求

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Thank you so much!
Please talk to Inventor
Dorian in Izlude, and ask
him to restore my bond of
debt. I'll be waiting for
you right here, okay?
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
太感谢你了！
请去依斯鲁得岛找发明家
多里安，让他修复我的借据。
我会在这里等你的，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Really? I was hoping
that you'd continue to
help me, but... Alright.
I'm sure you've got other
problems. If you change your
mind, though, just come back.
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
真的吗？我还以为
你会继续帮我的，但是...
好吧。
我相信你肯定有别的事情要忙。
不过如果你改变主意了，
随时都可以回来。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Oh, I knew you'd come
back and help me restore
my bond of debt! You look
too nice to just leave
me hanging like that.
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
哦，我就知道你会回来
帮我修复借据的！
你人太好了，不会就这样
丢下我不管的。

scripts.text: Accept His Request
scripts.translation: 接受他的请求

scripts.text: Decline His Request
scripts.translation: 拒绝他的请求

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Thank you so much!
Please talk to Inventor
Dorian in Izlude, and ask
him to restore my bond of
debt. I'll be waiting for
you right here, okay?
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
太感谢你了！
请去依斯鲁得岛找发明家
多里安，让他修复我的借据。
我会在这里等你的，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Really? I was hoping
that you'd continue to
help me, but... Alright.
I'm sure you've got other
problems. If you change your
mind, though, just come back.
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
真的吗？我还以为
你会继续帮我的，但是...
好吧。
我相信你肯定有别的事情要忙。
不过如果你改变主意了，
随时都可以回来。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Would you please visit
^FF0000Inventor Dorian^000000 in Izlude,
and ask him to use his
Magic Dryer to restore
my bond of debt?
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
请去依斯鲁得岛拜访
^FF0000发明家多里安^000000，
让他用他的魔法烘干机
修复我的借据，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Muff]
You're back! So how
did it go? I was getting
pretty anxious... So did
Dorian's Magic Dryer work?
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
你回来了！
情况怎么样？
我有点担心... 所以
多里安的魔法烘干机起作用了吗？

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Oh! It worked much better
than I expected! Belder
can't complain now! Haha!
You've done well, my friend.
Here, please take these as
a meager reward for your help.
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
哦！效果比我预期的好多了！
贝尔德现在没话可说了！哈哈！
你做得很好，我的朋友。
拿着，这是对你帮助的
一点微薄回报。

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Now that I have my bond
of debt, I should get my
jewel back from Belder.
He won't have any excuse
to keep my treasure now!
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
既然我拿回了借据，
我就应该从贝尔德那里
拿回我的宝石。
他现在没借口再扣着我的
宝物了！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
H-hey! Where's my
bond of debt?! Don't
tell me you lost it!
You'd better go back
to Dorian... Hopefully
you left it with him!
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
嘿！我的借据呢？！
别告诉我你把它弄丢了！
你最好回去找多里安...
希望你把它留在他那里了！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Yes! Finally, I'm
free of debt! I've got
my jewel back, business
is doing well... Life sure
is good right now. Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
是的！终于，我摆脱了债务！
我拿回了我的宝石，生意
也做得很好... 现在的生活
真不错。哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Muff]
Listen to me: never
take out a loan if you
can help it. And if you do,
borrow from someone
more reputable than...
Well, you know my story.
*Sigh*
scripts.translation:
[玛芙]
听我说：如果可能的话，
千万不要去借钱。
如果非要借，
就找比... 嗯，你知道我的故事。
*叹气*

scripts.text:
[Belder]
I ought to hire some
part-time promotional
workers... Some sexy
ladies ought to bring in
the customers by th--Oh!
Welcome to Belder Loans!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔德]
我应该雇一些兼职的
促销员... 一些性感的女士
应该能吸引大量顾客，然后——哦！
欢迎光临贝尔德贷款！

scripts.text: I'll promote your loans!
scripts.translation: 我来推广你的贷款！

scripts.text: Uh...

[Belder]
You? But you're a dude!
No sweaty, stinky, sleazy
man should be the image
of Belder Loans! We need
to exude trust, dependability,
and... And lady charms.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔德]
你？但你可是个男人！
汗流浃背、臭烘烘、油腻腻的男人
怎么能成为贝尔德贷款的形象代言人呢！
我们需要展现信任、可靠，
以及... 以及女性的魅力。

scripts.text:
[Belder]
You? Well, don't take
this the wrong way, but
all your curves? Wrong
places, honey. Later!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔德]
你？嗯，别误会，
但是你的曲线... 长错地方了，亲爱的。
再见！

scripts.text:
[Belder]
Hey, aren't you
interested in a loan?
Better you come to
me than you relying
on some guy that'll
try to rip you off!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔德]
嘿，你对贷款感兴趣吗？
来找我比找那些
想坑你一把的家伙好多了！

scripts.text:
[Belder]
Welcome! So, do you
need money fast? Belder
Loans get you the money
you need at low interest rates!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔德]
欢迎光临！需要快速筹钱吗？
贝尔德贷款能让您以低利率
获得所需的资金！

scripts.text: Ask About Muff
scripts.translation: 询问玛芙

scripts.text:
[Belder]
Muff? Oh! Is that
supposed to be a name?
I thought you meant--No.
Nope. Doesn't ring a bell.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔德]
玛芙？噢！
那是个名字吗？
我还以为你指的是——不。
不是。没听说过。

scripts.text:
[Belder]
Huh? Collateral?
Now why would I refuse
to take back his money
if I really loaned it to him?
Leave me alone now, this kind
of talk is bad for business!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔德]
哈？抵押品？
如果我确实借给了他钱，
为什么我会拒绝收回呢？
别烦我了，这种话题
对生意没好处！

scripts.text:
[Belder]
He really found his bond
of debt? Damn it--I mean,
what a surprise! That's,
uh, real good for him.
Now that I think of it, I did
loan a Muff money once.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔德]
他真的找到了
那张借据？该死——我是说，
真是意外！这，嗯，
对他来说挺好的。
仔细想想，我确实
曾借给一个叫玛芙的人钱。

scripts.text:
[Belder]
What's with that dirty look?
I've got nothing to hide!
Can't you see that I'm
the victim here? Me!
Just... Scram before you
make me more upset.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔德]
你那是什么眼神？
我没什么可隐瞒的！
难道看不出
我才是受害者吗？是我！
赶紧...滚开，别
让我更生气。

scripts.text:
[Belder]
Welcome! Did you need
money fa--Oh. Hey, it's
you again, the do-gooder.
Why don't you do me some
good, and go back where
you came from. Jerk.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔德]
欢迎光临！需要快——噢。
嘿，又是你，
那个多管闲事的人。
不如行行好，
回到你来的地方去。
混蛋。

scripts.text:
[Belder]
Cash flow problems?
Well, I'm your solution!
I offer unsecured loans
at an extremely low interest
rate, twenty-four hours a day!
Belder Loans is Alberta's best!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔德]
资金周转困难？
我就是你的解决方案！
我提供无抵押贷款，
利率极低，全天候24小时服务！
贝尔德贷款是艾尔贝塔最好的！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt looks like someone
dug a hole in the ground,
and then covered it again.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF看起来有人
在地上挖了个洞，
然后又填上了。^000000

scripts.text: Dig Up the Spot
scripts.translation: 挖掘这个地方

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There must be something
in the ground. I better
dig it up and check...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
地下肯定有什么东西。
我最好挖出来看看...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ergh...! Ugh!
This would be a lot
easier with a shovel!
Only a little more to go...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃...！唔！
如果有铲子会容易得多！
再挖一点就好了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hm? I hit something?
Let's--Yucky! It's so
wet and--Ugh! Nasty
little thing. Now what?
I dropped it! I have to
try to dig it up again...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯？我碰到什么东西了？
让我——好恶心！好湿——唔！
讨厌的小东西。现在怎么办？
我把它弄掉了！我得
再试着挖出来...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Something isn't quite
kosher about all this.
Nope, this time, I'm
not going to do this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这一切都有些不对劲。
不，这次，
我不打算这么做了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here we are... It's...
A soggy wallet? This
must be the one Muff
lost. Oh, and the bond
of debt is inside... Mm...
Ugh, it's really soaked...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在这里...这是...
一个湿透的钱包？这
一定是玛芙丢的那个。噢，
还有那张借据在里面...嗯...
唔，真的泡得很湿...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I've done all
I can for now. I should
bring this back to Muff.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我现在能做的
都做了。我应该
把这个还给玛芙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is the same spot
I dug up from before.
It's useless to me now!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是我之前挖过的地方。
现在对我没用了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh. There's a weird
bump in the ground. Well,
I can't just go looking at
anything that's slightly
out of the ordinary. Heh.
I'm not weird like that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哈。地上有个奇怪的
凸起。好吧，
我不能随便去查看
任何稍微有点异常的东西。嘿。
我没那么奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ugh, just like a member
of the working class:
hoarding all your items
like a packrat? Have the
decency to relocate your
goods to Kafra Storage, please.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
唉，就像
工人阶级的一员：
像囤积癖一样
把所有物品都堆在一起？
请有点体面，
把货物转移到卡普拉仓库吧。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
You must be in awe
of my elegant, artistic
touch. In my hands, almost
anything can become a
work of art... Even you~
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
你一定在惊叹
我优雅的艺术
触觉。在我手中，
几乎任何东西都能变成
艺术品...甚至是你~

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
I am Inventor Dorian,
and I welcome you to my
workship. All I create is
infused with art's essence~
So... How may I assist you?
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
我是发明家多里安，
欢迎来到我的工作船。
我所创造的一切，
都蕴含着艺术的精髓~
那么...有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: I want to use your Magic Dryer.
scripts.translation: 我想使用您的魔法烘干机。

scripts.text: I want to be your student.
scripts.translation: 我想拜您为师。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Magic Dryer? No, no, no.
That, my friend, is my
Mystic Heater de Elegance.
Don't disgrace my creation
like that. What, pray tell,
do you need to dry?
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
魔法烘干机？不不不。
朋友，那是我的
优雅神秘加热器。
请不要这样侮辱我的创作。
请问，您想烘干什么？

scripts.text: This Bond of Debt
scripts.translation: 这个债务契约

scripts.text: My Hair
scripts.translation: 我的头发

scripts.text: I'm just curious.
scripts.translation: 我只是好奇。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Mm? My masterpiece is far
too sophisticated for such
petty purposes, but... You
intrigue me. Show me this
''bond of debt'' you wish
to restore.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
嗯？我的杰作
太过精密，
不适合这种琐碎的用途，但是...
您引起了我的兴趣。
让我看看您想修复的
那个“债务契约”。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ah, now I understand.
This print is beyond
recognition. Only my creation
can restore the life that
nature has taken away! Yes...
You were right to come here.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
啊，我明白了。
这个印记已经
面目全非了。只有我的创作
才能恢复被自然夺走的生命力！是的...
您来这里是对的。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Allow me to explain how
the Mystic Dryer de Elegance
works. A glamourous ruby
engine whose design was born
of my genius, generates a
powerful magnetic field.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
请允许我解释一下
优雅神秘加热器的工作原理。
一颗华丽的红宝石引擎，
其设计源于我的天才，
能产生强大的磁场。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
The ruby engine's
magnetic field operates
according to the ^FF00003 Centrifuge
Wavelength Theory^000000. Now,
pearl inset sensors detect
the amount of calibration...
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
红宝石引擎的磁场
遵循^FF0000三离心波长理论^000000运作。现在，
珍珠镶嵌传感器检测
校准的量...

scripts.text: Zzz...
scripts.translation: 呼噜...

scripts.text: Oh, please!
scripts.translation: 拜托了！

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
You... You fell asleep?
But I was dutifully explaining
the machine's operation!
No, no, I won't hear your
excuses. What's that?
You were listening?
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
你...你睡着了？
但我可是尽职地
在讲解机器的运作原理！
不不，我不听你的借口。
什么？你在听？

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Hm. Well then, let me
ask you this: what is the
main theory by which the
Mystic Heater de Elegance
operates? Hmm? Well?
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
嗯。那么，让我
问你一个问题：
优雅神秘加热器
运作的主要理论是什么？
嗯？怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
That's right. My apologies.
I suppose I misjudged you.
Yes, the magnetic field can
restore the shape and integrity
of damaged, inanimate objects.
However, there is a problem.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
没错。抱歉。
看来我误判了您。
是的，磁场可以
恢复受损无生命物体的
形状和完整性。
但是，有一个问题。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
The ruby engine is broken,
and I've been too busy with
other projects as ordered by
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
I'll need your assistance
to fix the engine. Alright?
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
红宝石引擎坏了，
而我一直忙于
卢恩·米德加兹王国
指派的其他项目。
我需要您的帮助
来修复引擎。好吗？

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
If you help me fix the
Mystic Dryer de Elegance,
I'll allow you to use it
as much as you like. First,
I'd like you to gather all
of the repair materials.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
如果您帮我修复
优雅神秘加热器，
我会允许您
随意使用它。首先，
我想请您收集
所有的修复材料。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Please procure
^FF000020 Rusty Screws^000000,
^FF000010 Iron Ores^000000,
^FF00005 Steel^000000,
^FF00002 Rubies^000000, and
^FF000010 Red Gemstones^000000.

[Dorian]
Once you bring all the
repair materials, I'll
explain how you can
repair the Mystic
Dryer de Elegance.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
一旦您带齐所有
修复材料，我
就会向您解释
如何修复
优雅神秘加热器。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Oh? You sound dissatisfied
with my explanation. Well...
I surely can't let you use the
machine unless you fathom
how it works. Otherwise,
you just might break it.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
哦？听起来您对
我的讲解不太满意。好吧...
如果您不明白
它的运作原理，
我当然不能让您使用
这台机器。否则，
您可能会把它弄坏。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Were you too bored while
listening to me speak?
Ah! This wound! It's so...
Alas! It's too emotional!
I am seriously hurt!
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
您听我说话时
觉得太无聊了吗？
啊！这个伤口！真是...
唉！太让人动情了！
我深受打击！

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
How can you compare my
Mystic Dryer de Elegance
to a simple hair dryer?
Your comment offends me!
I'm no mere engineer...
I'm a true virtuoso!
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
您怎么能把我的
优雅神秘加热器
和普通的吹风机相提并论？
您的话冒犯了我！
我不只是个普通工程师...
我是真正的艺术家！

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Allow me to explain how
the Mystic Dryer de Elegance
works. A glamourous ruby
engine whose design was born
of my genius, generates a
powerful magnetic field.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
请允许我解释一下
优雅神秘加热器的工作原理。
一颗华丽的红宝石引擎，
其设计源于我的天才，
能产生强大的磁场。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
The ruby engine's
magnetic field operates
according to the ^FF00003 Centrifuge
Wavelength Theory^000000. Now,
pearl inset sensors detect
the amount of calibration...
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
红宝石引擎的磁场
遵循^FF0000三离心波长理论^000000运作。现在，
珍珠镶嵌传感器检测
校准的量...

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
I know, I know.
Astounding, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
我知道，我知道。
是不是很惊人？

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ah, my apologies.
Too many have asked, so
I now only accept beautiful
female students. Don't be
too disappointed: I know
you can find someone else.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
啊，抱歉。
因为询问的人太多，
我现在只招收
美丽的女学生。别太失望：
我知道您可以
去找别人。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Mademoiselle, it is my
honor to meet you: even
the moon covers its face,
and roses raise their thorns,
shameful of themselves
and jealous of your beauty.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
小姐，很荣幸
见到您：连月亮
都遮住了脸，
玫瑰也竖起了刺，
为您美丽的容貌
感到羞愧和嫉妒。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ah! But why go under the
pretense of being my student
when we can leisurely spend
time together as lovers?
Won't you--Mademoiselle?
Wait, where are you going?
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
啊！但为什么
要假装是我的学生，
而不是作为恋人
悠闲地共度时光呢？
您不会——小姐？
等等，您要去哪里？

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
I don't have enough
time for trivel, so
please leave me to my
artistic endeavors and
bother me no longer.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
我没有时间
闲聊，所以
请让我专心于
艺术创作，
不要再打扰我了。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ugh, your behavior
from before disgusts me...
But those pitiful eyes...
Seeking sympathy. Ah,
you're only human.
I shall forgive you.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
唉，您之前的
行为让我很反感...
但那双可怜的眼睛...
在寻求同情。啊，
您只是个人类。
我原谅您了。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Alright then. Please
listen carefully this time,
and don't insult my pride
again. When you are ready,
please come talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
好吧。请
这次仔细听好，
不要再冒犯我的自尊。
当您准备好了，
请再来找我对话。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ah, did you bring all
the materials I need to
repair the Mystic Dryer
de Elegance? Let me take
a glance at what you brought...
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
啊，您带齐了
我修复优雅神秘加热器
所需的材料吗？让我
看看您带了什么...

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ah, well done. Now
that the materials are
ready, I can instruct you on
how to repair the machine.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
啊，做得好。现在
材料都准备好了，
我可以指导您
如何修复这台机器。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
I expect you to fail
a few times, but the
Mystic Dryer de Elegance
is designed for durability:
even if you tried, you'd
have trouble scratching it.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
我预计您会
失败几次，但
优雅神秘加热器
的设计非常耐用：
即使您想，
也很难在它上面留下划痕。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
First, insert a new rough
ruby into the ruby engine,
and tighten the screw on
the joint until you hear
a ^0000FFclick^000000. You'll break it
if you tighten it further.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
首先，将一颗新的
红宝石原石插入红宝石引擎，
并拧紧关节处的螺丝，
直到听到
^0000FF咔哒^000000声。如果继续拧紧，
您会把它弄坏的。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Next you'll need to
operate the four switches
coded by the colors red,
blue, yellow, and green.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
接下来您需要
操作四个分别用
红、蓝、黄、绿
颜色编码的开关。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Press the ^0000FFRed^000000 switch
if the engine is in 1st
Gear. Press the ^0000FFBlue^000000
switch in 2nd Gear,
^0000FFYellow^000000 for 3rd, and
^0000FFGreen^000000 for 4th.

[Dorian]
The engine's sound is the
only indicator of which
gear is running. You'll
have to figure that out
on your own. I'm sorry
I designed it that way...
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
引擎的声音是
判断当前档位
的唯一指标。您
得自己弄清楚。抱歉
我把它设计成这样...

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ah, one last tip!
If you enter the correct
engine gear, the machine
will start without a problem,
even if you press the same
switch more than once.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
啊，最后一个小提示！
如果您输入了正确的
引擎档位，即使
多次按同一个开关，
机器也能正常启动。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Please let me know
if you get it started so
I can verify if the Mystic
Dryer de Elegance is fully
operational. Good luck now~
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
如果您成功启动了它，
请告诉我，这样我就能
验证“优雅神秘干燥机”
是否完全正常运行。
祝您好运~

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Oh? You're still missing
some materials. Well, we're
in no rush. If you already
forgot, then let me remind
you what you need to bring...
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
哦？您还缺少一些材料。
没关系，我们不着急。
如果您已经忘记了，
那就让我提醒您一下
您需要带什么...

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Please procure
^FF000020 Rusty Screws^000000,
^FF000010 Iron Ores^000000,
^FF00005 Steel^000000,
^FF00002 Rubies^000000, and
^FF000010 Red Gemstones^000000.

[Dorian]
Did you already forget
my instructions for fixing my
Mystic Dryer de Elegance?
I can't blame you since
they're a bit complicated.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
您已经忘记我关于
修理“优雅神秘干燥机”
的说明了吗？
考虑到步骤有点复杂，
我不怪您。

scripts.text: Instructions
scripts.translation: 查看说明

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
First, insert a new rough
ruby into the ruby engine,
and tighten the screw on
the joint until you hear
a ^0000FFclick^000000. You'll break it
if you tighten it further.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
首先，将一颗新的
红宝石原石插入红宝石引擎，
并拧紧关节处的螺丝，
直到听到
^0000FF咔哒^000000声。如果继续拧紧，
您会把它弄坏的。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Next you'll need to
operate the four switches
coded by the colors red,
blue, yellow, and green.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
接下来您需要
操作四个分别用
红、蓝、黄、绿
颜色编码的开关。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Press the ^0000FFRed^000000 switch
if the engine is in 1st
Gear. Press the ^0000FFBlue^000000
switch in 2nd Gear,
^0000FFYellow^000000 for 3rd, and
^0000FFGreen^000000 for 4th.

[Dorian]
The engine's sound is the
only indicator of which
gear is running. You'll
have to figure that out
on your own. I'm sorry
I designed it that way...
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
引擎的声音是
判断当前档位
的唯一指标。您
得自己弄清楚。抱歉
我把它设计成这样...

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ah, one last tip!
If you enter the correct
engine gear, the machine
will start without a problem,
even if you press the same
switch more than once.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
啊，最后一个小提示！
如果您输入了正确的
引擎档位，即使
多次按同一个开关，
机器也能正常启动。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Please let me know
if you get it started so
I can verify if the Mystic
Dryer de Elegance is fully
operational. Good luck now~
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
如果您成功启动了它，
请告诉我，这样我就能
验证“优雅神秘干燥机”
是否完全正常运行。
祝您好运~

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Really? It's no problem
for me to explain it again
to you. Don't be shy now:
not all of us can be geniuses~
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
真的吗？没问题，
我可以再向您解释一遍。
别害羞：
毕竟不是每个人都是天才~

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ah, so you failed to
fix the Mystic Dryer de
Elegance? That's expected:
I didn't really design it for the common user in mind. Well,
why don't you try it again?
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
啊，所以您没能
修好“优雅神秘干燥机”？
这是意料之中的：
我设计它时并没有
考虑到普通用户。那么，
您不妨再试一次？

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ah, I underestimated you.
You really repaired the
Mystic Dryer de Elegance~
This is a testament to my
incredible teaching prowess.
Congratulations are in order!
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
啊，我低估您了。
您真的修好了
“优雅神秘干燥机”~
这证明了我
惊人的教学能力。
恭喜您！

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Now all you have to do
is insert the damaged
document and press the
switch. Simple, yes?
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
现在您只需要
插入损坏的文件
并按下开关。
很简单，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Well, I'm afraid my
usefulness to you has
been all used up. Ah,
but I'll make sure to
contact you if I need
your kind of help. Farewell~
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
嗯，恐怕我对您的
用处已经用完了。啊，
但如果我需要
您这样的帮助，我会
联系您的。再见~

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ah, hello! How have
you been? Are you in need
of my artistic inventions?
Or did you just miss me?
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
啊，你好！
最近怎么样？您需要
我的艺术发明吗？
还是说您只是
想我了？

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Wh-what are you doing?
D-don't sully my wonderful
masterpieces with your
uncultured hands!
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
你...你在做什么？
别...别用你那
粗俗的手玷污
我精美的杰作！

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Can't you see that the
machine won't work without
the materials? Even a simple
child should understand that!
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
难道您看不出
没有材料机器
就无法工作吗？
连小孩子都应该明白！

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Ugh, just like a member
of the working class:
hoarding all your items
like a packrat? Have the
decency to relocate your
goods to Kafra Storage, please.
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
唉，就像
工人阶级的一员：
像囤积癖一样
把所有物品都堆在一起？
请有点体面，
把货物转移到卡普拉仓库吧。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis must be Dorian's
Mystic Dryer de Elegance.
What do you want to do?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这一定是多里安的
“优雅神秘干燥机”。
您想做什么？^000000

scripts.text: Check the Machine
scripts.translation: 检查机器

scripts.text: Replace the Engine
scripts.translation: 更换引擎

scripts.text: Tighten the Screw
scripts.translation: 拧紧螺丝

scripts.text: Press a Switch
scripts.translation: 按下开关

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's no power
in this behemoth
of a machine.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这台庞然大物
没有通电。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou replace the rough
ruby in the ruby engine
with a new rough ruby.
It clicks into place
inside the engine core.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF您用一颗新的红宝石原石
替换了红宝石引擎中的
红宝石原石。
它咔哒一声卡入
引擎核心。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe ruby in the
engine has already
been replaced.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF引擎中的红宝石
已经被替换过了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou probably need
to replace the ruby
in the engine first.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF您可能需要先
替换引擎中的红宝石。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Krrrr-Krrrrr*^000000
^3355FF*Krrrr-Krrrrr*^000000

^3355FF*Krrrr-Krrrrr*^000000
^0000FF*Click*^000000

^3355FF*Krrrr-Krrrrr*^000000
^3355FF*KrrICK-ICK-ICK-KOOM*^000000

^3355FFYou tightened the
screw too tightly!
The joint is broken...
You should go back
to Dorian for help.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF您把螺丝拧得太紧了！
连接处坏了...
您应该去找多里安帮忙。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFSomething must have
gone wrong. You'd be
better off starting
from the beginning...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF一定出了什么问题。
您最好从头开始...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou need to replace
the engine's ruby and
tighten the main screw
before you mess with
these switches.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在您摆弄这些开关之前，
您需要先替换引擎的红宝石
并拧紧主螺丝。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou need to tighten
the scren before you can
start the engine safely.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF您需要先拧紧螺丝，
才能安全地启动引擎。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe Mystic Dryer de
Elegance started with
a mighty buzz, and the
sound lowers to a calm
hum as it stabilizes.
It looks like you fixed it!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF神秘干燥器“优雅”
发出巨大的嗡嗡声启动，
随着稳定下来，
声音逐渐降低为平稳的嗡嗡声。
看起来您修好了它！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou should tell Dorian
first so that you can
use this machine.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF您应该先告诉多里安，
这样您才能使用这台机器。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Buzz Buzz*^000000
^3355FF*Buzz Buzz*^000000
^3355FFThe machine is
vibrating weakly.
Which switch do
you want to press?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*嗡嗡 嗡嗡*^000000
^3355FF*嗡嗡 嗡嗡*^000000
^3355FF机器在微弱地振动。
您想按下哪个开关？^000000

scripts.text: Red Switch
scripts.translation: 红色开关

scripts.text: Blue Switch
scripts.translation: 蓝色开关

scripts.text: Yellow Switch
scripts.translation: 黄色开关

scripts.text: Green Switch
scripts.translation: 绿色开关

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Whiz Whiz*^000000
^3355FF*Whiz Whiz*^000000

^3355FFThe machine made some
violent, erratic sounds,
and vibrated violently
before coming to a sudden
stop. That was the wrong
switch. You'd better ask Dorian...
scripts.translation:
^3355FF机器发出剧烈、不规则的声音，
并剧烈振动，
然后突然停止。那是错误的开关。
您最好问问多里安...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe machine's
vibrations have
grown stronger.
It looks like you
chose the right switch.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF机器的振动
变强了。
看起来您选对了开关。^000000

^3355FF*Whiz Whiz*^000000

Which switch will
you try now?^000000
scripts.translation:

^3355FF*呼噜 呼噜*^000000

您最好问问多里安...

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
It sounds like you're
done fixing my Mystic
Dryer de Elegance.
Why don't you come
back so I can explain
how you can use it?
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
听起来你已经修好了
我的“优雅神秘烘干机”。
不如回来吧，
我可以向你解释
如何使用它。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou lift the main
operational switch,
turning on a light and
opening a convenient
slot. You insert the
wet bond of debt.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你抬起主操作开关，
指示灯亮起，
一个便捷的插槽打开了。
你插入了湿漉漉的债务契约。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe engine's pistons
and cylinders churn
with a lively din, and
when the heater stops,
the slot reopens.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF引擎的活塞和气缸
发出活泼的轰鸣声，
当加热器停止时，
插槽再次打开。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So this is the original
bond of debt that Muff
lost? It looks... Perfect!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这就是玛芙丢失的
原始债务契约吗？
看起来...完美！

scripts.text:
You already used this
machine to restore the
bond of debt. There's no
need to mess around
with it any longer.
scripts.translation:
你已经使用这台机器
恢复了债务契约。
不需要再折腾它了。

scripts.text:
[Dorian]
Who are you?
Don't you dare lay
a hand on my precious
masterpiece inventions!
scripts.translation:
[多里安]
你是谁？
别碰我珍贵的
杰作发明！

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
You're carrying too much
stuff with you. Dump it
in Kafra Storge, sell it,
drop it, whatever, before
you come talk to me, okay?
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
你身上带的东西太多了。
在来找我之前，
把它们存进卡普拉仓库，
卖掉，扔掉，随便怎样，
好吗？

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Have you heard of the
Four Cursed Jewels?
I hear that one of them,
the Diamond of Destruction,
just appeared recently.
What I'd do to find it...
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
你听说过四颗诅咒宝石吗？
我听说其中一颗，
毁灭之钻，
最近刚刚出现。
我多希望能找到它...

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
{0}, right?
Don't be too suprised.
I've heard of you here
and there. Heh heh~!
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
{0}，对吧？
别太惊讶。
我在这里听说过你。
嘿嘿~！

scripts.text: How can I help you?
scripts.translation: 有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: What'd you hear?
scripts.translation: 你听到了什么？

scripts.text: Bye!
scripts.translation: 再见！

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
I wanted to ask you about
the Four Cursed Jewels.
All the merchants in the
area are talking about them.
Anyway, I was able to obtain
the Diamond of Destruction!
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
我想问问你关于
四颗诅咒宝石的事。
这一带的商人们
都在谈论它们。
总之，我获得了
毁灭之钻！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^666666Hmm... He might
be talking about that
jewel Muff gave to Belder
as collateral for his debt.^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(^666666嗯...他可能在说
玛芙抵押给贝尔德的
那颗宝石。^000000)

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
I paid a hefty sum for it,
but then I lost it after
just a few days. I kept it
under high security, but
that didn't stop the thief...
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
我花了大价钱买下它，
但几天后就丢了。
我把它放在高度安保的地方，
但这没能阻止那个盗贼...

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
It's a risky job, but
I want to employ you to
find where my diamond went.
It'd be best if you could get
it back, but I can understand
if you can't. You up for it?
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
这是一份危险的工作，
我想雇你去找
我的钻石去了哪里。
最好能把它找回来，
但如果找不到我也能理解。
你愿意吗？

scripts.text: Sure, I'll help you.
scripts.translation: 当然，我会帮你。

scripts.text: No, sorry.
scripts.translation: 不，抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Great! I knew it was
a good idea to find you.
The thief didn't leave any
clues, but he should have
some problems selling the gem.
It's one of a kind, you know.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
太好了！我就知道找你准没错。
那个盗贼没留下什么线索，
但他想卖掉那颗宝石应该会很难。
那可是独一无二的珍品啊。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Visiting the large
jewelry shops in the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom
would be a good start.
Their merchants know the
most about those jewels.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
去卢恩·米德加兹王国的大型珠宝店看看是个好主意。
那里的商人对宝石最了解。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
The thief will also have
to sell the jewel to a jeweler
that can afford astronomical
prices. There are three big
locations you should check.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
那个盗贼还得找一家出得起天价的珠宝商才行。
你应该去查查这三个地方。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Find ^0000FFJhonnita^000000 in Alberta,
^0000FFKimeunbang^000000 in Payon, and
^0000FFLeblo^000000 in Geffen. They wanted 
that diamond badly too, so
they'll remember if they
heard any clues about it.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
去艾尔贝塔找^0000FF琼妮塔^000000，
斐扬找^0000FF金恩邦^000000，
吉芬找^0000FF勒布罗^000000。他们也想要那颗钻石，
所以如果听到关于它的线索，
他们肯定记得。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Please don't let them
know I've hired you to
investigate that diamond.
They won't speak to you
if they figure out that
I've sent you to them.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
请不要让他们知道是我雇你
去调查那颗钻石的。
如果他们发现是我派你来的，
就不会跟你对话了。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Well, I'll be right
here. I hope you come
back with some good news.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
嗯，我就在这里等着。
希望你能带回好消息。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Really? I went through
a lot of trouble to find
you, but... I understand.
If you have a change of
heart, I'll be willing to
hire you for your expertise.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
真的吗？我费了好大劲才找到你，
不过...我理解。
如果你改变主意了，
我很乐意因为你的专长而雇佣你。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
So it's true...
People say you're
just a Novice, but
you still help them
out with their problems.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
原来是真的...
人们都说你只是个初心者，
但你还是帮他们解决了麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
I've got a few buddies
in the Swordman Association.
They dropped your name when
I mentioned I was looking
for someone smart and strong.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
我在剑士协会有几个朋友。
当我提到我在找一个既聪明又强壮的人时，
他们提到了你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Heh, so you really
are one of those holy
knights. I'm glad to
have met you for myself.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
嘿，看来你真的是那种神圣的骑士。
很高兴能亲自见到你。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
I didn't think a member
of the clergy would be so
strong, but you know, your
reputation precedes you.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
我没想到神职人员会这么强，
不过你知道的，你的名声早已传开了。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Hey, if I didn't know
your name, how could I call
myself a Merchant? You set
an example for us all~
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
嘿，如果我不知道你的名字，
我怎么能自称是商人呢？你为我们所有人树立了榜样~

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
We have a mutual friend,
you know that? Aragham
really spoke highly of you.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
我们有个共同的朋友，你知道吗？
阿拉甘对你的评价非常高。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
I know a guy who knows
a guy in the Alchemist Guild.
Around their parts, it sounds
like you're pretty hot stuff.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
我认识一个认识炼金术士公会的人。
在他们那边，听说你相当厉害。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Magic is totally beyond
my understanding, but
if it gets the job done,
it can't be all bad.
I hear you're really
good at that stuff.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
魔法完全超出了我的理解范围，
但如果它能解决问题，
那也不全是坏事。
听说你在这方面真的很擅长。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Heh, it sounds like almost
anyone who's anyone in
Morocc knows who you are.
Pleasure to make your
acquaintance~
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
嘿，听起来摩洛克几乎每个有名有姓的人
都知道你是谁。
很高兴认识你~

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Anyone who's used
a bow seems to drop
your name when it comes
to accuracy and heroism.
Hard to believe that I'm
actually talking to you~
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
任何用过弓的人，
在谈到精准和英勇时都会提到你的名字。
很难相信我真的在和你说话~

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Is it really true?
I hear you sing
like an angel...
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
是真的吗？
听说你唱歌像天使一样...

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Is it really true?
I hear you dance
like the devil...
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
是真的吗？
听说你跳舞像魔鬼一样...

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Me and your old master,
Phoenix, we go way back.
He had nothing but pride
when he talked about you~
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
我和你以前的师父，
凤凰，我们渊源颇深。
他谈到你时总是充满自豪~

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
I heard your name from
this spiritual message
I got from a dream. That
doesn't sound crazy to
you, does it?
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
我从一个梦中的灵验信息里听到了你的名字。
这听起来不疯狂吧？

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Aren't you the least
bit curious how I know
about you? Wait, come back!
I'm not really that suspicious!
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
你难道一点都不好奇我是怎么知道你的吗？
等等，回来！
我没那么可疑！

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Find ^0000FFJhonnita^000000 in Alberta,
^0000FFKimeunbang^000000 in Payon, and
^0000FFLeblo^000000 in Geffen. They wanted 
that diamond badly too, so
they'll remember if they
heard any clues about it.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
去艾尔贝塔找^0000FF琼妮塔^000000，
斐扬找^0000FF金恩邦^000000，
吉芬找^0000FF勒布罗^000000。他们也想要那颗钻石，
所以如果听到关于它的线索，
他们肯定记得。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Please don't let them
know I've hired you to
investigate that diamond.
They won't speak to you
if they figure out that
I've sent you to them.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
请不要让他们知道是我雇你
去调查那颗钻石的。
如果他们发现是我派你来的，
就不会跟你对话了。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Are you still investigating
the diamond's whereabouts?
Well, I hope you can bring
me back good news soon.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
你还在调查钻石的下落吗？
希望你能尽快带给我好消息。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Oh, you're back.
Made any headway in
your investigation of the
Diamond of Destruction?
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
哦，你回来了。
调查“毁灭之钻”有什么进展吗？

scripts.text: Explain What You Learned
scripts.translation: 解释你了解到的情况

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
What?! The Z Gang stole
my diamond? No wonder!
I bet they wanted to use its
curse for something evil.
How about the jewel?
Did you retrieve it?
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
什么？！Z集团偷了我的钻石？
难怪了！
我敢打赌他们想利用它的诅咒做坏事。
宝石呢？
你拿回来了吗？

scripts.text: Give Diamond of Destruction
scripts.translation: 交出毁灭之钻

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Oh! Great! So it was
in the Z Gang's hideout?
Wow, even after hearing so
much about you, you still
exceeded my expectations!
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
哦！太好了！
原来是在Z集团的秘密基地？
哇，即使听过那么多关于你的传闻，
你依然超出了我的预期！

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Thank God, I finally
have this back! Ah, and
as for your payment...
Well, I don't know if
it's enough for what you
did, but I hope you like it.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
谢天谢地，我终于把它拿回来了！
啊，至于报酬...
我不知道这是否配得上你做的事，
但希望你能喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Now that I have the
Diamond of Destruction
again, I can research
more about its strange
properties. I'll contact you
again if I need your help.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
既然我重新拥有了“毁灭之钻”，
我可以进一步研究它奇特的属性。
如果需要你的帮助，我会再联系你。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Ah, I hear from a friend
in Morocc that you happened
to obtain the Unlucky Emerald.
I'm sure it's one of the Four
Cursed Jewels. You wouldn't
mind if I look at it, do you?
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
啊，我听说你在摩洛克偶然获得了“异样的绿宝石”。
我确信它是四颗诅咒宝石之一。
你不介意我看看它，对吧？

scripts.text: No!
scripts.translation: 不！

scripts.text: Sure, why not?
scripts.translation: 当然，为什么不呢？

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
No? Well, I'm sure you
have your reasons. Still,
maybe I can learn something
that would benefit both of
us if I examined it.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
不？好吧，我相信你有你的理由。
不过，如果我研究一下，
也许能学到一些对双方都有益的东西。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Ah, I appreciate it!
Now, let's see here...
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
啊，谢谢！
那么，让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Yes, judging from its
characteristic shape, this
is the cursed emerald.
Like me, you now possess
one of the Four Cursed Jewels.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
是的，从它独特的形状来看，
这就是那颗被诅咒的绿宝石。
像我一样，你现在也拥有了一颗四颗诅咒宝石之一。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Hm? Did you happen to
misplace your emerald?
I mean, it's not with you...
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
嗯？你难道把绿宝石弄丢了？
我是说，它不在你身上...

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Tell me, what were
you planning to do with
the Unlucky Emerald?
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
告诉我，
你打算怎么处理那颗“异样的绿宝石”？

scripts.text: I'm going to sell it.
scripts.translation: 我打算卖掉它

scripts.text: I'm going to study it.
scripts.translation: 我打算研究它

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Oh, you weren't going
to keep it? I wish I could
afford to buy it from you...
But I've had enough trouble
buying the Diamond of
Destruction.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
哦，你不打算留着它？
我真希望能买得起它...
但我买“毁灭之钻”已经花了不少钱。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
You already met several
renown jewelers while
you were looking for the
dimaond. Why don't you ask
them if they'll buy that
Unlucky Emerald from you?
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
你在寻找钻石的时候，
已经见过几位著名的珠宝商了。
为什么不问问他们愿不愿意从你这里买下那颗“异样的绿宝石”呢？

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Ah, I applaud your
thirst for knowledge,
your quest to seek truth.
If you really want an expert
to look at the emerald, talk
to this scholar in Comodo.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
啊，我赞赏你对知识的渴望，
以及你追求真理的决心。
如果你真的想请专家鉴定那颗绿宝石，
去克魔岛找那位学者谈谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
This man is an antique
appraiser, an specialist in
ancient artifacts and treasure.
I highly recommend consulting
him since he's been invaluable
in my own jewel research.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
这位先生是古董鉴定师，
专门研究古代文物和珍宝。
我强烈推荐你咨询他，
因为他在我的宝石研究中帮了大忙。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
I heard that you obtained
the Unlucky Emerald from
a friend in Morocc. Let me
warn you that you might not
be strong enough to handle
its power. Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
我听说你从摩洛哥的朋友那里
得到了“异样的绿宝石”。
我要提醒你，你可能还不足以
驾驭它的力量。小心一点。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
If you're not wary,
its curse might destroy
you. Understand?
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
如果你不警惕，
它的诅咒可能会毁灭你。
明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Thank you for all
you've done for me. I'll
continue my research in the
cursed jewel's powers, and
I'll contact you if I need your
help again. Take care~
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
感谢你所做的一切。
我会继续研究这颗被诅咒宝石的力量，
如果还需要你的帮助，我会联系你的。
保重~

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
I don't have the funds
to buy your emerald at
a fair price, but why don't
you ask the other jewelers?
They might be interested
in buying your jewel.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
我没有足够的资金
以合理的价格买下你的绿宝石，
但你可以问问其他珠宝商。
他们可能会对购买你的宝石感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Ah, you're back~
So were you able to
sell the Unlucky Emerald?
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
啊，你回来了~
那么，你卖掉“异样的绿宝石”了吗？

scripts.text: Everyone seems scared!
scripts.translation: 大家都好害怕！

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Ah, I see now. They
must be too afraid of
that particular jewel's
curse. Huh. Weird.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
啊，我明白了。
他们一定是太害怕那颗宝石的诅咒了。
嗯。真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
I guess the Diamond of
Destruction is considered
pretty safe since it's been
around for a while without
any strange incidents.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
我想“毁灭之钻”应该算是比较安全的，
因为它已经存在一段时间了，
而且没有发生过任何奇怪的事件。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
You just dug up the
emerald? I suppose it
might be too soon to sell it.
Not too many people will
test their luck with that gem,
now that I think about it.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
你刚挖出这颗绿宝石？
我想现在卖掉可能还为时过早。
仔细想想，
现在没多少人愿意拿自己的运气去赌那颗宝石。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Ah, here's an idea.
Why don't you ask my
scholar friend in Comodo
to examine it? Maybe you
can learn more about the
emerald's so-called curse.
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
啊，我有个主意。
为什么不请我在克魔岛的学者朋友
来鉴定一下呢？
也许你能了解更多关于
那颗绿宝石所谓诅咒的事情。

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
I'll go ahead and send
him a message ahead of
time so that he'll know to
expect your arrival, okay?
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
我会先给他发个消息，
让他知道你要来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Why don't you visit my
scholar friend in Comodo,
and ask him to examine your
Unlucky Emerald? The more
you learn about that so-called
curse, the better. Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
为什么不去拜访我在克魔岛的学者朋友，
请他鉴定一下你的“异样的绿宝石”呢？
你越了解那个所谓的诅咒，对你越有利。
祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Oh, so what have you
learned about the Unlucky
Emerald so far? Hmmm. Yes,
very intriguing. Good luck
with your research efforts~
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
哦，那你目前对“异样的绿宝石”
了解了多少呢？嗯嗯。
是的，非常引人入胜。
祝你的研究工作顺利~

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Have you heard of
the Four Cursed Jewels?
I wish to retrieve my
Diamond of Destruction,
but whoever has it has
kept it well hidden...
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
你听说过“四颗被诅咒的宝石”吗？
我想找回我的“毁灭之钻”，
但持有它的人把它藏得很严实...

scripts.text:
[Ibrahim]
Psst, adventurer!
You're {0}, right?
There's something
I'd like to discuss
with you in private!
scripts.translation:
[易卜拉欣]
嘘，冒险者！
你是{0}，对吧？
我有件事想私下和你谈谈！

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
Oh, it's always nice
to see a new face~
So were you interested
in selling or buying
a jewel? We only carry
the best. Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[琼妮塔]
哦，总是很高兴见到新面孔~
那么，你是想卖还是想买宝石？
我们这里只有最好的。哈哈哈！

scripts.text: What's the most popular jewel?
scripts.translation: 最流行的宝石是什么？

scripts.text: Do you know Diamond of Destruction?
scripts.translation: 你知道“毁灭之钻”吗？

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
Ah, take a look at this
lustrous ruby. Isn't it
just breathtaking? It can
be yours for the specially
discounted price of just
1,000,000 zeny!
scripts.translation:
[琼妮塔]
啊，看看这颗光彩夺目的红宝石。
是不是美得令人窒息？
现在特价只要1,000,000 Zeny！

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
Wait, where are you--?
Damn, I shouldn't have
marked it up so much.
Rookie mistake, rookie
mistake! I'm a professional!
scripts.translation:
[琼妮塔]
等等，你要去哪——？
该死，我不该把价格标得这么高。
新手失误，新手失误！我可是专业人士！

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
Diamond of Destruction?
Heh heh! A rookie like you
wouldn't appreciate its true
value. I wanted it so badly,
but that Ibrahim was much
luckier that I was...
scripts.translation:
[琼妮塔]
毁灭之钻？
嘿嘿！像你这样的新手，
根本不懂它真正的价值。
我本来非常想要它，
但那个易卜拉欣运气比我好多了...

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
It makes me so upset to
think about how I lost to
him. All the big jewelers
are trying to snatch up
the Four Cursed Jewels...
But only one showed up so far.
scripts.translation:
[琼妮塔]
一想到输给他，我就很生气。
所有大珠宝商都在争抢
四颗被诅咒的宝石...
但到目前为止只出现了一颗。

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
Hey. You look familiar.
You're not one of my
regulars, are you?
No, couldn't be.
You're not dressed
richly enough. No offense.
scripts.translation:
[琼妮塔]
嘿。你看起来很面熟。
你不是我的常客吧？
不，不可能。
你穿得不够华丽。别介意啊。

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
So you here to sell
any Garlets, or did you
come to spend your life
savings on my jewels?
scripts.translation:
[琼妮塔]
所以你是来卖加勒结晶，
还是想把毕生积蓄
花在我的宝石上？

scripts.text: Show me some jewels...
scripts.translation: 给我看看宝石...

scripts.text: I have a rare emerald to sell...
scripts.translation: 我有一颗稀有祖母绿要卖...

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
It couldn't hurt to
show you my wares, but...
I doubt you can afford them.
Jewels aren't cheap, you know?
scripts.translation:
[琼妮塔]
给你看看我的货也无妨，但是...
我怀疑你买不起。
宝石可不便宜，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
Oh, I get it now. You want
to give one as a present to
some woman. Isn't that typical?
Can't you come up with a more
creative way to buy some
woman's love? Huh?
scripts.translation:
[琼妮塔]
哦，我明白了。你想买一个
送给某个女人当礼物。真典型。
你就不能想点更有创意的
方式去讨好女人吗？哼？

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
Sorry, sweetheart, but
I have a strict ''no window
shopping'' policy.
scripts.translation:
[琼妮塔]
抱歉，亲爱的，
但我有严格的“禁止只看不买”政策。

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
Rare emerald, eh?
It better not be something
like a Garlet or a Zargon!
Sometimes you guys make
that kind of mistake.
Okay, let's see...
scripts.translation:
[琼妮塔]
稀有祖母绿，是吗？
希望它不是加勒结晶或刹勒空结晶！
你们有时候会犯这种错误。
好吧，让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
......
Umm...

[Jhonnita]
...........................Um.
It's an incredibly nice
emerald, but I can't take
this off your hands. Er,
would you be on your way?
scripts.translation:
[琼妮塔]
...........................嗯。
这是一颗非常漂亮的祖母绿，
但我不能从你手里收下它。呃，
你可以走了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh? But why?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么？但为什么？

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
J-just get out of my
shop! Go... Go to Payon
and talk to Kimeunbang!
Y-yeah, and don't come back!
scripts.translation:
[琼妮塔]
快...快离开我的店！
去...去斐扬找金恩邦！
对，别再回来了！

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
What'd I tell you, huh?
I don't want you here
in my shop anymore!
scripts.translation:
[琼妮塔]
我刚才怎么说的？
我不希望你再出现在我的店里！

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
Look, I'll level with you.
Rumors spread fast amongst
us jewelers. Nobody will get
near you if they know you
have that jewel. You get it
now? Please... Stay back...
scripts.translation:
[琼妮塔]
听着，我跟你说实话。
消息在珠宝商之间传得很快。
如果别人知道你有那颗宝石，
没人敢靠近你。你懂了吗？
拜托...离远点...

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
I don't want anything
to do with your weird
emerald or with you.
Aren't you leaving
already? Go away!
scripts.translation:
[琼妮塔]
我不想跟你的奇怪祖母绿
或者跟你有任何关系。
你还不走吗？快滚！

scripts.text:
[Jhonnita]
Are you here to buy or
sell any jewels? I always
buy high and sell low.
Come to me for all of
your gem related needs~
scripts.translation:
[琼妮塔]
你是来买还是卖宝石？
我向来高买低卖。
所有宝石相关的需求都来找我~

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
Zzzz... Huh?
Why'd you wake me?
Such a good dream too.
Go to another jewelry shop,
I don't feel like opening up.
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
呼噜噜...啊？
你把我吵醒了？
我刚才正做着美梦呢。
去别家珠宝店吧，
我现在不想开门。

scripts.text: What's wrong?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？

scripts.text: Diamond of Destruction?
scripts.translation: 毁灭之钻？

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
I'm just disappointed.
I was so close to getting
that Diamond of Destruction.
So close! Belder, my business
partner, actually snatched
it up from some poor sap.
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
真是令人失望。
我本来都快拿到那颗毁灭之钻了。
就差一点！贝尔德，我的生意伙伴，竟然从某个倒霉蛋手里把它抢走了。

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
Somehow, Belder ended up
returning the jewel. I was
going to buy the jewel from
the original owner, but then
this upstart jeweler got to
it before I could. Damn it!
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
不知怎的，贝尔德最后又把宝石还了回去。我本来打算从原主人手里买下它，结果被那个不知天高地厚的珠宝商抢先一步。真是可恶！

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
This was a monumental
failure. I haven't been
able to sleep, I don't want
to work. Ugh. Well, thanks
for letting me get that off
my chest. I feel a bit better.
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
这是一次巨大的失败。我睡不着觉，也不想工作。唉。不过，谢谢你听我发牢骚。我现在感觉好多了。

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
Here, take this as
a little gift. Not all of us
jewelers are as greedy
as you think we are. Heh.
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
拿着，这是给你的小礼物。并不是我们所有珠宝商都像你想的那样贪婪。嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
Oh! That diamond is the
very reason for my agony!
I was so close to getting it...
But then someone got to the
diamond before I did. Argh!
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
哦！那颗钻石正是让我痛苦的原因！
我本来都快拿到它了...
结果有人比我先一步得到了它。啊！

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
I don't feel like opening
my shop any time soon, but
you can always come back later.
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
我最近都不打算开门营业了，
不过你以后随时可以再来。

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
Oh, hello. Looks like
I'm back in business~
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
哦，你好。看来我又重新开张了~

scripts.text: I have a jewel to sell.
scripts.translation: 我有宝石要卖

scripts.text: How are you?
scripts.translation: 你好吗？

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
Really? Alright, just
give me a minute to
appraise your gem.
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
真的吗？好的，请稍等，
让我鉴定一下你的宝石。

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
I'm sorry, but I just
can't buy this emerald.
It's... It's too big of
a risk. The rumors I keep
hearing, they're just horrible.
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
抱歉，但我不能买这颗祖母绿。
这...这风险太大了。我听到的那些传闻，简直太可怕了。

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
Hm? Where's this
jewel you were talking
about? Did you forget
to bring it with you?
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
嗯？你刚才说的那颗宝石在哪里？
你忘记带在身上了吗？

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
I don't even feel like
talking about my business.
I've been considering closing
up shop for good, actually.
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
我甚至都不想谈生意了。
实际上，我一直在考虑彻底关店。

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
No jeweler around will
buy that cursed emerald.
I'm really sorry. You can
try talking to Ibrahim, though.
He's the one that got that
Diamond of Destruction.
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
周围的珠宝商没人敢买那颗被诅咒的祖母绿。
真的很抱歉。不过你可以去找易卜拉欣。
就是他拿到了那颗毁灭之钻。

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
Ugh... The stress
of the jewel business
is finally getting to me.
Oh well, I've had a good run...
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
唉...珠宝生意的压力终于让我吃不消了。
算了，我也算尽力了...

scripts.text:
[Kimeunbang]
I don't feel like opening
my shop any time soon, but
you can always come back later.
scripts.translation:
[金恩邦]
我最近都不打算开门营业了，
不过你以后随时可以再来。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Oh, I've heard about
you. You're the one that's
been asking questions about
the Diamond of Destruction.
scripts.translation:
[勒布罗]
哦，我听说过你。你就是那个一直在打听毁灭之钻的人。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Don't be so suprised:
word travels fast in the
jewel industry. Well, if you
want to learn more, you'll
have to do something for
me first. We have a deal?
scripts.translation:
[勒布罗]
别这么惊讶：消息在珠宝行业传得很快。好吧，如果你想了解更多，得先帮我做点事。我们成交吗？

scripts.text: Deal.
scripts.translation: 成交。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
I've been suffering back
pain lately, and none of
the medicines do any good.
I resorted to seeing this
famous doctor in Payon, but
then I totally screwed it up.
scripts.translation:
[勒布罗]
我最近一直背痛，
吃了不少药都没用。
我只好去找斐扬那位名医，
结果却把事情搞砸了。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
She was such a nag, and
I said something... unpleasant
to her. Now she refuses to
examine me! But if I sent
you, then you could get
some medicine for me.
scripts.translation:
[勒布罗]
她是个爱唠叨的人，
我说了些...不礼貌的话。
现在她拒绝给我看病！
但如果你去的话，
应该能帮我拿到药。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
She knows my symptoms
so if you make her happy,
she'll give you my medicine...
I hope. Anyway, her name is
^0000FFWola^000000, and she's in Payon.
scripts.translation:
[勒布罗]
她知道我的症状，
只要你让她高兴，
她就会把药给你...
我想吧。总之，她叫
^0000FF沃拉^000000，在斐扬。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Oh, yeah? Well, that's
fine with me. I don't
have anything to lose.
scripts.translation:
[勒布罗]
哦，是吗？
那对我来说正合适。
反正我也没什么可失去的。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Please look for a female
doctor named ^0000FFWola^000000 in Payon.
Do what you can to get my
medicine from her... Oh,
and try to be nice~
scripts.translation:
[勒布罗]
请去斐扬找一位名叫
^0000FF沃拉^000000的女医生。
尽量帮我从她那里拿到药...
哦，还有，态度好点~

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Oh? Is that... Is that my
medicine? Thank goodness!
 Hm? Oh, so I misunderstood
 her. I thought she was awfully
 arrogant, but she was just
 concerned for my health.
scripts.translation:
[勒布罗]
哦？那是...那是我的药？
谢天谢地！
嗯？哦，原来是我误会她了。
我以为她很傲慢，
其实她只是关心我的健康。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
I better make it a point
to properly apologize to
her the next time I see her.
scripts.translation:
[勒布罗]
下次见到她，
我一定要好好向她道歉。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Right, I need to tell
you about the Diamond of
Destruction. Listen carefully.
A while ago, a young couple
tried to sell me that very
jewel. Suspicious, eh?
scripts.translation:
[勒布罗]
对了，我得告诉你
关于毁灭之钻的事。
仔细听好。
不久前，一对年轻情侣
试图把那枚宝石卖给我。
很可疑，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
I had no interest in
buying it, so I actually
offered them a much lower
price than they hoped.
Now that I think about it...
scripts.translation:
[勒布罗]
我对买它没兴趣，
所以我出的价比他们期望的
低得多。
现在回想起来...

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
That man and woman looked
like the members of that
infamous Z Gang. Heh!
I should have reported it,
but... You know. Back
pain and all that.
scripts.translation:
[勒布罗]
那对男女看起来像是
那个臭名昭著的Z帮的成员。
嘿！
我本该举报他们的，
但是...你知道的。
背痛什么的。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
I hear the Rogue Guild
is secretly investigating
the Z Gang, so that couple
must have plenty of enemies.
So... Yeah. The Z Gang has
the Diamond of Destruction.
scripts.translation:
[勒布罗]
听说流氓公会
正在秘密调查Z帮，
所以那对情侣肯定有很多敌人。
所以...是的。Z帮拥有
毁灭之钻。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
You should talk with one
of the investigators of the
Rogue Guild if you want to
learn more about the Z Gang.
Pretty useful info, huh?
Take care, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[勒布罗]
如果你想了解更多关于Z帮的事，
应该去和流氓公会的
调查员谈谈。
很有用的信息，对吧？
保重，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
You should talk with one
of the investigators of the
Rogue Guild if you want to
learn more about the Z Gang.
Pretty useful info, huh?
Take care, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[勒布罗]
如果你想了解更多关于Z帮的事，
应该去和流氓公会的
调查员谈谈。
很有用的信息，对吧？
保重，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Hm? I'm sorry, but
I'm pretty busy with
all my other customers.
Besides, you don't strike
me as a jewel seller or
buyer. Please excuse me...
scripts.translation:
[勒布罗]
嗯？抱歉，
我忙着接待其他顾客。
而且，你看起来不像
是卖珠宝或买珠宝的人。
请原谅我...

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Oh, hey. Did you
have any business
with me today?
scripts.translation:
[勒布罗]
哦，嘿。你今天
有什么事找我吗？

scripts.text: I have a jewel to sell.
scripts.translation: 我有宝石要卖

scripts.text: No, not really.
scripts.translation: 不，不是。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Oh, yeah? Well then,
I'm curious now. You
mind if I take a look?
scripts.translation:
[勒布罗]
哦，是吗？那太好了，
我现在很好奇。
介意我看一眼吗？

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Now, what do we ha--
Oh. I'm sorry, but I just
can't buy this. I hate to
break it to you, but I hear
that thing has an awful curse.
See what you can do about that!
scripts.translation:
[勒布罗]
那么，我们看看这是什--
哦。抱歉，但我就是
不能买这个。真不想告诉你，
但我听说这东西有可怕的诅咒。
你自己想办法吧！

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Hmm. The jewel
you were just
talking about...
Did you remember
to bring it with you?
scripts.translation:
[勒布罗]
嗯。你刚才提到的
那枚宝石...
你记得带它来了吗？

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Oh, yeah? Well, that's
fine too. No skin off
my nose, that's what
I always say.
scripts.translation:
[勒布罗]
哦，是吗？那也好。
对我没什么损失，
我一直是这么说的。

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Oh. I'm sorry, but I just
can't buy this. I hate to
break it to you, but I hear
that thing has an awful curse.
See what you can do about that!
scripts.translation:
[勒布罗]
哦。抱歉，但我就是
不能买这个。真不想告诉你，
但我听说这东西有可怕的诅咒。
你自己想办法吧！

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
I'm sorry that you're
the one that currently
has that jewel. Hopefully,
the curse is just a rumor...
But, well, I didn't get this
old by taking chances...
scripts.translation:
[勒布罗]
真抱歉，现在持有那枚宝石的人是你。
希望那个诅咒只是谣言...
不过，我活了这么久，可不是靠冒险活下来的...

scripts.text:
[Leblo]
Hello, are you interested
in buying or selling any
precious jewels?
scripts.translation:
[勒布罗]
你好，你想买或卖什么宝石吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务
将部分物品存入仓库，
然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello? I'm here to
see Doctor Wola.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好？我来找沃拉医生。

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Oh... Ah... Um...

[{0}]
Excuse me, but do you
know where I can find her?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下，你知道我在哪里能找到她吗？

scripts.text:
[Wola]
I, um...
Oh no! Wah!
See what you did?!
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
我，嗯...
哎呀！哇！
你看你干的好事！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I... I don't know
what you're talking
about. I'm just wanted
to talk to Doctor Wola.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我...我不知道你在说什么。
我只是想见沃拉医生。

scripts.text:
[Wola]
I'm Doctor Wola!
And look! You made me
drop the herbal medicine
I was brewing! The pot
is all broken now...
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
我就是沃拉医生！
你看！你让我把正在熬制的汉方药材洒出来了！
锅全碎了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh? Oh, I'm...
I'm really sorry.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊？哦，我...
真的很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Wola]
That's... That's
quite alright. It's
my fault, really.
Waaah~! My pot!
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
那...那没关系。
其实是我的错。
哇啊~！我的锅！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry, I don't know
what's going on exactly.
Was that pot expensive?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，我不太清楚发生了什么。
那个锅很贵吗？

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Oh, I'm acting stupid
again! I don't have time
to cry over a broken pot!
I need to check my hands
for any cuts! If they're
hurt, I can't help anyone!
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
哎呀，我又犯傻了！
我没时间为一个碎锅哭泣！
我得检查一下手有没有被割伤！
如果受伤了，我就没法帮别人了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's, uh, that
sounds pretty serious.
So how are your hands?
They don't hurt, do they?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这，嗯，听起来挺严重的。
那你的手怎么样？
不疼吧？

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Oooh, never mind that!
They're fine, thank goodness.
What's important now is that
you help me fix my herbal
medicine pot. You're partly
responsible, you know.
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
噢，别管那个了！
还好没事。
现在重要的是，
你要帮我修好这个熬药锅。
你也得负一部分责任，知道吗。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay. Just tell
me what I should do.
Hold on, I came here to
ask you if you'd give me
some medicine. You see--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的。告诉我该怎么做。
等等，我来这里是想
问问你能不能给我一些药。
你看--

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Perfect! All the more
reason you should help
me fix this pot! I can't
make any medicine without
this pot now, can I? Let's
see... I'll need glue, glue...
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
太好了！
那你更应该帮我修好这个锅了！
没有这个锅，我现在没法熬药，对吧？
让我想想...我需要胶水，胶水...

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Hurry and get
^0000FF20 Fine Sands^000000,
^0000FF5 Empty Bottles^000000,
^0000FF10 Brigans^000000, and
^0000FF10 Soft Blades of Grass^000000.
There's no time to waste!

[{0}]
You... You got it.

[Wola]
Good, you're back.
So you brought everything
I need to glue my pot
back together again?
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
很好，你回来了。
所以你带齐了
我修锅需要的东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Great. Give them here.
I should grind this, mix
that... Wait, was that right?
What were these for again?
Argh, I'm acting stupid again!
You mind not watching me?
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
太好了。给我吧。
我应该磨这个，混合那个...
等等，是这样吗？
这些是做什么用的来着？
哎呀，我又犯傻了！
你能别看着我吗？

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Just... Just sit in
that corner, don't say
anything, and wait till
I say I'm done, okay?!
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
就...就坐在那个角落，
什么都别说话，
等我做完再说，好吗？！

scripts.text:
[Wola]
There. It's finally
fixed. Oh wait, did you
say something about needing
some medicine? I completely
forgot about that for a while.
What did you say exactly?
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
好了。终于修好了。
哦等等，你刚才说需要
什么药来着？我刚才完全
忘了那回事。
你具体说了什么？

scripts.text: Will you go out with me?
scripts.translation: 你愿意和我约会吗？

scripts.text: Leblo's back medicine?
scripts.translation: 勒布罗的伤药？

scripts.text:
[Wola]
^666666*Blush*^000000 But it's too
early for us to just go
on a date. I'm sorry, it's...
I have someone in mind.
Still, I'm flattered that
you think of me that way.
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
^666666*脸红*^000000 但我们现在
还太早，不能就这样
去约会。对不起，我...
我心里有别人了。
不过，你能这样想，
我很荣幸。

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Wow, I can't believe
I'm turning you down--
a little surprised,
actually. But yes.
I have someone I like.
And it's not really you. Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
哇，我居然要拒绝你——
其实有点惊讶。但是是的。
我有喜欢的人了。
而且那个人不是你。抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Leblo... Oh, that
man in Geffen? Finally...
He has the sense to send
someone to get his meds.
I already prepared it.
Where did I put it now?
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
勒布罗... 哦，是吉芬的
那个男人？终于...
他总算有常识，派人来
取他的药了。
我已经准备好了。
我把它放哪儿了来着？

scripts.text:
[Wola]
I want to double check
his medicine first so
please tell him that I'll
have it delivered to him
shortly. In a while, maybe?
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
我想再仔细检查一下
他的药，所以请告诉他，
我很快就会送过去。
过一会儿，好吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um, you're not mad or
anything? I gathered that
you didn't like him much...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，你生气了吗？
我感觉你好像不太喜欢他...

scripts.text:
[Wola]
What are saying?
I'm a doctor: we're duty
bound to heal everyone we can!
That's not to say that some
patients suffer longer and
more painful treatment...
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
你在说什么？
我是医生：我们有义务
救治每一个能救的人！
这并不意味着有些病人
要承受更久、更痛苦的
治疗...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^666666She hates him!
But I guess Leblo's life
should be okay in her hands.^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(^666666她讨厌他！
但我想勒布罗的命
在她手里应该没问题。^000000)

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Alright, just let Leblo
know that I'm taking care
of him, that his life should
be okay in my hands. I need
to get back to work: please
take care of yourself!
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
好了，告诉勒布罗，
我正在照顾他，他的命
在我手里应该没问题。
我得回去工作了：
请照顾好自己！

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Hurry and get
^0000FF20 Fine Sands^000000,
^0000FF5 Empty Bottles^000000,
^0000FF10 Brigans^000000, and
^0000FF10 Soft Blades of Grass^000000.
There's no time to waste!

[{0}]
You... You got it.

[Wola]
Sorry, I completely
missed what you said
earlier. Something about
needing medicine from me?
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
抱歉，我完全没听清
你刚才说的话。是关于
需要从我这里拿药吗？

scripts.text: Will you go out with me?
scripts.translation: 你愿意和我约会吗？

scripts.text: Leblo's back medicine?
scripts.translation: 勒布罗的伤药？

scripts.text:
^666666*Blush*^000000 But it's too
early for us to just go
on a date. I'm sorry, it's...
I have someone in mind.
Still, I'm flattered that
you think of me that way.
scripts.translation:
^666666*脸红*^000000 但我们现在
还太早，不能就这样
去约会。对不起，我...
我心里有别人了。
不过，你能这样想，
我很荣幸。

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Wow, I can't believe
I'm turning you down--
a little surprised,
actually. But yes.
I have someone I like.
And it's not really you. Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
哇，我居然要拒绝你——
其实有点惊讶。但是是的。
我有喜欢的人了。
而且那个人不是你。抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Leblo... Oh, that
man in Geffen? Finally...
He has the sense to send
someone to get his meds.
I already prepared it.
Where did I put it now?
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
勒布罗... 哦，是吉芬的
那个男人？终于...
他总算有常识，派人来
取他的药了。
我已经准备好了。
我把它放哪儿了来着？

scripts.text:
[Wola]
I want to double check
his medicine first so
please tell him that I'll
have it delivered to him
shortly. In a while, maybe?
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
我想再仔细检查一下
他的药，所以请告诉他，
我很快就会送过去。
过一会儿，好吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um, you're not mad or
anything? I gathered that
you didn't like him much...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，你生气了吗？
我感觉你好像不太喜欢他...

scripts.text:
[Wola]
What are saying?
I'm a doctor: we're duty
bound to heal everyone we can!
That's not to say that some
patients suffer longer and
more painful treatment...
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
你在说什么？
我是医生：我们有义务
救治每一个能救的人！
这并不意味着有些病人
要承受更久、更痛苦的
治疗...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^666666She hates him!
But I guess Leblo's life
should be okay in her hands.^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(^666666她讨厌他！
但我想勒布罗的命
在她手里应该没问题。^000000)

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Alright, just let Leblo
know that I'm taking care
of him, that his life should
be okay in my hands. I need
to get back to work: please
take care of yourself!
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
好了，告诉勒布罗，
我正在照顾他，他的命
在我手里应该没问题。
我得回去工作了：
请照顾好自己！

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Food has a dramatic
effect on your body:
treat it like a drug, and
watch what you eat. Oh,
and do your research!
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
食物对身体有巨大的
影响：把它当作药物，
注意你吃的东西。哦，
还有，多做研究！

scripts.text:
[Wola]
You know, your lifestyle
and habits determine
your health in the future.
Take care of yourself!
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
你知道吗，你的生活方式
和习惯决定了你未来的
健康。请照顾好自己！

scripts.text:
[Wola]
Oh, how can this be
happening? What 
should I do?
scripts.translation:
[沃拉]
哦，怎么会发生这种事？
我该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Oh, remember me?
It's been a long time
so I can't blame you:
I was there when you
first joined our guild!
So what brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
哦，还记得我吗？
好久不见了，
不记得也情有可原：
你刚加入公会时，
我就在那里！
那么，这次来找我什么事？

scripts.text: Ask About the Z Gang
scripts.translation: 询问关于Z帮的事

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Ah, Z Gang, you said?
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
啊，你说的是Z帮？

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Oh, yeah, we're investigating
those guys. We actually found
their hideout, but then they
escaped before we could even
catch them. Wily bastards...
I think they were tipped off!
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
哦，对，我们正在调查那帮家伙。
我们其实找到了他们的据点，
但还没来得及抓人，
他们就逃了。真是一群狡猾的家伙...
我觉得他们肯定是收到风声了！

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
A few of our Rogue agents
are investigating the hideout,
but I doubt they can find
anything useful there.
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
我们几名流氓特工正在调查那个据点，
但我怀疑那里能有什么有用的线索。

scripts.text: Where's the hideout?
scripts.translation: 据点在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Well, it's a large
warehouse over in Comodo.
You're free to scope out
the place if you really want.
But chances are slim that
you'll find anything at all.
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
嗯，那是克魔岛上的一个大仓库。
如果你真的想去，
可以随意去探探路。
不过，你在那里找到东西的可能性很小。

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Hey, how's it going?
You ever consider joining
the Rogues? It'd be a lot
of fun. You're welcome to
look around, so feel free
to ask me any questions.
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
嘿，最近怎么样？
有没有考虑过加入流氓？
会很开心的。
欢迎四处看看，
有什么想问的尽管问我。

scripts.text: Ask About the Z Gang
scripts.translation: 询问关于Z帮的事

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Oh, yeah, we're investigating
those guys. We actually found
their hideout, but then they
escaped before we could even
catch them. Wily bastards...
I think they were tipped off!
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
哦，对，我们正在调查那帮家伙。
我们其实找到了他们的据点，
但还没来得及抓人，
他们就逃了。真是一群狡猾的家伙...
我觉得他们肯定是收到风声了！

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
A few of our Rogue agents
are investigating the hideout,
but I doubt they can find
anything useful there.
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
我们几名流氓特工正在调查那个据点，
但我怀疑那里能有什么有用的线索。

scripts.text: Where's the hideout?
scripts.translation: 据点在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Well, I'm not sure if
I can just tell you that
kind of information. I mean,
you're not a member of our
guild... Yet. What can I do?
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
嗯，我不确定我能不能
直接告诉你那种信息。我是说，
你还不是我们公会的成员...
至少目前还不是。我能为你做什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
I got it. I'll just tell my
boss that you bribed me
with 10,000 zeny. Not too
much, is it? We Rogues are
pretty bad... But not that bad.
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
明白了。我就跟老板说
你用10,000 Zeny贿赂了我。
不多吧？我们流氓虽然有点坏...
但也没那么坏。

scripts.text: Sounds good!
scripts.translation: 听起来不错！

scripts.text: Never mind, I'll find it myself...
scripts.translation: 算了，我自己去找...

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Thanks for the money~
Of course, if you became
a Rogue, this amount is
nothing compared to what
you can gank. ^666666*Ahem*^000000
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
谢谢你的钱~
当然，如果你成为流氓，
这点钱跟你强夺来的比起来
根本不算什么。^666666*咳咳*^000000

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
The Z Gang's old hideout
is a large warehouse over
in Comodo. I doubt you'll
find anything there, but
you can go check it out.
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
Z帮以前的据点
是克魔岛上的一个大仓库。
我怀疑那里能有什么东西，
但你可以去检查一下。

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Aw, what am I gonna
do if my boss askes to
see the money? We've got
to make this bribe authentic!
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
哎呀，如果老板要检查这笔钱，
我该怎么办？我们得让这笔贿赂看起来真实一点！

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Be my guest, maybe it'll be
a good learning experience.
But yeah, come back when
you think about changing
your job, okay? Be a Rogue~
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
请便吧，也许这会是个不错的学习经历。
不过，等你考虑转职的时候，
记得回来哦，好吗？做个流氓~

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Whoa, what are you doin'
here? I've got no beef with
you, but some Rogues, see,
some Rogues, have got a 
lot of beef. Uh, what'd you
want? Not a fight, I hope.
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
哇，你在这里干什么？
我跟你没什么过节，但是有些流氓，
嗯，有些流氓，
可是很有脾气的。呃，
你想干什么？希望不是想打架。

scripts.text: Ask About the Z Gang
scripts.translation: 询问关于Z帮的事

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Those guys have been
bothering everyone!
Yeah, I guess you can
say we're united on this.
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
那帮家伙一直在骚扰大家！
是的，我想我们可以说
在这件事上我们是一致的。

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Oh, yeah, we're investigating
those guys. We actually found
their hideout, but then they
escaped before we could even
catch them. Wily bastards...
I think they were tipped off!
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
哦，对，我们正在调查那帮家伙。
我们其实找到了他们的据点，
但还没来得及抓人，
他们就逃了。真是一群狡猾的家伙...
我觉得他们肯定是收到风声了！

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
A few of our Rogue agents
are investigating the hideout,
but I doubt they can find
anything useful there.
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
我们几名流氓特工正在调查那个据点，
但我怀疑那里能有什么有用的线索。

scripts.text: Where's the hideout?
scripts.translation: 据点在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Uh, I can't just give
you that information
if you're not a member
of our guild. But since
we're together on this,
I'll just ask for 10,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
呃，如果你不是我们公会的成员，
我不能随便给你那种信息。但既然
我们在同一阵线，
我就只要10,000 Zeny吧。

scripts.text: Sounds good!
scripts.translation: 听起来不错！

scripts.text: Forget it...
scripts.translation: 算了...

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Right on, right on.
Alright, I didn't charge
you much since the hideout
is a large warehouse in
Comodo where I doubt you'll
find anything. But who knows?
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
很好，很好。
好吧，我没收你太多钱，因为据点
是克魔岛上的一个大仓库，
我怀疑你能找到什么。但谁知道呢？

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Hey, this isn't enough
money. I thought people
in your job made more
zeny than this everyday!
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
嘿，这点钱不够啊。
我以为像你这种职业的人
平时赚的Zeny比这多得多呢！

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Alright, but I think
you'll need a little
extra help finding that
place. I mean, Rogues are
hiding experts, and even
we had some trouble!
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
好吧，但我觉得
你可能需要一点额外的帮助
才能找到那个地方。
我是说，流氓是隐匿专家，
连我们都费了点劲呢！

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Geez, I'm so sleepy...
Everyone's out on a mission,
and I'm stuck here on guard
duty. When can I see some
action again? Ugh! Rogues
hate standing in one place!
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
天哪，我好困...
大家都出任务去了，
我却只能在这里站岗。
什么时候才能再有点动作啊？
唉！流氓最讨厌站在一个地方不动了！

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Hey, pal. You part
of the guild? Nice.
If they sent you to help
out, well, there's nothing
to do here. This place is
pretty much cleaned out.
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
嘿，伙计。
你是公会的成员吗？不错。
如果是他们派你来帮忙的，
那这里没什么可做的。
这个地方基本上已经被搜空了。

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
What do you want?
Oh, your guild musta
sent you to help out.
Yeah. We investigated.
Didn't find anything.
The Z Gang's long gone.
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
你想干什么？
哦，你们公会一定是派你来帮忙的。
是啊。我们调查过了。
什么也没找到。
Z帮早就跑光了。

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Feel free to look
around, but if you ask
me, it's a waste of time.
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
你可以随便看看，
但在我看来，
这是浪费时间。

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Yeesh, I'm stuck here
till I receive my new
orders from the guild.
They didn't... They didn't
forget about me, did they?
scripts.translation:
[调查员]
唉，我得在这里待着，
直到收到公会的新命令。
他们不会...不会忘了我吧？

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere is a small
safe hidden under the
shadows of these boxes.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这些箱子的阴影下
藏着一个小型保险箱。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Looks like the Z Gang
forgot to take this with
them in their rush to escape.
Hmmm... How do I open this?
Is there a key, a switch,
something I can use?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看来Z帮在匆忙逃跑时
忘了把这个带走。
嗯...我怎么打开它？
是有钥匙，还是开关，
或者有什么我能用的东西？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, the safe opened!
Those switches must have
done the trick. Now...
Let's look inside.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，保险箱开了！
那些开关一定起了作用。
现在...
让我们看看里面有什么。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Awesome! It's a huge
red diamond! Is this
Ibrahim's Diamond
of Destruction?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
太棒了！是一颗巨大的红钻石！
这是易卜拉欣的
毁灭之钻吗？

scripts.text:
[Investigator]
Zzz... Zzz...

[{0}]
Lucky for me, this
guy is asleep. I better
sneak out of here, and
return this big diamond
to Ibrahim as soon as I can.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
幸好这家伙睡着了。
我得赶紧溜出去，
尽快把这颗大钻石还给易卜拉欣。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There was something here
fixed to the ground, but now
it looks like something yanked
it out forcefully. How weird.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这里原本有个固定在地上的东西，
但现在看起来像是被强行拔走了。
真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is this?
Oh well, I don't
think it's important.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是什么？
算了，我觉得这并不重要。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere is a tiny
switch on the ground
near the whiskey barrels.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF威士忌桶附近的地面上
有一个微小的开关。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Was this here before?
What happens if I press
this teeny little switch?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是之前就在的吗？
如果我按下这个微小的开关
会发生什么？

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Click Click*^000000

[{0}]
That sound...!
Something happened,
but what could it be?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那个声音...！
好像有什么东西发生了，
但会是什么呢？

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere is a tiny
switch on the ground
under the boxes' shadows.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF箱子阴影下的地面上
有一个微小的开关。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Was this here before?
What happens if I press
this teeny little switch?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是之前就在的吗？
如果我按下这个微小的开关
会发生什么？

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Click Click*^000000

[{0}]
That sound...!
Something happened,
but what could it be?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那个声音...！
好像有什么东西发生了，
但会是什么呢？

scripts.text:
====National Wanted Notice====
Please report any information
regarding these criminals to
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom's
Homeland Security Office.
scripts.translation:
====全国通缉令====
请向卢恩·米德加兹王国
国土安全局报告
关于这些罪犯的任何信息。

scripts.text:
====National Wanted Notice====
^0000ffLouis Von Silokens^000000 - Human Male
^0000ffMartha Hertizan^000000 - Human Female
^0000ffCatfoii^000000 - Pet Cat
scripts.translation:
====全国通缉令====
^0000ff路易斯·冯·西洛肯斯^000000 - 人类男性
^0000ff玛莎·赫蒂赞^000000 - 人类女性
^0000ff卡特福伊^000000 - 宠物猫

scripts.text:
====National Wanted Notice====
These infamous members
of the Z Gang are suspected
of stealing national treasure,
committing fraud, forgery,
and promoting overall
depravity and immorality.
scripts.translation:
====全国通缉令====
这些臭名昭著的Z帮成员
涉嫌盗窃国家宝藏、
实施欺诈、伪造文件，
以及助长整体的
堕落与不道德行为。

scripts.text:
====National Wanted Notice====
Anyone that captures
the listed criminals will
be rewarded with the Book
of Forbidden Mystery, one
of the kingdom's treasures.
scripts.translation:
====全国通缉令====
任何捕获
名单上罪犯的人
都将获得《禁忌之谜之书》
作为奖励，
这是王国的宝藏之一。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Ever since you captured
the Z Gang, crime has gone
down to an all time low.
Thanks for helping us out~
scripts.translation:
[大副]
自从你们捕获了Z帮，
犯罪率就降到了
历史最低点。
谢谢你们帮助我们~

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Peace never lasts long...
Some other fiends will
replace the Z Gang soon.
When that happens, I hope
we can count on you again.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
和平不会持续太久...
很快就会有其他恶棍
取代Z帮。
当那一天到来时，
我希望还能依靠你们。

scripts.text:
====National Wanted Notice====
Please report any information
regarding these criminals to
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom's
Homeland Security Office.
scripts.translation:
====全国通缉令====
请向卢恩·米德加兹王国
国土安全局报告
关于这些罪犯的任何信息。

^0000ffMartha Hertizan^000000 - Human Female
^0000ffCatfoii^000000 - Pet Cat
scripts.translation:
====全国通缉令====
^0000ff路易斯·冯·西洛肯斯^000000 - 人类男性
^0000ff玛莎·赫蒂赞^000000 - 人类女性
^0000ff卡特福伊^000000 - 宠物猫

scripts.translation:

涉嫌盗窃国家宝藏、
实施欺诈、伪造文件，
以及助长整体的
堕落与不道德行为。

scripts.text:
