Anyone that captures
the listed criminals will
be rewarded with the Book
of Forbidden Mystery, one
of the kingdom's treasures.
scripts.translation:
====全国通缉令====
任何捕获
名单上罪犯的人
都将获得《禁忌之谜之书》
作为奖励，
这是王国的宝藏之一。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
You're carrying far too
much right now. Please
lighten your load by
placing your items
in the Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
你现在携带的物品
实在太多了。请
将物品放入卡普拉仓库
以减轻负担。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Adventurers, this is
your chance to protect
and serve your country!
Please read the National
Wanted Notice for more details.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
冒险者们，这是
你们保卫和服务
国家的绝佳机会！
请阅读全国通缉令
以了解更多详情。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Attention, attention.
The Homeland Security Office
of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom
is looking for any information
regarding the Z Gang.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
注意，注意。
卢恩·米德加兹王国
国土安全局正在
寻找关于Z帮的任何信息。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
There are three members:
Louis Von Silokens a.k.a.
Louis, Martha Hertizan a.k.a.
Martha, and Catfoii a.k.a.
Catfoii must be captured!
scripts.translation:
[大副]
共有三名成员：
路易斯·冯·西洛肯斯，
又名路易斯，玛莎·赫蒂赞，
又名玛莎，以及卡特福伊，
又名卡特福伊，必须被捕获！

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Oh, were you interested
in pursuing the criminals
listed in the Wanted notice?
I'm sorry, but you're not
ready for that kind of task...
But I encourge you to train!
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
啊，你是想追捕
通缉令上列出的罪犯吗？
很抱歉，但你还没有
准备好执行这种任务...
但我鼓励你多加训练！
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Hello, Rune-Midgartian.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[大副]
你好，卢恩·米德加兹的居民。
有什么事吗？

scripts.text: National Wanted Notice
scripts.translation: 全国通缉令

scripts.text: Z Gang
scripts.translation: Z帮

scripts.text: What crimes did Z Gang commit?
scripts.translation: Z帮犯了什么罪？

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Ah, were you interested
in pursuing the Z Gang?
Please carefully read the
Wanted notice posted right
next to me. We desperately
need help to catch them.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
啊，你是想追捕Z帮吗？
请仔细阅读
贴在我旁边的通缉令。
我们急需帮助来抓捕他们。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
If you want to learn
more about the Z Gang,
I suggest talking to
a knight named Valdes.
He's fairly familiar with
their brand of antics.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
如果你想了解更多
关于Z帮的信息，
我建议你去和
一位名叫瓦尔德斯的骑士谈谈。
他对他们的所作所为
相当熟悉。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Unfortunately, I fear
that he may be ashamed
of his failure to catch
them. However, I am sure
that he will be of service
in your quest for justice.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
不幸的是，我担心
他可能会因为未能
抓捕他们而感到羞愧。
不过，我相信他
会在你追求正义的
旅途中提供帮助。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
You wanted to know more
about the Z Gang members?
I don'tknow much about them,
but I can divulge what
little I've heard.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
你想知道更多
关于Z帮成员的事吗？
我对他们了解不多，
但我可以透露
我所听到的一些信息。

scripts.text: Louis
scripts.translation: 路易斯

scripts.text: Martha
scripts.translation: 玛莎

scripts.text: Catfoii
scripts.translation: 卡特福伊

scripts.text: Book of Forbidden Mystery?
scripts.translation: 《禁忌之谜之书》？

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Louis Von Silokens was
the third son of the noble
Silokens family which was
ruined many years ago.
According to record, he failed
Magic Academy three times.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
路易斯·冯·西洛肯斯是西洛肯斯家族的三子，该家族多年前已家道中落。
据记载，他曾三次未能通过魔法学院的考试。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
It is believed that he formed
the Z Gang as a result of
his personal failure. He
also stole the Book of
Forbidden Mystery from
the Royal Library.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
人们认为他因个人失败而组建了Z帮。
他还从皇家图书馆偷走了《禁忌之谜之书》。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
We must capture him and
retrieve that book before
he can abuse its power.
We need the help of the
people in order to find him
and bring Louis to justice!
scripts.translation:
[大副]
我们必须在他滥用其力量之前将他抓获并夺回那本书。
我们需要民众的帮助来找到他，让路易斯受到法律的制裁！

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Martha Hertizan is the
second daughter of Alberta's
Hertizan family. No one knows
why she ran away from home
at the age of twenty.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
玛莎·赫蒂赞是艾尔贝塔赫蒂赞家族的二小姐。
没人知道她为何在二十岁时离家出走。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Martha handles the Z Gang's
finances. It's a shame that
such a talented merchant
has stooped to thievery.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
玛莎负责管理Z帮的财务。
真可惜，如此有才华的商人竟沦落为盗贼。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
We initially believed
that Catfoii was just
Louis and Martha's pet
cat... But it's actually a
master criminal. Approach
it with extreme caution!
scripts.translation:
[大副]
我们起初以为卡特福伊只是路易斯和玛莎的宠物猫...
但它其实是个犯罪大师。请极度小心地接近它！

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
That's all I know about
that animal. The true
nature of Catfoii is
shrouded in mystery.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
关于那只动物，我就知道这些。
卡特福伊的真实面目笼罩在神秘之中。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Out of all their crimes,
their theft of the Book of
Forbidden Mystery poses the
greatest danger to the kingdom.
If they misuse that book, it
will cause grave disaster.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
在他们犯下的所有罪行中，
偷窃《禁忌之谜之书》对王国构成了最大的威胁。
如果他们滥用那本书，将引发严重的灾难。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
That damned Z Gang seems
to be in the center of all the
crime that's happening in
Rune-Midgarts. They caused
a riot in Geffen by spreading
rumors about ghosts...
scripts.translation:
[大副]
该死的Z帮似乎正处于卢恩·米德加兹所有犯罪活动的中心。
他们散布关于幽灵的谣言，在吉芬引发了骚乱...

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
They poisoned the
drinking water in the
wells of Payon, seized
countless goods, profited
off illegal trade... The list
just keeps going on and on...
scripts.translation:
[大副]
他们在斐扬的水井中投毒，掠夺无数货物，从中非法贸易中牟利...
这样的罪行简直数不胜数...

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Out of all their crimes,
their theft of the Book of
Forbidden Mystery poses the
greatest danger to the kingdom.
If they misuse that book, it
will cause grave disaster.
scripts.translation:
[大副]
在他们犯下的所有罪行中，
偷窃《禁忌之谜之书》对王国构成了最大的威胁。
如果他们滥用那本书，将引发严重的灾难。

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Oh, you were that nice
adventurer that dropped
by the other day. How
may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[大副]
哦，你是前几天来过的那位好心的冒险者。
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
What's that?! You really
found the Z Gang's hideout,
captured them, and retrieved
the forbidden book?
scripts.translation:
[大副]
什么？！你真的找到了Z帮的秘密基地，
抓住了他们，并夺回了那本禁忌之书？

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Splendid! Just splendid!
On behalf of the king,
let me give you a well
deserved reward. Thank
you for your work on
behalf of our kingdom!
scripts.translation:
[大副]
太棒了！简直太棒了！
代表国王，让我为您颁发一份应得的奖励。
感谢您为我们王国所做的贡献！

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
Your bravery and ardent
patriotism will forever
be recorded in the annals
of Rune-Midgarts history.
Congratulations!
scripts.translation:
[大副]
您的英勇和炽热的爱国之心将永远载入卢恩·米德加兹的历史。
恭喜您！

scripts.text:
[Chief Officer]
All those that oppose
the peace and safety of
our kingdom will not be
spared the fury of our
righteous swords!
scripts.translation:
[大副]
所有反对我国和平与安全的人，
都将受到我们正义之剑的怒火制裁！

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务
将部分物品存入仓库，
然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
^666666*Urp*^000000 What?
You here to... 
Um, commiserate
about failing life too?
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
^666666*嗝*^000000 什么？
你来这里... 
呃，也是为了同情我人生失败的事吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you Valdes?
I came to ask you
for your help...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是瓦尔德斯吗？
我来是想请求你的帮助...

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
^666666*Hiccup*^000000 Why~?
I'm-I'm no good
to anybody anymore!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
^666666*嗝*^000000 为什么~？
我...我已经对谁都没用了！

scripts.text: Ask About Z Gang
scripts.translation: 询问关于Z帮派的事

scripts.text: The chief officer is worried about you.
scripts.translation: 大副很担心你。

scripts.text: Bye!
scripts.translation: 再见！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
That Z Gang...
Ruined my life!
My career, my pension...
It's all gone because
of those damn criminals!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
那个Z帮派...
毁了我的人生！
我的事业，我的退休金...
全都被那群该死的罪犯给毁了！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
You? Capture them?
Good luck! Just... Just
try not to end up like me.
Oh, you want info-information?
^666666*Hic*^000000 Heh, scratch my back,
well, you know the rest.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
你？去抓他们？
祝你好运！只是...只是
别像我一样落得这种下场。
哦，你想要资...资讯？
^666666*嗝*^000000 嘿，帮我个忙，
你也知道规矩的。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Heh, I just ran out of wine!
Gimme, um, ^0000FFMorocc Fruit Wine^000000!
5 bottles! Then... Maybe...
I'll tell you want you really
wanna know. Heh heh~ ^666666*Hic!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
嘿，我刚好没酒了！
给我来...^0000FF莫洛克果酒^000000！
5瓶！然后...也许...
我会告诉你你真正想知道的。嘿嘿~ ^666666*嗝！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
R-really? Well...
I don't care! Just
let me drink in peace!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
真...真的吗？好吧...
我才不在乎呢！
让我安安静静地喝酒！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Wha--? Who do you think
you're messing with, ^666666*Hic!*^000000
just comin' by to say ''bye?!''
I useta be a knight once,
you know that? I could
totally kick your--^666666*Urp!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
什...什么？你以为你在跟谁说话，^666666*嗝！*^000000
就只是来道个“再见”吗？！
我以前可是骑士，
你知道吧？我完全能把你揍得--^666666*嗝！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Heeeey yoooou~
You bring me wine?
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
嘿~ 你~
你带酒来了？

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
^666666*Sniff*^000000 Yeeesh, that
smeells good. This must
be it. Oh, yeah. Knight's
honor. First I talk, then
I can drink theesh...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
^666666*吸鼻子*^000000 哇，闻起来
真香。这应该就是它了。哦，对。骑士的
荣誉。先说话，
然后才能喝...这酒...

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Well, maybe...
Just one tashte~
^666666*Gulp Gulp Gulp*^000000
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
嗯，也许...
就尝一小口~
^666666*咕咚咕咚咕咚*^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You just...
That was three bottles!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你刚才...
那已经喝了三瓶了！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Ah, delicious!
Alright, fellow,
now I feel better
able to speak now~
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
啊，美味！
好了，伙计，
现在我感觉好些了，
可以好好说话了~

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
I assume you already know
the basic information about
the Z Gang, their members,
et cetera. I'm not sure why
they've gone on such a brazen
crime spree so suddenly.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
我想你应该已经知道
关于Z帮派的基本信息，
他们的成员等等。我不明白
为什么他们突然开始
如此肆无忌惮地犯罪。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
Their success is unprecedented:
they've even managed to elude
the Rogue Guild repeatedly.
I investigated them six
months ago, but I was
dismissed for my failure.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
他们的成功前所未有：
他们甚至多次逃脱了
流氓公会的追捕。我六个月前
调查过他们，但因为
失败而被解职了。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
I am aware that the Z Gang
has many informers in their
employ, and that the Rogue
Guild are still investigating
the Z Gang on their own.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
我知道Z帮派
雇佣了许多线人，而且
流氓公会也在
独立调查Z帮派。

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
I suggest meeting one
of the Rogue agents,
Marybell, in the Rogue
Guild. The password you
must give her is ''^0000FFThe
dawn is yet to come^000000.''
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
我建议你去流氓公会
见见其中一名特工，
玛丽贝尔。你必须
告诉她的密码是“^0000FF黎明尚未到来^000000。”

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
That is all I can tell you.
Please give my regards to
Marybell for me, and catch
those Z Gang bastards.
^666666*Sigh*^000000 I think I'll go rest
a bit now. Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
这就是我能告诉你的全部了。
请代我向玛丽贝尔问好，
并抓住那些Z帮派的混蛋。
^666666*叹气*^000000 我想我现在去
休息一下。祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
You stinkface!
Where's my wine?!
My ^0000FF5 bottles of
Morocc Fruit Wine^000000?!
I'm not gonna talk
to you without it!
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
你这个臭脸！
我的酒呢？！
我的^0000FF5瓶莫洛克果酒^000000？！
没有它我
不会跟你说话的！

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
I suggest meeting
Marybell in the Rogue
Guild, and giving her the
password, ''^0000FFThe dawn
is yet to come^000000.''
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
我建议你去流氓公会
见见玛丽贝尔，并告诉她
密码：“^0000FF黎明尚未到来^000000。”

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
^666666*Sigh*^000000 It is my greatest
wish that the knight master
will allow me to rejoin the
corps. However, I doubt that
he's forgiven my failure. ^666666*Sob*^000000
It's like my life is over...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
^666666*叹气*^000000 我最大的愿望
就是骑士长能允许我
重新加入部队。不过，我怀疑
他还没有原谅我的失败。^666666*哭泣*^000000
感觉我的人生已经完了...

scripts.text:
[Valdes]
^666666*Sigh*^000000 Goddamn thieves.
Why should I even care
about them?! They're not
my problem anymore...
^666666*Hiccup*^000000
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔德斯]
^666666*叹气*^000000 该死的小偷。
我为什么要
在意他们？！他们
已经不是我的问题了...
^666666*打嗝*^000000

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Hey. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
嘿。你想干什么？

scripts.text: Password
scripts.translation: 密码

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Can't hear you.
Come a little closer,
and talk right in my ear.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
听不见。
靠近一点，
凑到我耳边说。

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Valdes sent you?!
I'm surprised he finally
decided to talk to someone!
Alright, if you're his friend,
then I'll do what I can to
help. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
瓦尔德斯派你来的？！
没想到他终于
决定跟别人说话了！
好吧，既然你是他的朋友，
我会尽力帮忙。你需要什么？

scripts.text: Ask About Z Gang
scripts.translation: 询问关于Z帮派的事

scripts.text: Valdes says, ''Hi.''
scripts.translation: 瓦尔德斯说：“你好。”

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
The Z Gang again?
I guess he's still mad
about capturing them.
It's not a big deal for me
to tell you what I know, but
can I really trust you?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
又是Z帮派？
看来他还在为
抓不到他们而生气。
告诉你我知道的事
对我来说不算什么，但
我真的能信任你吗？

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Let me test you out.
Go to Payon, find an old
guy named Moonho Ahn. He's
a legendary gambler better
known as the White Meteor.
If he trusts you, I trust you.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
让我测试一下你。
去斐扬，找一个叫安文浩的
老头。他是个传奇赌徒，
绰号“白流星”。
如果他信任你，我就信任你。

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Heh, but he'll only trust
you if you can beat him at
gambling. Whether you return
or not, I'm gonna continue
investigating the Z Gang for
the Rogue Guild and Valdes.
[Marybell]
Let me test you out.
Go to Payon, find an old
guy named Moonho Ahn. He's
a legendary gambler better
known as the White Meteor.
If he trusts you, I trust you.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
哈，但他只会在

不管你回不回来，我都会
继续为流氓公会和瓦尔德斯
调查Z帮派。
[玛丽贝尔]
让我测试一下你。
去斐扬，找一个叫安文浩的
老头。他是个传奇赌徒，

如果他信任你，我就信任你。

scripts.text:

[Marybell]
What, you're back?
Aww, nuts! That signature
on your arm... You really
beat him? How the hell--?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
哈，但他只会在
你赢了他之后才信任你。
不管你回不回来，我都会
继续为流氓公会和瓦尔德斯
调查Z帮派。
[玛丽贝尔]
什么，你回来了？
哎呀，该死！你手臂上的
那个印记...你真的
赢了他？怎么可能--？

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Heh, but he'll only trust
you if you can beat him at
gambling. Whether you return
or not, I'm gonna continue
investigating the Z Gang for
the Rogue Guild and Valdes.
[Marybell]
Well, I promised to tell
you what I know about the
Z Gang, so I gotta make good.
What did you want to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
哈，但他只会在
你赢了他之后才信任你。
不管你回不回来，我都会
继续为流氓公会和瓦尔德斯
调查Z帮派。
[玛丽贝尔]
好吧，我答应过要告诉你
我知道的关于Z帮派的事，
所以我得说到做到。
你想问什么？

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Heh, but he'll only trust
you if you can beat him at
gambling. Whether you return
or not, I'm gonna continue
investigating the Z Gang for
the Rogue Guild and Valdes.
[Marybell]
Oh, and one more thing...
I hear that they're trying
to secretly recruit more
gang members in Morocc.
The nerve of those guys...!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
哈，但他只会在
你赢了他之后才信任你。
不管你回不回来，我都会
继续为流氓公会和瓦尔德斯
调查Z帮派。
[玛丽贝尔]
哦，还有一件事...
我听说他们正在莫洛克
秘密招募更多帮派成员。
这些家伙真是胆大包天...！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Heh, but he'll only trust
you if you can beat him at
gambling. Whether you return
or not, I'm gonna continue
investigating the Z Gang for
the Rogue Guild and Valdes.
[Marybell]
Hey, I've been looking for
you! One of the Rogues
dispatched to Comodo found
this envelope on a Z Gang
informer. Could be a clue!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
哈，但他只会在
你赢了他之后才信任你。
不管你回不回来，我都会
继续为流氓公会和瓦尔德斯
调查Z帮派。
[玛丽贝尔]
嘿，我一直在找你！
派往克魔岛的一名流氓
在一个Z帮派线人身上
发现了这个信封。可能是线索！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Heh, but he'll only trust
you if you can beat him at
gambling. Whether you return
or not, I'm gonna continue
investigating the Z Gang for
the Rogue Guild and Valdes.
[Marybell]
Hey, why don't you talk
to Gooho Ahn in Payon,
and ask if he finished
decoding that secret letter
from the Z Gang already?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
哈，但他只会在
你赢了他之后才信任你。
不管你回不回来，我都会
继续为流氓公会和瓦尔德斯
调查Z帮派。
[玛丽贝尔]
嘿，你为什么不跟斐扬的
安具浩谈谈，问问他
是否已经破译了那封
来自Z帮派的秘密信件？

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Heh, but he'll only trust
you if you can beat him at
gambling. Whether you return
or not, I'm gonna continue
investigating the Z Gang for
the Rogue Guild and Valdes.
[Marybell]
Oh, Gooho decoded everything?
Let's see... Something about
the Book of Forbidden Mystery... Ah. There we go! The location
of the Z Gang's hideout!
Heh heh! We got 'em!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
哈，但他只会在
你赢了他之后才信任你。
不管你回不回来，我都会
继续为流氓公会和瓦尔德斯
调查Z帮派。
[玛丽贝尔]
哦，安具浩全都破译了？
让我看看... 关于《禁忌之谜之书》...
啊。找到了！Z集团秘密基地的位置！
嘿嘿！我们抓到他们了！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Heh, but he'll only trust
you if you can beat him at
gambling. Whether you return
or not, I'm gonna continue
investigating the Z Gang for
the Rogue Guild and Valdes.
[Marybell]
We're definitely sure
that the Z Gang's hideout
is near the secret path
to the South Morocc
underground. You
know where that is?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
哈，但他只会在
你赢了他之后才信任你。
不管你回不回来，我都会
继续为流氓公会和瓦尔德斯
调查Z帮派。
[玛丽贝尔]
我们非常确定
Z集团的秘密基地
就在通往莫洛克地下
秘密通道的附近。
你知道那是在哪里吗？

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Heh, but he'll only trust
you if you can beat him at
gambling. Whether you return
or not, I'm gonna continue
investigating the Z Gang for
the Rogue Guild and Valdes.
[Marybell]
Nice work! You captured
the Z Gang! The kingdom
musta given you a really
big reward, huh?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
哈，但他只会在
你赢了他之后才信任你。
不管你回不回来，我都会
继续为流氓公会和瓦尔德斯
调查Z帮派。
[玛丽贝尔]
干得好！你抓住了
Z集团！王国
肯定给了你一大笔奖励，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Heh, but he'll only trust
you if you can beat him at
gambling. Whether you return
or not, I'm gonna continue
investigating the Z Gang for
the Rogue Guild and Valdes.
[Marybell]
That Z Gang has been
a pain the Rogue Guild's
ass. No one runs away
from us! Nobody! But...
They can do it somehow.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
哈，但他只会在
你赢了他之后才信任你。
不管你回不回来，我都会
继续为流氓公会和瓦尔德斯
调查Z帮派。
[玛丽贝尔]
那个Z集团一直
让流氓公会头疼。没人
能从我们手里逃走！一个都没有！但是...
他们总能做到。

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Heh, but he'll only trust
you if you can beat him at
gambling. Whether you return
or not, I'm gonna continue
investigating the Z Gang for
the Rogue Guild and Valdes.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
哈，但他只会在你赢了他之后才信任你。
不管你回不回来，我都会继续为流氓公会和瓦尔德斯调查Z帮派。

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Weird. It's not like him
to send his regards like that.
He's not sick or anything,
is he? If he's still drinking
the next time I see him,
I'm gonna clobber that guy!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
真奇怪。他不像会这样托人带话的样子。
他应该没生病吧？
下次见到他如果还在喝酒，
我一定要揍扁那个家伙！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Geez. Doesn't he know
I volunteered for this
job for his sake? Oh well,
it's really nice to know
that he's thinking of me.
What? Rogues can have friends!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
真是的。他难道不知道
我接这工作是为了他吗？
算了，知道他心里有我
感觉还不错。
什么？流氓也能有朋友！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Can't tell what
you're saying exactly.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
完全听不懂你在说什么。

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
If this is some kind
of weird come-on, you'd
better have something
better to say than that!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
如果这是某种奇怪的搭讪，
你最好说点更有意思的！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
What, are you coming
on to me? I'm down with
any gender, but, heh,
you sure about this?
Hahahahahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
什么，你在向我示好？
我对性别没要求，但是，哈，
你确定吗？
哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Let me test you out.
Go to Payon, find an old
guy named Moonho Ahn. He's
a legendary gambler better
known as the White Meteor.
If he trusts you, I trust you.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
让我测试一下你。
去斐扬，找一个叫安文浩的
老头。他是个传奇赌徒，
绰号“白流星”。
如果他信任你，我就信任你。

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
What, you're back?
Aww, nuts! That signature
on your arm... You really
beat him? How the hell--?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
什么，你回来了？
哎呀，该死！你手臂上的那个印记...
你真的赢了他？怎么可能--？

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Wait, lemme check
and make sure. Yeap.
That's the one. That's
the signature he used when
he was the White Meteor.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
等等，让我确认一下。
没错。
就是那个。那是他作为
白流星时使用的印记。

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
How did you beat him?
Last time, he cleaned me
out of all my money! You
must be some kinda genius
to beat that guy. Heh. Guess
I underestimated you.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
你是怎么赢他的？
上次，他把我所有的钱都赢走了！
你能赢他，一定是个天才。
哈。看来我小看你了。

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Hold on, before anything
else, I gotta tell everyone
that someone actually beat
the White Meteor. They're
totally not gonna believe it!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
等一下，在说别的之前，
我得告诉所有人，
真的有人赢了白流星。
他们肯定不敢相信！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Well, I promised to tell
you what I know about the
Z Gang, so I gotta make good.
What did you want to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
嗯，我答应过告诉你
关于Z帮派我知道的事，
所以我得兑现承诺。
你想问我什么？

scripts.text: Z Gang's Goal
scripts.translation: Z帮派的目标

scripts.text: Z Gang's Recent Movements
scripts.translation: Z帮派最近的动向

scripts.text: Z Gang's Stronghold
scripts.translation: Z帮派的据点

scripts.text: Thanks for the tip!
scripts.translation: 谢谢你的情报！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Actually, I don't know
what they plan to do, but
obviously it isn't something
very good. Personally, I think
they just want to harass
people as much as they can.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
其实，我不知道他们打算做什么，
但显然不是什么好事。
就我个人而言，我觉得
他们只是想尽可能多地骚扰别人。

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
You could conquer the
world, I guess, with that
Book of Forbidden Mystery,
but I don't think they're
that... Calculating.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
用那本《禁忌之谜之书》
也许能征服世界，
但我觉得他们没那么... 有谋略。

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Well, the Z Gang is
responsible for a series
of thefts lately. They've
only been stealing jewels
like diamonds, rubies,
emeralds. Not sure why...
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
嗯，Z帮派最近负责了一系列盗窃案。
他们只偷钻石、红宝石、
祖母绿之类的宝石。不知道为什么...

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Well, we don't know where
they're hiding out. If that
was the case, the Z Gang
would already be caught!
They even got away from
us Rogues. Crazy, huh?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
嗯，我们不知道他们藏在哪里。
如果知道的话，Z帮派
早就被抓了！
他们甚至从我们流氓公会手里逃走了。
真疯狂，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
The Rogue Guild has got
the best intel network so...
The Z Gang probably has
informers everywhere in
all the towns. It's the only
way they can escape us.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
流氓公会拥有最好的情报网络，所以...
Z帮派可能在所有城镇都有线人。
这是他们能逃脱我们的唯一方式。

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Hey, we can use that...
If we can catch one of
their informers, one of
them'll spill the beans
on where the Z Gang is
hiding. Worth a shot, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
嘿，我们可以利用这一点...
如果我们能抓住其中一个线人，
他们就会供出Z集团藏匿的地点。
值得一试，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Oh, and one more thing...
I hear that they're trying
to secretly recruit more
gang members in Morocc.
The nerve of those guys...!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
哦，还有一件事...
我听说他们正在摩洛克秘密招募
更多的帮派成员。这些人真是胆大包天...！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
It might be a good idea
for you to go to Morocc
and check it out. Good
luck finding those Z Gang
guys. And take care!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
也许你去摩洛克看看情况是个好主意。
祝你好运找到那些Z集团的人。
保重！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Hey, I'm willing to
let you in on everything
I know. After all the trouble
you went through, I'm sure
you've got a ton of questions!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
嘿，我愿意把我知道的一切都告诉你。
经历了那么多麻烦，
我肯定你有很多问题要问！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Oh, and one more thing...
I hear that they're trying
to secretly recruit more
gang members in Morocc.
The nerve of those guys...!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
哦，还有一件事...
我听说他们正在摩洛克秘密招募
更多的帮派成员。这些人真是胆大包天...！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
I haven't heard anything
else, but would you let me
know if you get any new leads?
The Rogue Guild wants these
Z Gang guys really bad!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
我没听到其他消息，但如果你得到
任何新线索，请告诉我好吗？
流氓公会非常想抓住这些Z集团的人！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Hey, I've been looking for
you! One of the Rogues
dispatched to Comodo found
this envelope on a Z Gang
informer. Could be a clue!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
嘿，我一直在找你！
派往克魔岛的一名流氓
在一个Z集团线人身上发现了这个信封。
这可能是一个线索！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
What's weird is that the
informer was fighting so
hard to hold on to blank
piece of paper... But we 
know that's not really
the case here, is it?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
奇怪的是，那个线人拼命想抓住
一张空白的纸...但我们都知道
这里的情况并非如此，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
They must've been using
some kinda secret invisible
ink. Anyway, I gave the paper
to a professional decoder to
crack, and he oughta be
done by now. Anyway...
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
他们一定使用了某种秘密的隐形墨水。
总之，我把那张纸交给了一个专业的
解码员去破解，他现在应该已经完成了。
总之...

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
I thought maybe you'd
want to go talk to him,
see if he's finished with it.
His name's Gooho Ahn over
in Payon, one of the best
decoders in this kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
我想你可能想去找他谈谈，
看看他是否完成了。他叫安具浩，
在斐扬，是这个王国最好的解码员之一。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Gooho Ahn?
Why does it feel like
I should know that
name? It's so familiar...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
安具浩？
为什么我觉得我应该知道
这个名字？它很熟悉...

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
I guess it's 'cause
Gooho is the younger brother
of Moonho, that legendary
gambler you happened to beat.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
我想是因为安具浩是月浩的弟弟，
那个你碰巧打败的传奇赌徒。

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Eh, that's not what's
important right now.
Would you talk to Gooho
Ahn and see what he found?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
呃，现在这不是最重要的。
你会去和安具浩谈谈，看看他发现了什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Hey, why don't you talk
to Gooho Ahn in Payon,
and ask if he finished
decoding that secret letter
from the Z Gang already?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
嘿，你为什么不和斐扬的安具浩谈谈，
问问他是否已经破解了那封来自Z集团的秘密信件？

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Oh, Gooho decoded everything?
Let's see... Something about
the Book of Forbidden Mystery... Ah. There we go! The location
of the Z Gang's hideout!
Heh heh! We got 'em!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
哦，安具浩破解了一切？
让我们看看...关于《禁忌之谜之书》...啊。找到了！
Z集团秘密基地的位置！
嘿嘿！我们抓到他们了！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
One of the Rogues followed
the informer carrying this
letter, but he just vanished
during the chase... Like, by
magic, I guess. So we don't
the hideout's exact place.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
一名流氓跟踪了携带这封信的线人，
但他在追逐中消失了...就像
被魔法一样。所以我们不知道
秘密基地的确切位置。

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Even so, we're definitely
sure that it's around the
secret path to the South
Morocc underground. Um,
but we can't let you come
with the Rogue Guild.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
即便如此，我们肯定知道它在
摩洛克南部的地下秘密通道附近。
嗯，但我们不能让你和流氓公会一起
去。

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Sorry, I know, it's official
business and all that hooplah.
Tell you what. We'll each go
hunt them down separately, and
whoever finds 'em first gets
dibs on beating them up!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
抱歉，我知道，这是官方业务之类的。
这样吧。我们各自去追捕他们，
谁先找到他们，谁就有优先权
揍他们一顿！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
We're definitely sure
that the Z Gang's hideout
is near the secret path
to the South Morocc
underground. You
know where that is?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
我们肯定知道Z集团的秘密基地
在摩洛克南部的地下秘密通道附近。
你知道那在哪里吗？

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Tell you what. We'll each go
hunt them down separately, and
whoever finds 'em first gets
dibs on beating them up!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
这样吧。我们各自去追捕他们，
谁先找到他们，谁就有优先权
揍他们一顿！

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Nice work! You captured
the Z Gang! The kingdom
musta given you a really
big reward, huh?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
干得漂亮！你抓住了Z集团！
王国肯定给了你一大笔赏金吧？

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Valdes really wanted to
capture them himself, but
I'm sure he'll be real happy
to hear the news. Maybe he
and I can celebrate with
a little drink later.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
瓦尔德斯本来很想亲自抓住他们，
但听到这个消息他肯定很高兴。
也许之后我和他能小酌一杯庆祝一下。

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
Hey, it's been a real
thrill working with you,
real thrill. Maybe we can
team up again for a good
cause some other time, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
嘿，和你合作真是令人兴奋，
真的非常刺激。希望以后有机会
我们还能为了正义再次联手，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
That Z Gang has been
a pain the Rogue Guild's
ass. No one runs away
from us! Nobody! But...
They can do it somehow.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
那个Z集团真是让流氓公会头疼。
没人能逃过我们的手掌心！
一个都没有！但是...
他们总能做到。

scripts.text:
[Marybell]
There's not much here
that might interest you,
but knock yourself out
if you wanna look around.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽贝尔]
这里没什么特别值得你关注的东西，
不过如果你想四处看看，请便。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Hahaha, now what brings
a youngster like you before
me? You're not here for what
I think you are... Are you?
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
哈哈，是什么风把像你这样的年轻人
吹到我面前来了？
你不会是来找我...做那件事的吧？

scripts.text: Are you the White Meteor?
scripts.translation: 你是白流星吗？

scripts.text: I'm here to challenge you.
scripts.translation: 我来向你挑战。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
It's been so long since
I've heard that name...
I'm retired now, and it
seems no one wants to
challenge me anymore.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
好久没听到这个名字了...
我现在已经退休了，
看来也没人想再挑战我了。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Those were some good
times. Back then, only
Dalho Kwak was able to
give me a real challenge.
I wonder what he's doing now?
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
那是段美好的时光。那时候，
只有达霍·郭能给我真正的挑战。
不知道他现在在做什么？

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
Oh, I was right...!
You're here to challenge
me! It's been a long time...
Alright. I accept. However,
I set all of the terms.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
哦，我猜对了...！
你是来挑战我的！
真是好久不见了...
好吧，我接受。不过，
规则由我来定。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
I'm too old to play the
complicated games I loved
in the past. Let's just
play a simple game that
I call Coin Shake.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
我年纪大了，玩不动过去那些
复杂的游戏了。让我们玩个简单的，
我称之为“摇硬币”的游戏。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
This is basically
a guessing game played
in rounds, best 2 out of 3.
One of us will be the coin
shaker, and the other will
be the guesser.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
这基本上是一个猜谜游戏，
分回合进行，三局两胜。
其中一人负责摇硬币，
另一人负责猜。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
The coin shaker begins
the round by grabbing
a random amount of coins,
shaking them in his closed
hands, and then stopping,
keeping the coins concealed.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
负责摇硬币的人开始回合时，
会抓取随机数量的硬币，
在紧握的双手中摇晃，
然后停下，保持硬币隐藏。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
The other person, the
guesser, will then declare
a guess on whether the total
value of the coins is ^0000FFOdd^000000 or
^0000FFEven^000000. Afterwards, the coin
shaker reveals the coins...
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
另一人，也就是猜的人，
需要猜测硬币的总价值是^0000FF奇数^000000还是
^0000FF偶数^000000。之后，摇硬币的人

have 500 zeny to play

you feel like playing Coin

[安文浩]

500 Zeny都没有吗？
好吧，等你想玩
“摇硬币”的时候，
随时欢迎过来。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
This is basically
a guessing game played
in rounds, best 2 out of 3.
One of us will be the coin
shaker, and the other will
be the guesser.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
这基本上是一个猜谜游戏，
分回合进行，三局两胜。
其中一人负责摇硬币，
另一人负责猜。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
The coin shaker begins
the round by grabbing
a random amount of coins,
shaking them in his closed
hands, and then stopping,
keeping the coins concealed.
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
负责摇硬币的人开始回合时，
会抓取随机数量的硬币，
在紧握的双手中摇晃，
然后停下，保持硬币隐藏。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
The other person, the
guesser, will then declare
a guess on whether the total
value of the coins is ^0000FFOdd^000000 or
^0000FFEven^000000. Afterwards, the coin
shaker reveals the coins...
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
另一人，也就是猜的人，
需要猜测硬币的总价值是^0000FF奇数^000000还是
^0000FF偶数^000000。之后，摇硬币的人
会展示硬币...

[Moonho Ahn]

then he wins the round.
However, if he guessed
wrong, then it's a victory
for the coin shaker.

如果猜的人猜对了，

但是，如果他猜错了，
那就是摇硬币的人获胜。

记得喊出^0000FF奇数^000000或^0000FF偶数^000000。

participation fee. It's
not much, just 500 zeny.

[安文浩]

所以要收取一点参与费。
不多，只要500 Zeny。
我们只是玩玩，
不是要让你破产。

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
I still remember that
last legendary match with
Dalho Kwak. Now that man was
a worthy opponent: he could
read others' hands three times
faster than the normal eye!
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
我仍记得上次
与郭达豪的那场传奇对决。
那位先生是位值得尊敬的对手：
他看穿别人手牌的速度
比常人快三倍！

scripts.text:
[Moonho Ahn]
God, I miss those
days competing against
him. I wonder how he's
been doing lately...
scripts.translation:
[安文浩]
天哪，我真怀念
当年与他竞争的日子。
不知道他最近过得怎么样...

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn]
Oh, hello
adventurer.
Um, was there
something you wanted?
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
哦，你好，冒险者。
呃，有什么事吗？

scripts.text: Rogue Guild's Decoding Request
scripts.translation: 流氓公会的破译委托

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn]
Ah, Marybell sent you?
I see. I've been struggling
trying to decrypt this letter.
Did you want to take a look?
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
啊，是玛丽贝尔派你来的？
原来如此。我一直都在努力破译这封信。
你想来看看吗？

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn]
This looks like a piece
of blank paper, but if you
add just the right amount
of heat and light, you can
read its contents. This is
some powerful encryption!
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
这看起来像是一张白纸，
但如果加上适量的热量和光照，
就能读出里面的内容。这是一种非常强大的加密技术！

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn]
So far, I've only decrypted
just a portion of the letter's
content. Unfortunately, I ran
out of the materials I need to
measure how much light and heat
I need to unlock this message.
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
目前，我只破译了信件内容的一小部分。
不幸的是，我用来测量解锁这条信息所需光照和热量强度的材料用完了。

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn]
I'm pretty swamped over
here, but if you're working
for Marybell, I don't think
you'd mind doing a favor
for me. Would you gather
the materials I need?
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
我这边事情很多，
但既然你是为玛丽贝尔工作的，
我想你不会介意帮我个忙吧。
你能帮我收集我需要的材料吗？

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn]
I need
^0000FF20 Live Coals^000000,
^0000FF1 Matchstick^000000,
^0000FF2 Alcohol^000000, and
^0000FF10 Burning Hearts^000000.

[Gooho Ahn]
Once I have the things
I need, I should be able
to decrypt the rest of
this secret Z Gang letter.
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
一旦我有了需要的东西，
我就应该能破译这封Z Gang秘密信件剩下的部分了。

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn]
So did you bring the
things I need to measure
how much light and heat
I need to reveal the rest
of this secret Z Gang letter?
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]

我需要测量光照和热量，
以揭示这封Z Gang秘密信件剩下的内容。

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn]
Oh, good. Thanks a lot.
Now I should do my part,
and decrypt the rest of
this letter. Mm... Just
give me a second to
make some adjustments...
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
哦，太好了。非常感谢。
现在该我做我的部分了，
破译这封信剩下的部分。
嗯...请给我一点时间
做一些调整...

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn]
Oh, what? This language...
It's ancient! Aegye hasn't
been used in... centuries.
I've seen Aegye used in the
Book of Forbidden Mystery
before it was stolen.
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
哦，什么？这种语言...
它是古老的！Aegye已经几百年
没有被使用过了。
在《禁忌之谜之书》被偷走之前，
我曾见过Aegye被使用。

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn]
There's a legend about
an ancient civilization that
set the foundation for our
modern society. The Aegye
language was considered
a subcultural phenomenon.
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
有一个关于古代文明的传说，
他们奠定了我们现代社会的基础。
Aegye语言被认为是一种亚文化现象。

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn]
Aegye was popular among
children and rebellious
teens, but was considered
vulgar until it entered the
mainstream. Then, somehow...
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
Aegye在儿童和叛逆青少年中很流行，
但在进入主流之前一直被认为是粗俗的。
然后，不知怎的...

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn] 
Aegye destroyed that
ancient people's lingual
system and civilization
once it was popularized.
That is why there is strong
Aegye censorship today.
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
Aegye在普及后摧毁了那个
古代人民的语言体系和文明。
这就是为什么今天对Aegye有严格的审查。

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn] 
In fact, the existence
of Aegye is supposed to
be a huge secret. That
language is responsible
for one of the greatest
disasters of all time.
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
事实上，Aegye的存在
应该是一个巨大的秘密。
这种语言是历史上
最大灾难之一的罪魁祸首。

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn] 
Mm... Let me check...
My knowledge in Aegye
is very limited, so...
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
嗯...让我看看...
我对Aegye的了解非常有限，所以...

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn] 
^0000ffWeii arr prowd Z G gna^000000
^0000ffAynoen hwo sspotp uys^000000
^0000ffwlil eb kckide on htier ssa!^000000
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
^0000ffWeii arr prowd Z G gna^000000
^0000ffAynoen hwo sspotp uys^000000
^0000ffwlil eb kckide on htier ssa!^000000

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn] 
That's the nature
of Aegye: it is chaotic,
and barely legible!
Regardless, this letter
is invaluable as research
material for my studies.
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
这就是Aegye的本质：
它是混乱的，而且几乎无法辨认！
无论如何，这封信作为我研究的
研究材料是无价的。

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn] 
It will be enough
for Marybell if you
deliver the message to
her verbatim. Listen
to me carefully, and
maybe write this down.
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
只要原封不动地把信交给玛丽贝尔就够了。
请仔细听我说，
也许最好把它记下来。

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn] 
^0000ffWeii arr prowd Z G gna^000000
^0000ffAynoen hwo sspotp uys^000000
^0000ffwlil eb kckide on htier ssa!^000000
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
^0000ffWeii arr prowd Z G gna^000000
^0000ffAynoen hwo sspotp uys^000000
^0000ffwlil eb kckide on htier ssa!^000000

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn]
Please hurry!
I'm sure Marybell is
waiting to learn the
whereabouts of the Z Gang,
and this letter might have
a clue. Oh, and remember...
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
请快点！
玛丽贝尔肯定在等着
得知Z帮的下落，
这封信里可能有线索。
哦，对了，别忘了...

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn] 
I need
^0000FF20 Live Coals^000000,
^0000FF1 Matchstick^000000,
^0000FF2 Alcohol^000000, and
^0000FF10 Burning Hearts^000000.

[Gooho Ahn]
Once I have the things
I need, I should be able
to decrypt the rest of
this secret Z Gang letter.
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
一旦我有了需要的东西，
我就应该能破译这封Z Gang秘密信件剩下的部分了。

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn] 
Please tell Marybell
the contents of the
Z Gang's letter so that
I can keep the original
document for research purposes.
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
请把Z帮信件的内容
转告玛丽贝尔，
这样我就可以保留原件
用于研究了。

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn] 
^0000ffWeii arr prowd Z G gna^000000
^0000ffAynoen hwo sspotp uys^000000
^0000ffwlil eb kckide on htier ssa!^000000
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
^0000ffWeii arr prowd Z G gna^000000
^0000ffAynoen hwo sspotp uys^000000
^0000ffwlil eb kckide on htier ssa!^000000

scripts.text:
[Gooho Ahn] 
Encryption is the art of
hiding truth in layers of
secrecy. My specialty is
in unraveling the truth
by breaking encryption.
scripts.translation:
[安具浩]
加密的艺术在于
用层层秘密隐藏真相。
我的专长是通过
破解加密来还原真相。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
... ...

[{0}]
Something's not quite
right. I should come back
and investigate this area
later when there are fewer
people watching...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有些不对劲。
我应该等这里人少一点的时候
再回来调查一下...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Nuts! I was supposed
to try to do this secretly!
I better try to investigate
this area again when no
one is around here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
该死！我本来
是想悄悄做的！
最好等这里没人的时候
再回来调查一次。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Haha! Got you!
You're an informer for
the Z Gang, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哈哈！抓住你了！
你是Z帮的线人，对吧？

scripts.text:
[????]
I... I... d-don't
know what you're
talking about!
I'm innocent!
scripts.translation:
[????]
我...我...不...不知道
你在说什么！
我是无辜的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then you're telling
me this note didn't
just fall out of your
pocket? What's this
about trying to kill me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那你是说这张纸条
不是刚从你口袋里掉出来的？
这上面说要杀我是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[????]
Th-that's...
I'm not--That...!

[{0}]
You better confess, or
I'll drag you over to the
Prontera Knightage or the
Rogue Guild to take care
of you. In fact, let's just
head over to Prontera...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你最好招供，
否则我就把你拖到
普隆德拉骑士团或流氓公会
去处理你。
其实，我们直接去普隆德拉吧...

scripts.text:
[Z Gang Informer]
N-no! I'll tell you
everything! Please!
My mother's old! I've
got kids to feed!
I... I can't go to jail!
scripts.translation:
[Z帮线人]
不...不！我会告诉
你一切的！求你了！
我母亲年纪大了！
我还要养家糊口！
我...我不能坐牢！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright.
Let's start by you
telling me where
I can find the Z Gang.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧。
先从告诉我
我在哪里能找到Z帮开始吧。

scripts.text:
[Z Gang Informer]
I... I really don't
know where to find them.
I'm at the bottom of the
food chain, I just follow
their written instructions.
scripts.translation:
[Z帮线人]
我...我真的不知道
他们在哪里。
我在食物链的最底端，
我只是按照他们的书面指示行事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know what?
Never mind. I'm won't
take you to be jailed by
the Prontera Knights.
I'll drop you off
at the Rogues.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道吗？
算了。我不会把你交给
普隆德拉骑士团坐牢。
我会把你交给流氓公会。

scripts.text:
[Z Gang Informer]
...............................
Their secret hideout is in
South Morocc, and you can't
enter the place without the
secret password.
scripts.translation:
[Z帮线人]
...............................
他们的秘密据点在
南莫洛奇，
没有秘密口令
是进不去的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Nice. Now, you better
stop running with the
Z Gang. Otherwise, I'm
not going to be so merciful
the next time I see you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很好。现在，你最好别再跟Z帮混了。
否则下次再见到你，
我可不会这么仁慈了。

scripts.text:
[Z Gang Informer]
Anything you want!
J-just let me liiive!
scripts.translation:
[Z帮线人]
您想让我做什么都行！
求...求您让我活命吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I should head back to
Marybell, and see if she's
learned any new information.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我该回去找玛丽贝尔，
看看她有没有打听到什么新消息。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
What? Get lost!
Listen, you don't
want to mess with
me. Just. Don't.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
什么？滚开！
听着，你最好别惹我。
就是...别惹我。

scripts.text:
[Thug]
What? Get lost!
Listen, you don't
want to mess with
me. Just. Don't.
scripts.translation:
[恶棍]
什么？滚开！
听着，你最好别惹我。
就是...别惹我。

scripts.text:
[Z Gang Informer]
Whoa, leave me alone!
I'm just standing here
on the road, I didn't
do anything wrong!
scripts.translation:
[Z帮线人]
哇，别缠着我！
我只是站在路边，
我什么都没做错啊！

scripts.text:
[Former Z Gang Informer]
You don't have to
worry about me anymore.
I've turned over a new
leaf, got a real job,
that sort of deal.
scripts.translation:
[前Z帮线人]
您不用再担心我了。
我已经改过自新，
找了份正经工作，
就这样。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
What? Get lost!
Listen, you don't
want to mess with
me. Just. Don't.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
什么？滚开！
听着，你最好别惹我。
就是...别惹我。

scripts.text:
[Thug]
What? Get lost!
Listen, you don't
want to mess with
me. Just. Don't.
scripts.translation:
[恶棍]
什么？滚开！
听着，你最好别惹我。
就是...别惹我。

scripts.text:
[????]
I know you've
been pursuing us!
Grrrr... DIE NOW!
scripts.translation:
[????]
我知道你们一直在追查我们！
嘎嘎嘎...现在就去死吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wh-who are you?

[????]
Y-you're stronger
than I thought!
Run awaaaaay!
scripts.translation:
[????]
你...你比我想象的更强！
快逃啊啊啊！

scripts.text:
[{0}] 
Huh? That man must
have dropped this
note in his haste
to get away from here.
Let's see what it says...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？那个男人匆忙逃跑时
一定掉了这张纸条。
让我看看上面写了什么...

scripts.text:
^666666Kill {0}, meow.
That arrogant do-gooder
is looking into us too much.
Fail to kill him, and death
will be too good for you, meow.^000000
scripts.translation:
^666666杀掉{0}，喵。
那个自命不凡的多管闲事者
对我们查得太紧了。
如果杀不成他，
你就死定了，喵。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That must have been
an informer for the Z Gang.
He can't have gotten too far:
I have a chance to catch him!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那一定是Z帮的线人。
他应该跑不远：
我有机会抓住他！

scripts.text:
[Odd Slab]
^FF0000*Creak Creak*
Etner sspawrod.^000000
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的石板]
^FF0000*吱呀吱呀*
Etner sspawrod.^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This slab is speaking
to me! I... I think. Now
where have I heard
talking like this before?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这块石板在跟我说话！
我...我觉得是这样。
我刚才在哪里听过这种说话方式？

scripts.text:
[Odd Slab]
^FF0000*Creak Creak*
Etner sspawrod.^000000
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的石板]
^FF0000*吱呀吱呀*
Etner sspawrod.^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, right! This is that
trashy language, Aegye,
that Gooho Ahn told me
about. It still sounds
like... A poor excuse
for language to me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，对了！这是安具浩告诉我的
那种粗俗的语言，Aegye。
听起来还是像...一种蹩脚的方言。

scripts.text:
[Odd Slab]
^FF0000*Creak Creak*
Etner sspawrod.^000000
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的石板]
^FF0000*吱呀吱呀*
Etner sspawrod.^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I guess
I should talk to it. Um...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我想我应该跟它说说话。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Odd Slab]
^FF0000*Creak Creak*
Etner n2d sspawrod.^000000
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的石板]
^FF0000*吱呀吱呀*
Etner n2d sspawrod.^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa! It's saying
something different now!
I must be doing alright.
Now what do I say?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇！它现在说的不一样了！
看来我做得不错。
那我该说什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Odd Slab]
^FF0000*Creak Creak*
Etner r3d sspawrod.^000000
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的石板]
^FF0000*吱呀吱呀*
Etner r3d sspawrod.^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Heh! I'm on the right
track. Now what do I say?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿！我找对方向了。
那接下来该说什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Odd Slab]
*Creak Creak*
*Creak Creak*
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的石板]
*吱呀吱呀*
*吱呀吱呀*

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um... Now what...?
Waaaah! Waaah!
scripts.translation: 哇啊啊！哇啊！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What th--?! What's
happening?! I'm being
sucked away somewhere!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什...什么？！
发生什么事了？！
我好像被吸到什么地方去了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hm? Did I do something
wrong? It just stopped
working all of a sudden.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯？我是不是做错了什么？
它突然就不起作用了。

scripts.text:
[Odd Slab]
^FF0000Rrsoy, rrsoy.
Ai cn'at elt yoo ni ofr nwo. Plzea ecmo ckba tela.^000000
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的石板]
^FF0000Rrsoy, rrsoy.
Ai cn'at elt yoo ni ofr nwo. Plzea ecmo ckba tela.^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think...
I think I should
try this again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想...
我想我应该再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Odd Slab]
^666666*Pzzzzz*^000000

[{0}]
Huh? This talking slab
thing isn't working now.
Hello? What happened to you?
Hey! Talk to me, will you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？这个会说话的石板
现在又不行了。
喂？你怎么了？
嘿！跟我说话啊！

scripts.text:
[Odd Slab]
^666666*Pzzzzz*^000000

[{0}]
Huh? This talking slab
thing isn't working now.
Hello? What happened to you?
Hey! Talk to me, will you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？这个会说话的石板
现在又不行了。
喂？你怎么了？
嘿！跟我说话啊！

scripts.text:
[Odd Slab]
^666666*Pzzzzz*^000000

[{0}]
Huh? This talking slab
thing isn't working now.
Hello? What happened to you?
Hey! Talk to me, will you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？这个会说话的石板
现在又不行了。
喂？你怎么了？
嘿！跟我说话啊！

scripts.text:
[Odd Slab]
*Creak Creak*
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的石板]
*吱呀吱呀*

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This slab looks pretty
strange. Is it making
noises? Hmm... Maybe this
is a clue to the Z Gang!
I'll come back later
to investigate this~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这块石板看起来很奇怪。
它在发出声音吗？嗯...
也许这是Z帮的线索！
我稍后再回来调查一下~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This used to be
where the Z Gang
would hide out.
Good riddance!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这里曾经是
Z帮藏身的地方。
终于清除了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is a peculiar
looking slab. It sounds
like... What are those
noises? Huh. Weird.
It's like it's just
talking gibberish.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这块石板看起来
很特别。听起来像...
那是什么声音？
嗯。好奇怪。
它好像只是在胡言乱语。

scripts.text: ^FF0000*Creak Creak*^000000

[{0}]
Did I just...
Hear something
around here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我刚才...
是不是听到
附近有什么声音？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where am I...?
Something has gone
terribly wrong, hasn't
it? Let me go baaaack~!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在哪里...？
一定出了什么大错，
对吧？让我回...回去吧~！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where am I...?
Something has gone
terribly wrong, hasn't
it? Let me go baaaack~!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在哪里...？
一定出了什么大错，
对吧？让我回...回去吧~！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You cowardly Z Gang!
Come out and surrender!
I've defeated your monster
soldiers already!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你们这些胆小的Z帮！
出来投降吧！
我已经打败你们的
魔物士兵了！

scripts.text:
[Martha]
What should we do?
scripts.translation:
[玛莎]
我们该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Catfoii]
This is our greatest
crisis ever! I don't
know what to do, meow!
scripts.translation:
[卡特福伊]
这是我们面临的最大危机！
我都不知道该怎么办了，喵！

scripts.text:
[Louis]
The Z Gang's not going
to surrender yet! Come
forth, my loyal servants
of the darkness!
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
Z帮是不会轻易投降的！
出来吧，我黑暗中的忠实仆从们！

scripts.text:
[Catfoii]
No-no-no-meow!
Not that button!
scripts.translation:
[卡特福伊]
不不不不喵！
别按那个按钮！

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Huh? Why...?
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
咦？为什么...？

scripts.text:
[Louis]
You mess with the
Z Gang, you--wait.
Let's just do this later.
You know, when you're carrying
fewer items with you. Then,
we can rumble in peace.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
你竟然敢招惹Z帮，你——等等。
这事我们改天再算吧。
就是那种，你身上带的东西少一点的时候。
到时候，我们再好好较量一番。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
What happened?
The big guns were
supposed to come out!
Why aren't we invisible
anymore? What happened?
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
怎么回事？
那些大家伙应该已经出来了才对！
为什么我们的透明术失效了？
到底发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[Catfoii]
You pushed the button
to turn off the invisibility,
meow! Did you really have
to ask?! It's your fault!
scripts.translation:
[卡特福伊]
是你按下了关闭透明术的按钮，喵！
你居然还要问吗？！都是你的错！

scripts.text:
[Martha]
Argh! I should never
have trusted that fool!
scripts.translation:
[玛莎]
可恶！我就不该相信那个蠢货！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So... Z Gang...
And cat. It's time
to turn you in.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么... Z帮...
还有猫。
是时候把你们交出去了。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
I... I can't accept
our defeat! The Z Gang
won't go down so easily!
Come forth, my demon
spawn minions of doom!
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
我...我无法接受失败！
Z帮不会这么轻易倒下的！
出来吧，我那些带来灾厄的恶魔后裔仆从们！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think
they're coming.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得它们不会来了。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
...............................
We surrender. Argh, but
we were so close to
conquering the world!

[{0}]
Now if you'll just
hand over the Book
of Forbidden Mystery...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在，只要你们把
《禁忌之谜之书》交出来...

scripts.text:
[Catfoii]
Louis, meow!
Don't do it!
scripts.translation:
[卡特福伊]
路易斯，喵！
别这么做！

scripts.text:
[Martha]
Let's just surrender,
Louis. It looks like
the Z Gang is finished.
scripts.translation:
[玛莎]
路易斯，投降吧。
看起来Z帮已经完蛋了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyway, the Rogue Guild
is on its way to come get
you guys. You won't be able
to escape this time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
总之，流氓公会的人
正在赶来抓你们。
这次你们逃不掉了。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Awwww, man!
Fine, take the stupid
ol' book. I couldn't
use it that good anyway.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
哎呀，真是的！
好吧，把那本破书拿走。
反正我也用不好它。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Catfoii, would you
lead this adventurer guy
to the exit? I can't bear
to look at the face that's
caused my tragic downfall...
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
卡特福伊，
你带这位冒险者去出口吧。
我实在不忍心看着
导致我悲剧性失败的那张脸...

scripts.text:
[Catfoii]
Fine, meow.
I understand.
But how did we lose?!
scripts.translation:
[卡特福伊]
好吧，喵。
我明白了。
但我们是怎么输的？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where am I...?
Something has gone
terribly wrong, hasn't
it? Let me go baaaack~!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在哪里...？
一定出了什么大错，
对吧？让我回...回去吧~！

scripts.text:
[Martha]
Hey, you're carrying
too much stuff. You'd
better put some of your
items away first in Kafra
Storage or something.
scripts.translation:
[玛莎]
嘿，你带的东西太多了。
最好先把一些物品存到卡普拉仓库里。

scripts.text:
[Martha]
Argh...! What'd 
you do, Louis?
scripts.translation:
[玛莎]
啊...！
路易斯，你干了什么？

scripts.text:
[Louis]
What happened?
The big guns were
supposed to come out!
Why aren't we invisible
anymore? What happened?
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
怎么回事？
那些大家伙应该已经出来了才对！
为什么我们的透明术失效了？
到底发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[Catfoii]
You pushed the button
to turn off the invisibility,
meow! Did you really have
to ask?! It's your fault!
scripts.translation:
[卡特福伊]
是你按下了关闭透明术的按钮，喵！
你居然还要问吗？！都是你的错！

scripts.text:
[Martha]
Argh! I should never
have trusted that fool!
scripts.translation:
[玛莎]
可恶！我就不该相信那个蠢货！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So... Z Gang...
And cat. It's time
to turn you in.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么... Z帮...
还有猫。
是时候把你们交出去了。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
I... I can't accept
our defeat! The Z Gang
won't go down so easily!
Come forth, my demon
spawn minions of doom!
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
我...我无法接受失败！
Z帮不会这么轻易倒下的！
出来吧，我那些带来灾厄的恶魔后裔仆从们！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think
they're coming.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得它们不会来了。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
...............................
We surrender. Argh, but
we were so close to
conquering the world!

[{0}]
Now if you'll just
hand over the Book
of Forbidden Mystery...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在，只要你们把
《禁忌之谜之书》交出来...

scripts.text:
[Catfoii]
Louis, meow!
Don't do it!
scripts.translation:
[卡特福伊]
路易斯，喵！
别这么做！

scripts.text:
[Martha]
Let's just surrender,
Louis. It looks like
the Z Gang is finished.
scripts.translation:
[玛莎]
路易斯，投降吧。
看起来Z帮已经完蛋了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyway, the Rogue Guild
is on its way to come get
you guys. You won't be able
to escape this time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
总之，流氓公会的人
正在赶来抓你们。
这次你们逃不掉了。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Awwww, man!
Fine, take the stupid
ol' book. I couldn't
use it that good anyway.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
哎呀，真是的！
好吧，把那本破书拿走。
反正我也用不好它。

scripts.text:
[Louis]
Catfoii, would you
lead this adventurer guy
to the exit? I can't bear
to look at the face that's
caused my tragic downfall...
scripts.translation:
[路易斯]
卡特福伊，
你带这位冒险者去出口吧。
我实在不忍心看着
导致我悲剧性失败的那张脸...

scripts.text:
[Catfoii]
Fine, meow.
I understand.
But how did we lose?!
scripts.translation:
[卡特福伊]
好吧，喵。
我明白了。
但我们是怎么输的？！

scripts.translation:

一定出了什么大错，
对吧？让我回...回去吧~！

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
H-hello? Would you help me?
You'd be saving this poor man's
life if you would just do me
this favor. Please...
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
你...你好？能帮帮我吗？
如果你能帮这个小忙，
就等于救了这个可怜人的命。
拜托了...

scripts.text: How may I help you?
scripts.translation: 有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Ignore Him
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay, what can I do to help?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我能怎么帮你？

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
Oh, thank you so much!
It feels so good to talk to
someone after being ignored
all this time! I might appear to
be a beggar, but I'm actually a
treasure hunter from Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
哦，太感谢了！
被无视了这么久，
终于能和人说说话了，感觉真好！
我看起来像个乞丐，
但其实我是来自普隆德拉的寻宝猎人。

scripts.text: Umm... So?
scripts.translation: 嗯...然后呢？

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
I was so sure I could find
the treasure here in Morocc
when I first started... I did
all my research and prep work.
But after hiring teams of other
hunters and researchers...
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
刚开始的时候，
我很确信能在莫洛奇找到宝藏...
我做了所有的研究和准备工作。
但在雇佣了其他猎人和研究员的团队后...

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
I've spent my entire fortune,
and I'm still not any closer
to finding that treasure.
I... I don't even have enough
money to go back home!
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
我花光了所有的积蓄，
却离找到宝藏越来越远。
我...我甚至没有足够的钱回家！

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
Won't you spare some
money, so that I can finally
go back home to Prontera?
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
你能不能施舍一点钱，
让我终于能回到普隆德拉的家？

scripts.text: Why don't you just walk?
scripts.translation: 你怎么不自己走回去？

scripts.text: I can give you some money.
scripts.translation: 我可以给你一些钱。

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
What? You don't think that
if I could walk to Prontera,
I'd have done it already?!
Why would I even bother to
beg for money? Fine, I don't
need your brand of sympathy.
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
什么？你不觉得如果我能走回普隆德拉，
早就走了吗？！
我为什么要乞讨？
算了，我不需要你这副同情的样子。

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
You know, I had a hot tip
that I was going to let you
in on, but if you don't want
to share, then neither do I!
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
你知道吗，我本来有个好线索要告诉你的，
但如果你不想分享，那我也不分享！

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
Oh, thank you!
Anything you can spare,
I'll gladly appreciate!
God bless you, bless you!
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
哦，谢谢你！
你能给多少我都感激不尽！
上帝保佑你，保佑你！

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
Umm... Oh, dear...
You're just as bad off
as I am. I appreciate it,
but I can't take your money.
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
嗯...哎呀...
你的处境和我一样糟糕。
我很感激，但我不能收你的钱。

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
It's a shame, really.
If you had given me 1,200
zeny, I would have tipped
you off to something big...
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
真可惜。
如果你给我1,200 Zeny，
我本来可以告诉你一个大秘密...

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
Let's see... I just need
1,200 zeny. That's enough
for me to go back home.
Now, I can't let you just
give me money and let you
leave empty handed, can I?
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
让我想想...我只需要1,200 Zeny。
这就够我回家了。
不过，我不能让你白白给我钱然后空手离开，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
Remember that hidden
treasure I was looking for?
There's a rumor that it's
location has finally been
confirmed. Why don't you
try finding it for yourself?
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
还记得我一直在找的那个隐藏宝藏吗？
有传言说它的位置终于被确认了。
你要不要自己去找找看？

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
I'd rather that it end up in
the hands of someone like
you than a rival treasure
hunter. This hunter that
stays north in town apparently confirmed the treasure's location.
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
我宁愿它落入你这样的人手中，
也不愿落入竞争对手寻宝猎人手里。
听说住在城镇北边的那个猎人，
似乎已经确认了宝藏的位置。

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
Now, I hear that this guy
hasn't returned home yet,
and he still hasn't found
the treasure. He's probably
run into a pretty bad snag.
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
我听说这家伙还没回家，
而且至今还没找到宝藏。
他大概是遇到了不小的麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
I doubt that he'll let you
know the treasure's location
easily, but who knows? Maybe
he might slip, and accidentally
give you some kind of clue.
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
我怀疑他不会轻易告诉你宝藏的位置，
但谁知道呢？也许他会失言，
不小心给你透露一点线索。

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
Please! Please, wait!
You're an adventurer, aren't
you? I have some valuable
information to share if you'd
just spare me some... Hey!
Come back! No... I just...
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
求求你！请等等！
你是一名冒险者，对吧？
如果你能分我一点...嘿！
回来！不...我只是...

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
Oh, I remember you.
You must really want that
treasure now, do you? Just
give me 1,200 zeny for me
to go back home, and I'll
tell you everything I know.
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
哦，我记得你。
你现在一定很想要那个宝藏吧？
只要给我1,200 Zeny让我回家，
我就把我知道的一切都告诉你。

scripts.text: Give Money
scripts.translation: 给钱

scripts.text: Don't Give Money
scripts.translation: 不给钱

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
Ah, good choice!
And thank you so much.
It'll be great to finally be
back home in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
啊，好选择！
非常感谢你。
终于能回到普隆德拉的家了，
真是太好了。

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
What th--?! This isn't
enough money for me to go
back home! Well, just come
back later once you scrounge
up the funds. I'll be waiting.
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
什...什么？！
这点钱不够我回家的！
等你筹够钱后再来吧。
我会在这里等你的。

treasure I was looking for?

location has finally been
confirmed. Why don't you
try finding it for yourself?

he hands of someone like

scripts.text:

Now, I hear that this guy
hasn't returned home yet,

the treasure. He's probably
run into a pretty big snag.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
I doubt that he'll let you
know the treasure's location
easily, but who knows? Maybe
he might slip, and accidentally
give you some kind of clue.
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
我怀疑他不会轻易告诉你宝藏的位置，
但谁知道呢？也许他会失言，
不小心给你透露一点线索。

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
Fine, have it your way.
I admit that I'm a little
disappointed in you. Aren't
you adventurers supposed
to be heroes to the people?
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
好吧，随你吧。
我承认我对你有点失望。
你们冒险者不应该是人民的英雄吗？

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
Oh, you're back?
Ah, you must be having
trouble finding that guy
I was talking about. He's
just in the northern part of this town. It can't be that hard.
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
哦，你回来了？
啊，你肯定是在找我说的那个人吧。
他就在这座城镇的北边。应该不难找的。

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
You found the treasure?!
It... It really exists...
I'm sorry, it's just been
my dream to... I feel like
crying... Oh, God... I don't
know what this feeling is...
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
你找到宝藏了？！
它...它真的存在...
对不起，这只是我的梦想...我快哭了...
哦，天哪...我不知道这是什么感觉...

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
I mean... I feel so
damned happy, but...
I spent my entire fortune...
Ruined my whole life just
to see that treasure...
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
我是说...我感到无比幸福，但是...
我花光了所有的积蓄...
为了看到那个宝藏，毁了我的一生...

scripts.text:
[Ragged Man]
So how's the treasure
hunt coming along? I hope
you have better luck than
I did. Still, I've got a pretty good feeling that you'll find it.
scripts.translation:
[衣衫褴褛的男子]
寻宝进展得怎么样了？
希望你比我运气好。
不过，我有一种预感，你会找到的。

scripts.text:
[Man]
What do you want?
Just leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
你想干什么？
别来烦我。

scripts.text:
[Man]
What do you want?
Just leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
你想干什么？
别来烦我。

scripts.text: Tell me about the treasure.
scripts.translation: 告诉我关于宝藏的事

scripts.text:
[Man]
What? So you're the one
I was warned about! I've
been wondering when you'd
show up. Prepare to die!
scripts.translation:
[男子]
什么？原来你就是那个被警告过的人！
我一直在等你出现。准备受死吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Umm... Excuse me?
I've just heard that you
confirmed the location of
some amazing treasure,
and I just wanted to ask
you more about it. That's all!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...打扰一下？
我刚听说你确认了某个惊人宝藏的位置，
只是想多了解一些情况。仅此而已！

scripts.text:
[Man]
What? If you're just here
for that, then how'd you
find out about me and
the treasure? Not just
everyone knows about it.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
什么？如果你只是来打听这个的，那你又是从哪里知道我和宝藏的事的？
又不是人人都知道这件事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I was talking to
this other treasure hunter
who's... Well, he's kind
of a beggar now...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我之前和另一个寻宝者聊过天，他...嗯，他现在算是个乞丐了...

scripts.text:
[Man]
Oh. That old man?
Well, I don't know if the
treasure he was looking
for and the one I've found
are the same one. But
yeah, I know that guy.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
哦，那个老人？
我不知道他找的宝藏和我找到的是不是同一个。不过，我确实认识那个人。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Alright. So I found this
treasure, but I have no way
of digging it up. Maybe we
can help each other. I need
money, and you want to know
more, right? Let's cut a deal.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
好吧。我找到了这个宝藏，但我没办法把它挖出来。
也许我们可以互相帮助。我需要钱，你也想知道更多，对吧？
我们做个交易吧。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text: What'd you have in mind?
scripts.translation: 你有什么打算？

scripts.text:
[Man]
No? Well...
There's no reason for
you to trust me now,
I suppose. But what can
you gain by walking away?
scripts.translation:
[男子]
不？好吧...
我想你现在也没有理由信任我。
但如果你现在走开，又能得到什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Man]
Let me lay it out for you.
I've been hired to find this
treasure by some people:
they said I can take whatever
I find, but they specifically
want one item for themselves.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
让我给你解释一下。
有人雇我来找这个宝藏：
他们说我可以拿走我找到的任何东西，但他们特别想要其中一件物品留给自己。

scripts.text:
[Man]
They pay me on delivery
so I haven't seen a dime yet.
Now, my agreement with them
is conditional. I can't dig
up the treasure so they'll
understand if I say I failed.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
他们是在交货后才付钱的，所以我到现在还没见到一分钱。
而且我和他们的协议是有条件的。既然我挖不出宝藏，他们应该能理解我任务失败这件事。

scripts.text:
[Man]
But if you dig it up, you can
keep everything. Sound good?
All I want is some stuff from
you to make all my efforts up
till now worth my while.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
但如果你把它挖出来，你可以保留所有东西。听起来不错吧？
我只想要你的一些东西，来弥补我之前的努力。

scripts.text:
[Man]
In other words,
if you bring me,
^FF000020 Mementos^000000,
^FF00002 Pearls^000000, and
^FF00002 Zargons^000000, we can talk
business further. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[男子]
换句话说，
如果你给我
^FF000020个纪念品^000000、
^FF00002颗珍珠^000000，以及
^FF00002个刹勒空结晶^000000，我们就能进一步谈生意。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Man]
Hey, I might be losing out
by giving up my share of that
treasure, but hey, a bird in
the hand's always worth more.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
嘿，虽然我放弃了那份宝藏的份额，但嘿，落袋为安总是更好的。

scripts.text:
[Man]
You again? Lemme guess...
You're reconsidering that
deal I had in mind, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[男子]
又是你？让我猜猜...
你是在重新考虑我提出的那个交易，对吧？

scripts.text: No, not really.
scripts.translation: 不，不是。

scripts.text: I guess so.
scripts.translation: 我想是的。

scripts.text:
[Man]
You sure? No one would
be losing in this deal, you
know. Well, except the guys
that hired me to find that
treasure. It's pretty much
a win-win situation.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
你确定吗？在这笔交易中没有人会吃亏，你知道吗。
嗯，除了那些雇我来找宝藏的家伙。这基本上是一个双赢的局面。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Way I figure it,
someone ought to get
that treasure. I can't
dig it up, but maybe
someone like you can...
scripts.translation:
[男子]
在我看来，
总得有人得到那个宝藏。我挖不出来，但也许像你这样的人可以...

scripts.text:
[Man]
Let me lay it out for you.
I've been hired to find this
treasure by some people:
they said I can take whatever
I find, but they specifically
want one item for themselves.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
让我给你解释一下。
有人雇我来找这个宝藏：

All I want is some stuff from

till now worth my while.
scripts.translation:

但如果你把它挖出来，你可以保留所有东西。听起来不错吧？
我只想要你的一些东西，来弥补我之前的努力。

[Man]
In other words,
if you bring me,

^FF00002 Pearls^000000, and

scripts.translation:
[男子]
换句话说，
如果你给我
^FF000020个纪念品^000000、
^FF00002颗珍珠^000000，以及
^FF00002个刹勒空结晶^000000，我们就能进一步谈生意。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Man]
Hey, I might be losing out
