treasure, but hey, a bird in
the hand's always worth more.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
嘿，虽然我放弃了那份宝藏的份额，但嘿，落袋为安总是更好的。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Back again, huh?
So did you bring
the stuff I asked?
scripts.translation:
[男子]
又回来了，是吗？
那你带来我要求的东西了吗？

scripts.text:
[Man]
Nice. You did your part.
And now it's time that
I fulfilled my part of
this bargain. Listen up.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
很好。你完成了你的部分。
现在轮到我履行我在这笔交易中的承诺了。听好了。

scripts.text:
[Man]
The treasure is buried
south of Morocc. Use the
south gate to leave town,
and then head to the next
field to the south. From
there, you're on your own.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
宝藏埋在莫洛克的南边。使用南门离开城镇，
然后向南走到下一个野外区域。从那里开始，就要靠你自己了。

scripts.text:
[Man]
I don't know exactly
where the treasure is
buried, but you should
be able to find it within
that general area. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
我不知道宝藏具体埋在哪里，但你应该能在该区域内找到它。祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Huh, you must have
forgotten what I wanted.
I'm not really asking you
for extremely valuable stuff
here. Anyway, listen up.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
哈，你肯定忘了我要什么了。
我并不是在向你索要极其贵重的东西。总之，听好了。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Just bring me,
^FF000020 Mementos^000000,
^FF00002 Pearls^000000, and
^FF00002 Zargons^000000 so we can talk
business further. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[男子]
只要给我
^FF000020个纪念品^000000、
^FF00002颗珍珠^000000和
^FF00002个刹勒空结晶^000000，
我们就能进一步谈生意。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Man]
What are you still doing
here? Shouldn't you be
looking for the treasure?
scripts.translation:
[男子]
你还在这里干什么？
不应该去找宝藏吗？

scripts.text:
[Man]
What are you still doing
here? Shouldn't you be
looking for the treasure?
scripts.translation:
[男子]
你还在这里干什么？
不应该去找宝藏吗？

scripts.text: I already found it, but...
scripts.translation: 我已经找到了，但是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I already found it, but...
It won't budge at all!
I think it's protected by
magic. Do you know
anything about that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我已经找到了，但是...
它完全纹丝不动！
我觉得它被魔法保护着。
你知道关于这方面的事情吗？

scripts.text:
[Man]
Wow, you actually found
it? Heh, you're better than
I thought. Sorry about that.
I didn't explain the magic
part since... Well, I didn't
think you'd get that far.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
哇，你居然真的找到了？
呵，你比我想象的厉害。
抱歉，我没解释魔法的部分，因为...好吧，
我没想到你能走到这一步。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Anyway, I had problems
with that magic too. Some
guy was supposed to help me
with that, but he didn't come.
I've been so frustrated!
scripts.translation:
[男子]
总之，我也被那个魔法搞得很头疼。
本来有个家伙说要帮我处理这个，
但他没来。我真是受够了！

scripts.text:
[Man]
I mean, I have no clue
when it comes to magic, and
I don't understand how I'm
supposed to use this thing
my clients gave to me.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
我是说，我对魔法一窍不通，
也不明白该怎么使用
我委托人给我的这个东西。

scripts.text: Who was going to help you?
scripts.translation: 谁本来要帮你？

scripts.text: Your clients gave you something?
scripts.translation: 你的委托人给了你什么东西？

scripts.text:
[Man]
Oh, yeah. The guys that
hired me said that if I waited
at the treasure site, someone
would eventually come to help
me out on the magic end.
I don't know who he is, though.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
哦，对。雇我的人说，
如果我在宝藏所在地等待，
最终会有人来帮我解决魔法的问题。
不过我不知道他是谁。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Oh, yeah. They mentioned
something about him coming
a bit from the west. Maybe
he's over in Comodo?
scripts.translation:
[男子]
哦，对。他们提到
那个人会从西边过来。
也许他在克魔岛那边？

scripts.text:
[Man]
Oh, yeah. They gave me
this weird document labeled
''^FF0000[Open^000000.'' I don't know how
to use it at all, though.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
哦，对。他们给了我
一份奇怪的文档，上面写着
''^FF0000[开启^000000''。
但我完全不知道该怎么用它。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Oh, yeah. They gave me
this weird document labeled
''^FF0000[Unlock^000000.'' I don't know how
to use it at all, though.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
哦，对。他们给了我
一份奇怪的文档，上面写着
''^FF0000[解锁^000000''。
但我完全不知道该怎么用它。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Oh, yeah. Let's see here.
Ah, here's the document
that they gave me. It's kind
of a bit torn, though.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
哦，对。让我看看。
啊，这就是他们给我的文档。
不过它有点破损了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe torn document
is labeled ''^FF0000[Open^3355FF.''^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF那份破损的文档
上面写着''^FF0000[开启^3355FF''。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe torn document
is labeled ''^FF0000[Unlock^3355FF.''^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF那份破损的文档
上面写着''^FF0000[解锁^3355FF''。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, how could you not
know how to use this?
Didn't you get a chance
to talk to your clients?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，你怎么会不知道怎么用这个？
你没机会和你的委托人谈谈吗？

scripts.text:
[Man]
I haven't even met them.
I just get their instructions
through the mail. Everything
is through a medium with these
guys. I guess they've got their
eyes on me too, but whatever.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
我甚至没见过他们。
我只是通过邮件收到他们的指示。
和这些人打交道，一切都得通过中间人。
我想他们也在监视我，但无所谓了。

scripts.text:
[Man]
I guess they hired me because
they really want the treasure,
but don't want to tip anyone
off that they're looking for 
it, or that they have it.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
我想他们雇我是因为他们
真的很想要那个宝藏，
但不想让人知道他们在找它，
或者他们已经得到了它。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Anyway, all I know is that
this piece of paper is supposed
to do something. But I guess
I'm not smart enough to figure
it out. Maybe you'll have
better luck with them.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
总之，我只知道
这张纸应该能起什么作用。
但我想我脑子不够用，搞不懂。
也许你和他们打交道会更顺利。

scripts.text:
[Man]
You know, if you can actually
find that guy who was supposed
to help me but never showed up,
maybe he'll understand how to
use that document. Go ahead
and take 'em. Good luck, now.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
你知道吗，如果你能找到那个本该帮我却一直没露面的人，
也许他会知道怎么用那份文档。
拿去用吧。祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Man]
I already told you everything
I know. You'd be better off
finding that guy over in
Comodo, or the rest of
that torn document.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
我已经把我知道的都告诉你了。
你最好去克魔岛找找那个人，
或者找找那份破损文档的其余部分。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Now that I think about it,
maybe the treasure can be
obtained by two people?
I mean, they planned for
me to go with that guy. Eh,
best not to think about it.
scripts.translation:
[男子]
这么一想，
也许宝藏需要两个人才能拿到？
我是说，他们原本计划让我和那个人一起去。
算了，还是别想这些了。

scripts.text:
[Man]
Heh! Looks like I'll be
headed home soon~
scripts.translation:
[男子]
嘿！看来我很快就能回家了~

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Whoa, don't get so close!
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
哇，别靠得太近！

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Whoa, don't get so close!
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
哇，别靠得太近！

scripts.text: Why are you hiding here?
scripts.translation: 你为什么躲在这里？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why are you hiding here?
Didn't the Z Gang hire you
to dig up some treasure?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你为什么躲在这里？
Z帮不是雇你来挖宝藏吗？

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Huh? Z Gang? Treasure?
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
什么？Z帮？宝藏？

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Huh? Wait, tell me the
truth. Did you actually
meet the Z Gang?
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
什么？等等，告诉我实话。
你真的见过Z帮的人吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I not only met the Z Gang,
I also captured them. I've
come looking for you to
find out more about this
buried treasure.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不仅见过Z帮，
还抓住了他们。我来找你，
是想了解更多关于这个埋藏宝藏的事。

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
I get it now. You must
have met that other guy
they hired to get the
treasure. Huh. He's got one
half of the spell to open it,
and I've got the other.
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
我明白了。你肯定见过
他们雇来取宝藏的另一个人。
哼。他拿着开启宝藏咒语的一半，
而我拿着另一半。

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Well, you can have this,
the rest of the magic spell.
Let me warn you, though,
there's something weird
about the spell, and the
treasure itself.
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
好吧，这个给你，
剩下的咒语部分。
不过我要警告你，
这个咒语和宝藏本身都有些古怪。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received a torn
document that reads
''^FF0000Seseame]^000000.''
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你获得了一份破损的文档，
上面写着''^FF0000芝麻^000000''。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received a torn
document that reads
''^FF0000Treasure]^000000.''
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你获得了一份破损的文档，
上面写着''^FF0000开门^000000''。

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
I don't understand why they
went through the hassle of
splitting this spell in two
parts. There must be some
reason. Whatever it is, it
must be pretty important.
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
我不明白他们为什么要费心
把咒语分成两部分。
肯定有什么原因。不管怎样，
那一定很重要。

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
I guess maybe you need
two people to move the
treasure? Well, whatever.
Good luck finding that
treasure. Farewell now!
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
也许需要两个人才能移动宝藏？
算了，无所谓了。
祝你找到宝藏。再见！

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Whoa, don't get so close!
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
哇，别靠得太近！

scripts.text: Ask About Treasure
scripts.translation: 询问关于宝藏的事

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I've come looking
for information
about the treasure.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我来找你是为了
打听关于宝藏的消息。

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
You... You've come
looking for me?!
Ugh, I'm cornered!
I'm not going down
without a fight!
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
你...你是来找我的？！
可恶，我被包围了！
我绝不会束手就擒！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What? No, it's not like
that. I met this treasure
hunter in Morocc that said
I could find you around here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么？不，不是那样的。
我在莫洛克遇到一个寻宝猎人，
他说我可以在这里找到你。

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Treasure hunter...?
Oh, then you already
know about the treasure...
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
寻宝猎人...？
哦，那你已经知道宝藏的事了...

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
If I'm right, then you
need the other half of
the spell to open the
treasure. Here, you can
take it. I have no use
for it, anyway.
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
如果我没猜错，你需要咒语的另一半才能打开宝藏。
给你，拿去吧。反正我也用不上。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received a torn
document that reads
''^FF0000Sesame]^000000.''
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你获得了一张撕碎的纸条，上面写着
''^FF0000芝麻]^000000。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received a torn
document that reads
''^FF0000Treasure]^000000.''
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你获得了一份破损的文档，
上面写着''^FF0000开门^000000''。

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Now would you just get
out of here? If you couldn't
already tell, I'm hiding from
some people. I told you all
I know, so do me a favor,
and don't tell anyone I'm here!
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
你能不能快点走？
如果你还没发现的话，我正在躲避一些人。
我已经把知道的都告诉你了，
求你个忙，别告诉任何人我在这里！

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Aren't you going to
dig up that treasure?
You have both parts of
the spell that you need:
I already gave you the
''^FF0000Treasure]^000000'' part, right?
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
你难道不打算挖出那个宝藏吗？
你已经拥有了咒语的两部分：
我已经把''^FF0000宝藏]^000000'那部分给你了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Anyway, now that the
Z Gang is captured,
it might be safe enough
for me to go back home.
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
总之，既然Z帮已经被抓住了，
我大概可以安全地回家了。

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Would you do me a favor,
and just get out of here
before someone finds
my hiding place?
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
你能不能帮个忙，
在有人发现我的藏身之处之前离开这里？

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Aren't you going to
dig up that treasure?
You have both parts of
the spell that you need:
I already gave you the
''^FF0000Sesame]^000000'' part, right?
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
你难道不打算挖出那个宝藏吗？
你已经拥有了咒语的两部分：
我已经把''^FF0000芝麻]^000000'那部分给你了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Anyway, now that the
Z Gang is captured,
it might be safe enough
for me to go back home.
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
总之，既然Z帮已经被抓住了，
我大概可以安全地回家了。

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Would you do me a favor,
and just get out of here
before someone finds
my hiding place?
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
你能不能帮个忙，
在有人发现我的藏身之处之前离开这里？

scripts.text:
[Man in Hiding]
Heh! Looks like it's
safe for me to come out
of hiding, and just go home!
But maybe I should stick
around here a little longer,
just to be on the safe side.
scripts.translation:
[躲藏的男子]
嘿！看来我可以出来
回家去了！
但也许我应该在这里再待一会儿，
以防万一。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou're carrying too many
items: there's no way you
can carry the Treasure
Chest with you for now.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你携带的物品太多了：
目前你无法携带宝箱。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's something
here, buried just
beneath the ground.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这里有什么东西，
埋在地下。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Unngh! I-it won't...!

^3355FFNo matter how hard
you try, you can't dig
out the chest or open it.
There's some magical
aura surrounding the chest
that might be stopping you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF无论你怎么努力，
都无法挖出或打开箱子。
箱子周围似乎有某种魔法气息，
可能阻止了你。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThat Treasure Hunter in
Morocc must know something
about the chest's magical
protection. It might be
a good idea to ask him.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF莫洛克的寻宝猎人
一定知道关于箱子魔法防护的事。
也许最好去问问他。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tried casting the
spell on the document
you received, but nothing
happened. You should probably
find the other man over in
Comodo to see what he knows.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你尝试对你收到的纸条施法，
但什么也没发生。
你应该去克魔岛找另一个男人，
看看他是否知道些什么。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou'll need to combine
the two halves of the spell
on the document you received
to remove the chest's magical
protection to get the treasure.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你需要组合你收到的纸条上的
咒语两半，以移除箱子的魔法防护
并获得宝藏。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe Z Gang must have split
the spell document in two
parts because one person
isn't enough to open this
chest. It's a good thing
you brought a friend.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FFZ帮一定把咒语纸条分成了两部分，
因为一个人不足以打开这个箱子。
幸好你带了朋友。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou cast the spell,
the chest opens, and
you grab all the loot inside.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你施放了咒语，
箱子打开了，
你拿走了里面的所有战利品。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
N-no! What's going on?
This Emerald... It must
be cursed by evil magic!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不！发生什么事了？
这颗祖母绿...它一定
被邪恶的魔法诅咒了！

scripts.text:
^3355FFNothing happened.
You might not be
combining the spell
correctly. Perhaps if
you made it all one word...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF什么也没发生。
你可能没有正确组合咒语。
也许如果你把它变成一个词...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe treasure chest still
won't open. Then again,
this doesn't seem to be
a one man job...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF宝箱依然没有打开。不过话说回来，
这似乎不是一个人能完成的工作...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFSomone must have
checked the treasure
site after you left:
whoever it was left
telltale signs of
his presence.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在你离开后，一定有人
检查过宝藏地点：
无论那是谁，都留下了
他存在过的明显迹象。^000000

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
I'm an antique appraiser.
You may think of me as similar
to jewel appraisers, but I can
appraise the historical value
of antiques in addition to their quality and monetary value.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
我是一名古董鉴定师。
你可以把我看作类似珠宝鉴定师的人，
但我不仅能鉴定古董的品质和金钱价值，
还能鉴定其历史价值。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Oooh. You must be the
one sent by Ibrahim, right?
You're the one that found
that rare emerald, one of
the accursed jewels?
scripts.translation:
[学者]
哦。你一定是易卜拉欣派来的人吧？
你就是那个发现了稀有祖母绿的人，
那是被诅咒的宝石之一？

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
I'm very interested in the
Cursed Jewels, and have been
researching them. You came
to just the right person if you
wanted to learn more about
the emerald that you found.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
我对被诅咒的宝石非常感兴趣，
并且一直在研究它们。如果你想了解更多
关于你发现的那颗祖母绿的信息，
你来对人了。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Hello, how may
I help you today?
scripts.translation:
[学者]
你好，今天有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Ask About Cursed Jewel
scripts.translation: 询问关于被诅咒的宝石

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I came to ask you
about a Cursed Jewel.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我来是想向你询问
关于一颗被诅咒的宝石的事。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Let's see... Ah, did
you come to ask about
the Diamond of Destruction?
scripts.translation:
[学者]
让我看看...啊，你是来询问
关于“毁灭之钻”的事吗？

scripts.text: No, it's the Unlucky Emerald.
scripts.translation: 不，是异样的绿宝石。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Ah, the Unlucky Emerald?
Yes, that was the most recent
Cursed Jewel to be discovered.
Let's see, where did I put all
of my notes about that?
scripts.translation:
[学者]
啊，异样的绿宝石？
是的，那是最近被发现的一颗被诅咒的宝石。
让我看看，我把关于它的所有笔记
放在哪里了呢？

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Would you mind coming
back later? I'm not sure
where I misplaced my notes...
scripts.translation:
[学者]
你介意稍后再来吗？我不确定
我把笔记放在哪里了...

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Ah, let's see now.
There's a record here
entitled, ''The Story of the
Cursed Jewel.'' According
to this, no one knows where
these jewels were first found.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
啊，让我看看。
这里有一份记录，标题是
《被诅咒的宝石的故事》。根据这份记录，
没有人知道这些宝石最初是在哪里被发现的。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
The first incident involving
the jewel involved a Comodo
resident that used the jewel
to pay a gambling debt. He
committed suicide after he
paid his debt, which is a pity.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
涉及该宝石的第一起事件，
是一位克魔岛居民用这颗宝石
偿还赌债。他在还完债后
自杀了，这真令人惋惜。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
He didn't tell anyone
where he found the jewel
before he died, so we have
no way of determining the
jewel's true origins.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
他在死前没有告诉任何人
他是在哪里发现这颗宝石的，
所以我们无法确定宝石的真正来源。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
After it was sold, the
jewel came into a rich man's
possession. However, he lost
his fortune and was completely
ruined after obtaining it. Hence the moniker, ''Unlucky Emerald.''
scripts.translation:
[学者]
宝石被卖出后，
落入了一位富商手中。然而，
他在得到宝石后失去了财富，
彻底破产了。因此得名“异样的绿宝石”。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Then the emerald came into
the hands of a noble lady
who mysteriously died at
a young age. The emerald's
had thousands of owners
who just... Died.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
随后，这颗祖母绿落入了一位
贵族女士手中，她神秘地
英年早逝。这颗祖母绿
曾有数千位主人，他们只是...死了。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
What's disturbing is that
the emerald's curse seems
to grow stronger with each
life it takes away. Um, and
your jewel perfectly matches
the descriptions, so, uh...
scripts.translation:
[学者]
令人不安的是，
这颗祖母绿的诅咒似乎
随着它夺去的生命而变得更强。
嗯，而且你的宝石完全符合
描述，所以，呃...

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
You are the new owner
of the Unlucky Emerald.
No one will buy that from
you while it's still cursed.
For the sake of your life,
you must break that curse.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
你就是异样的绿宝石的新主人。
只要诅咒还在，没有人会买它。
为了你的性命，
你必须解除那个诅咒。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Now, holy spells won't work
on this kind of curse. You'll
need to talk to a shaman.
I think he lives in... Alberta?
He can summon the dead
and act as a medium for you.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
现在，神圣法术对这种诅咒无效。
你需要去找萨满。
我想他住在...艾尔贝塔？
他可以召唤亡灵，
并作为你的媒介。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
The idea is for you to talk
to the spirits killed by this
emerald through that shaman.
And I'm sure he'll be pretty
excited to see that you have
the Unlucky Emerald with you.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
你的任务是通过那位萨满，
与这颗绿宝石杀害的亡灵对话。
我相信他看到你带着
“异样的绿宝石”会非常兴奋。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Please find that shaman
in Alberta, and ask if he can
help you break the curse
on that Unlucky Emerald.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
请去艾尔贝塔找到那位萨满，
问问他能否帮你解除
“异样的绿宝石”上的诅咒。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Wait, you're telling me
that the emerald was cursed
by the vindictive spirit of
some warrior? Interesting...
I should record this in my
research notes. Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[学者]
等等，你是说这颗绿宝石
是被某个战士的怨灵诅咒的？
有意思...
我应该把这个记录在
研究日志里。谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Some jewels are said to
be possessed by ghosts
or evil spirits that will bring
misfortune to their owners,
drive them to death or
insanity, that sort of thing.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
据说有些宝石被幽灵
或邪恶的精灵附身，
会给主人带来厄运，
甚至导致死亡或疯狂，
诸如此类的事情。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
The spiritual realm is
the source of my sorcery.
Do not understimate the
power of the spirits!
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
灵界是我法术的源泉。
不要低估精灵的力量！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Oh? Heh heh!
You're carrying
something very
valuable, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
哦？嘿嘿！
你身上带着
非常贵重的东西，
对吧？

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
You! Yes... I can sense
them... The angry spirits of
your ancestors! You haven't
made any offerings to them,
have you? You must appease
them before they torment you!
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
你！是的...我能感觉到...
你祖先愤怒的亡灵！
你没有给他们供奉，
对吧？在他们折磨你之前，
你必须安抚他们！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Quickly, now! It is
imperative that you give me
500,000 zeny immediately
so that I can comfort their
souls before they wreck
havoc on your life!
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
快一点！你必须立刻
给我500,000 Zeny，
这样我才能安抚他们的灵魂，
以免他们扰乱你的生活！

scripts.text: Actually, I have a Cursed Jewel.
scripts.translation: 其实，我有一颗被诅咒的宝石。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Jewel...? Oh, a Cursed
Jewel! Hahaha! So that's
what that evil aura was!
My mistake! Say, do you
mind if I take a look at it?
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
宝石...？哦，是被诅咒的宝石！
哈哈！原来那股邪恶的灵气
是那个！我的错！
请问，你介意我看一眼吗？

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
So this bauble's the
Unlucky Emerald? Yes,
it's definitely cursed.
If you don't break the
curse soon, it'll consume
your soul. Not a good thing.
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
所以这个小玩意就是
“异样的绿宝石”？是的，
它确实被诅咒了。
如果你不尽快解除诅咒，
它会吞噬你的灵魂。这可不好。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
I need to perform
a ritual to break the
curse. I'll charge you
200,000 zeny for the service.
It's expensive, but I'm saving
your life and risking mine.
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
我需要举行仪式来解除诅咒。
这项服务收费200,000 Zeny。
虽然很贵，但我是在救你的命，
同时也冒着我自己的风险。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Hm? Did you forget to
bring the jewel? Hurry,
and bring it back to me.
You need to break that
curse before the jewel
can devour your soul!
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
嗯？你忘了带宝石？
快，把它带回来给我。
在宝石吞噬你的灵魂之前，
你必须解除那个诅咒！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Did you bring the money?
We must appease the spirits
possessing the soul, and to
do that, I will need to perform
a ritual that will be taxing
on my body and spirit.
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
你带钱了吗？
我们必须安抚附身于灵魂中的精灵，
为此，我需要举行一个
对我身心消耗很大的仪式。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Good, good. I see that
you've brought the money.
I can now begin the ritual.
If all goes well, you'll be
free of your curse, and I can
buy some Prontera real estate.
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
很好，很好。我看到
你带了钱。
我现在可以开始仪式了。
如果一切顺利，你就能摆脱诅咒，
而我也可以买一些普隆德拉的房产了。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Please come back soon
after I've completed the
preparations for the ritual.
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
请在我完成仪式准备后
尽快回来。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
You... You don't have
200,000 zeny? I'm sorry,
but I cannot perform the
ritual for free, even if
your soul is at stake.
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
你...你没有200,000 Zeny？
很抱歉，即使你的灵魂
危在旦夕，我也不能免费
为你举行仪式。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Hmm... You know the
money you gave me?
Apparently, it wasn't
enough. One of the spirits
was about to enter me, but...
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
嗯...你知道你给我的钱吗？
显然，那不够。其中一个精灵
差点进入我的身体，但是...

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
It left in disgust after
it learned that I was trying
to break the curse for only
200,000 zeny. I think...
I think I need 100,000 zeny
more for this to be effective.
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
它得知我只收了200,000 Zeny
就试图解除诅咒后，
愤怒地离开了。我想...
我想还需要100,000 Zeny
才能生效。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Good, you've returned!
Did you bring the 100,000
zeny like I asked? It's a small
price considering that I'm
saving your very soul.
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
很好，你回来了！
你按我说的带了100,000 Zeny吗？
考虑到我是在救你的灵魂，
这算是个小数目了。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Ah, perfect!
Hopefully, the
spirits will be more
cooperative this time.
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
啊，完美！
希望这次精灵们
会更配合一些。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Yes, the vindictive
spirit in this jewel
will be most impressed
by your sincere efforts.
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
是的，这颗宝石中
充满怨恨的精灵，
一定会被你的
真诚所打动。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
You didn't? Do you know
what it's like to have
your soul consumed? Let
me tell you, it's a lot
more painful than parting
with a paltry 100,000 zeny!
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
你没带？你知道
灵魂被吞噬是什么
感觉吗？让我告诉你，
那比失去区区100,000 Zeny
要痛苦得多！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
At long last, the
spirits and I are one.
The ritual may now begin.
Ohhhhhhhhhhhmmmmm...
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
终于，精灵与我
合二为一了。
仪式可以开始了。
噢噢噢噢噢噢噢噢噢噢...

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Hhhkkk... Arrrgh...!

[Shaman]
Th-this emerald!
So many lives! Money
alone won't break this
curse! It's time to get
serious and suppress
this jewel's power!
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
这...这颗绿宝石！
这么多生命！
光靠钱是无法解除
这个诅咒的！是时候
认真起来，压制
这颗宝石的力量了！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Remember the items
I tell you to bring, and
come back with them
as quickly as you can!
Both of our lives are in
danger until you do!
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
记住我让你带的物品，
并尽快带着它们回来！
在你做到之前，
我们两人的生命
都处于危险之中！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Bring me
^FF00001 Holy Water^000000,
^FF00001 Red Blood^000000,
^FF00001 Witherless Rose^000000,
^FF00001 Crystal Blue^000000, and
^FF00001 Wind of Verdure^000000.

[Shaman]
Hurry! Although the spirits
are eternal, they don't like
to be kept waiting! Don't
question this great irony,
and get those items now!
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
快一点！虽然精灵是
永恒的，但它们不喜欢
被人等待！不要质疑
这种伟大的讽刺，
现在就去拿那些物品！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
You brought the items?!
Quickly! Place them in
my hands! We can't afford
to waste any more time!
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
你带了物品来？！
快！把它们放在
我手里！我们不能再
浪费任何时间了！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Thank goodness.
Now... Let me begin...
Uhhkk... Argh! Wait!
I... I see someone...
Covered in blood? Yes...
He's staring at something.
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
谢天谢地。
现在...让我开始...
呃...啊！等等！
我...我看到一个人...
浑身是血？是的...
他正盯着什么东西看。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
There's a sword behind it.
He's... He's just been in
a fight? I can smell...
His bloodlust. I can't tell
if he cursed the jewel of
if he's another victim...
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
它后面有一把剑。
他...他刚经历过
一场战斗？我能闻到...
他的嗜血气息。我无法判断
他是诅咒了这颗宝石，
还是另一个受害者...

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Damn it! It's not clear
to me! We need to figure
out if what I'm seeing is
the root of the curse...
What can we do to--Right!
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
该死！我不清楚！
我们需要弄清楚
我看到的是否是
诅咒的根源...
我们能做什么——对了！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
I'm not sure how helpful
he'll be, but there is an
archaeologist in Juno that
might know more about this
specific jewel. Hopefully,
he will have the answer.
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
我不确定他会有多
有帮助，但朱诺有一位
考古学家，他可能
对这颗特定的宝石
了解更多。希望
他能找到答案。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
For now, the jewel's
curse is beyond my power.
However, if you can determine
the source of the curse, then
I will be able to help you.
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
目前，这颗宝石的
诅咒超出了我的能力。
但是，如果你能确定
诅咒的来源，那么
我就能帮助你。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
You... Forgot?!
Your body and soul are in
jeopardy and you forgot?!
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
你...忘了？！
你的身体和灵魂都
处于危险之中，
你却忘了？！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Bring me
^FF00001 Holy Water^000000,
^FF00001 Red Blood^000000,
^FF00001 Witherless Rose^000000,
^FF00001 Crystal Blue^000000, and
^FF00001 Wind of Verdure^000000!

[Shaman]
That antique appraiser...
He wouldn't know anything
more about the jewel, but
that archaeologist in Juno
will hopefully have some
new information we can use.
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
那个古董鉴定师...
他可能不会知道
关于这颗宝石的更多
信息，但朱诺的那位
考古学家应该会有一些
我们可以利用的新信息。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Ah, you're back.
So did you learn
anything new about
the Unlucky Emerald?
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
啊，你回来了。
那么，你关于
异样的绿宝石
了解到什么新情况了吗？

scripts.text: The archaeologist said...
scripts.translation: 考古学家说...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The archaeologist said...
Well, he said that there
is no curse on the jewel.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
考古学家说...
他说，这颗宝石上
并没有诅咒。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
What? How dare he refute
what I just told you?!
Is he calling me a liar?
There was a vindictive
warrior's soul inside
that very emerald!
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
什么？他竟敢反驳
我刚才告诉你的话？！
他是在说我在撒谎吗？
那颗绿宝石里
明明封印着一个
充满怨恨的战士灵魂！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Then again, there's no
point fighting someone
that doesn't believe in
the spirit realm. However,
I wasn't lying. My honor
as a shaman is at stake!
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
不过，跟一个不相信
灵界存在的人争论
也没有意义。但我没有撒谎，
我作为萨满的荣誉
不容有失！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
In fact, I'll prove it to you
by reading the message
inside this emerald. Bring
me the jewel, and I'll summon
the warrior spirit inside it.
Just let me rest a bit first.
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
事实上，我会向你证明。
通过解读这颗绿宝石
内部的信息。把宝石
带给我，我会召唤
里面的战士灵魂。
不过，请让我先休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Alright. By my pride
as a shaman, I'll provide
this service to you free
of charge! Can't have
anyone thinking I'm
some kind of quack...
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
好吧。以我作为萨满
的尊严起誓，我会
免费为你提供这项服务！
不能让任何人觉得
我是个江湖骗子...

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Hmmmm...
Hmmmm...
I... I see.
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
嗯...
嗯...
我...我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Huh. Well, what do you
know? There is no curse.
However, it's not true that
only Comodo's prodigal son
was killed over this jewel.
There are many more...
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
哈。真是的，居然
没有诅咒。不过，
关于这颗宝石，
被杀死的不仅仅是
科摩多龙的浪子。
还有很多人...

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Go yonder to the town
of Geffen, head west, and
seek the high ground that
is over the bridge. You know...
Leave Geffen through the west
gate and find a high place.
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
去吉芬镇，往西走，
寻找那座桥上方的
高地。你知道的...
从吉芬西门出去，
找一个高一点的地方。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Trust me. You'll find
something there that will
react to the power of that
emerald you possess.
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
相信我。你会在那里
找到一些东西，
它会对你手中
那颗绿宝石的力量
产生反应。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Hmpf! That arrogant
archaeologist! He doesn't
know what he's talking about!
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
哼！那个傲慢的
考古学家！他根本
不知道自己在说什么！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
You don't have the
emerald with you?
I hope you didn't
lose it somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
你没有带绿宝石吗？
希望你没有把它
弄丢在什么地方。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Go yonder to the town
of Geffen, head west, and
seek the high ground that
is over the bridge. You know...
Leave Geffen through the west
gate and find a high place.
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
去吉芬镇，往西走，
寻找那座桥上方的
高地。你知道的...
从吉芬西门出去，
找一个高一点的地方。

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
Trust me. You'll find
something there that will
react to the power of that
emerald you possess.
Don't forget to bring
that emerald with you!
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
相信我。你会在那里
找到一些东西，
它会对你手中
那颗绿宝石的力量
产生反应。
别忘了带上那颗绿宝石！

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
What did I tell you?
That jewel brings very
bad fortune. Though, I'm
not sure why the warrior
spirit inside wouldn't talk
to me. What's with that?
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
我跟你说过什么？
那颗宝石会带来
极大的厄运。虽然，
我不明白为什么里面的
战士灵魂不肯跟我说话。
这是怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[Shaman]
It's been a long time
since I've done these
rituals. I feel thoroughly
drained of my spiritual energy.
scripts.translation:
[萨满]
我已经很久没有
进行过这种仪式了。
我感觉我的灵力
被彻底耗尽了。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
There's so much to do!
How am I going to handle
all of this research? Don't
panic, don't panic, just
one thing at a time!
scripts.translation:
[考古学家]
要做的事情太多了！
我该怎么处理
所有的研究？别慌，
别慌，一次只做一件事！

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
Oh, I've heard about you
from that antique appraiser
in Comodo... You're the one
that dig up the Unlucky
Emerald, right? Would
you mind if I take a look?
scripts.translation:
[考古学家]
哦，我听说克魔岛
那个古董鉴定师
提起过你...你就是
挖出异样绿宝石的人，
对吧？介意我
看一眼吗？

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
Ah, it's no wonder so
many people want it.
This emerald is so huge
and... It's beautiful! So...
I'm guessing you needed
my help with something?
scripts.translation:
[考古学家]
啊，难怪那么多人
想要它。这颗绿宝石
这么大，而且...真美！
那么...我猜你是
需要我帮忙解决
什么问题？

scripts.text: Ask About the Jewel's Curse
scripts.translation: 询问宝石的诅咒

scripts.text: Show Off Jewel
scripts.translation: 展示宝石

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
The jewel's curse?
Hah! You believe in that
old superstition? Oh, so
you wanted to break the
jewel's curse? Mmpf. Hahah!
You're not dead yet, right?
scripts.translation:
[考古学家]
宝石的诅咒？
哈！你相信那种
老迷信吗？哦，原来
你是想解除宝石的诅咒？
唔。哈哈！
你还没死，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
It's all a load of bunk!
Only one man died while
keeping this jewel in his
possession, that gambler in
Comodo that used it to pay
off his gambling debts.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家]
那全是胡扯！
只有一个人因为
持有这颗宝石而死，
就是克魔岛那个
用它来偿还赌债的赌徒。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
This jewel happened to be
lost for a long time, and it
just reappeared. That's all.
Lots of myths and legends
surround extremely valuable
gems like this one.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家]
这颗宝石只是
遗失了很久，
现在重新出现了而已。
像这样极其珍贵的宝石，
周围总是围绕着
许多神话和传说。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
Anyway, there's no curse.
Believe what you want to,
but that happens to be my
professional opinion,
based on my research.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家]
总之，没有诅咒。
你爱信不信，
但根据我的研究，
这是我的专业意见。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
Wow...
That jewel sure
is freakin' huge...
scripts.translation:
[考古学家]
哇...
这颗宝石
真是大得离谱...

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
You lost the jewel?
Well, maybe it's not
all bad. History shows
that many people were
ruined by suddenly coming
upon vast fortunes, you know?
scripts.translation:
[考古学家]
你弄丢了宝石？
嗯，也许这并不全是坏事。
历史表明，许多人
因为突然获得巨额财富
而身败名裂，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
The vindictive soul
of a warrior is just
drifting around in the
world of the living?
I don't think I want to
believe what you're saying.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家]
一个战士的复仇之魂
只是在人间游荡？
我不太想相信
你说的话。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
I personally feel that
old shaman's a fraud, but...
You should have the freedom
to decide what you believe.
But don't let it bother you.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家]
我个人觉得
那个老萨满是个骗子，但是...
你有权利决定
自己相信什么。
不过别让它困扰你。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
Are you talking about
ghosts again? Fine. For
the sake of the argument,
let's say the jewel actually
possesses the soul of
some fallen warrior.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家]
你又在说幽灵了？
好吧。为了争论，
假设这颗宝石真的
拥有某个阵亡战士的灵魂。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
It's not unfathomable for
people with huge debts to
kill themselves, or for
warriors to perish while
fighting Cobolds. Still...
I'll see what I can learn.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家]
负债累累的人自杀，
或者战士在与哥布林战斗中丧生，
这并不令人费解。不过...
我会看看能了解到什么。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
That reminds me...
I've got some records about
an adventurer group that died
in the field west of Geffen
that you were talking about.
Let me see if I can find them.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家]
这让我想起...
我有一些关于一个冒险者团体
在吉芬以西的野外阵亡的记录，
就是你提到的那个。
让我看看能不能找到它们。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
Ah, you're back! I found
those records I told you
about. It's a witness's
account of what happened
when those people died
west of Geffen.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家]
啊，你回来了！我找到了
我告诉你的那些记录。
这是目击者对吉芬以西
那些人死时发生情况的描述。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
What's interesting is that
the warrior you keep talking
about wasn't killed by Cobolds
at all, according to what this
guy wrote. Let's see...
Ah, it's over here.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家]
有趣的是，根据这个人写的，
你一直提到的那个战士
根本不是被哥布林杀死的。
让我看看...
啊，在这里。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
''^666666When the chief and his
soldiers arrived, the battle
was over. Dead bodies lay
everywhere, but there was
one warrior covered in blood,
half conscious, but living.^000000''
scripts.translation:
[考古学家]
“^666666当首领和他的士兵到达时，
战斗已经结束。到处都是尸体，
但有一个战士浑身是血，
半昏迷状态，但还活着。^000000”

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
Strange, isn't it?
This is from a journal
written by a retired soldier
that lives in Prontera now.
It might be a good idea to
see if you can talk to him.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家]
奇怪，不是吗？
这是来自一名退役士兵的日记，
他现在住在普隆德拉。
也许你可以去和他谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
There's a retired soldier
that actually witnessed what
happened in the field west
of Geffen. You should try
to find him in Prontera, and
see what you can learn.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家]
有一名退役士兵
实际上目睹了吉芬以西
野外发生的事情。你应该
试着在普隆德拉找到他，
看看能了解到什么。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
Ah, that's... That's
very profound. That one
warrior went berserk when
he realized he was too weak
to protect his comrades?
He lost total control...
scripts.translation:
[考古学家]
啊，这...这
非常深刻。那个战士
在意识到自己太弱，
无法保护他的同志时
陷入了狂暴状态？
他完全失去了控制...

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
I better talk to that
old soldier and get the
full story on record.
It'll be a really good history
lesson for Swordmen everywhere.
Thank you for letting me know.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家]
我最好去和那个老士兵谈谈，
把完整的故事记录下来。
这对各地的剑士来说
将是一堂很好的历史课。
谢谢你告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist]
I'm so busy! Listen,
would you mind coming
back later when I'm not
so swamped with work?
scripts.translation:
[考古学家]
我太忙了！听着，
你介意稍后再来吗？
等我没那么忙的时候。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
Why are you carrying
so much stuff with you?
Isn't there a Kafra Storage
service for keeping your junk?
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
你为什么带着
这么多东西？
卡普拉不是有仓库服务
可以存放你的杂物吗？

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
It's strange that so
many people have been
wanting to talk to me for
some reason, but I'll
admit that it's kind of nice.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
奇怪，最近怎么有
这么多人想找我谈话？
不过说实话，
这种感觉还挺不错的。

scripts.text: Ask About Past Battles
scripts.translation: 询问过去的战斗

scripts.text: Ask About Fallen Warrior
scripts.translation: 询问那位倒下的战士

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
Don't get me started.
Once I start talking about
the old days, I'll go on all
night. Those were real hard
times to live through, but good
memories to remember...
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
别让我开始回忆。
一旦谈起往事，
我可能整晚都停不下来。
那是段艰难的日子，
但也是值得铭记的美好回忆...

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
The fallen warrior...?
There's only one that brings
a chill down my spine whenever
I think of him. He was about
your age when it happened...
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
倒下的战士...？
每当想起那个人，
我就感到脊背发凉。
事发时，他和你差不多大...

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
We received a report about
a Cobold threat, so we were
dispatched to the fields
west of Geffen. But the
battle was over once we
arrived. We were too late.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
我们收到了关于哥布林的报告，
于是被派往吉芬以西的野外。
但当我们赶到时，战斗已经结束了。
我们太迟了。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
All the Cobolds were slain,
but... There was one warrior
left, covered in blood. When
he saw us, he just started
attacking everyone! He
had completely lost it.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
所有的哥布林都被杀死了，
但...还剩下一个战士，浑身是血。
他看到我们时，
突然开始攻击所有人！
他完全失控了。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
We had no choice but to
kill him. It was self defense,
but I can't help but pity him.
All his comrades had been
killed: I can't imagine how
that must have felt.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
我们别无选择，只能杀了他。
那是正当防卫，
但我忍不住同情他。
他的所有同志都死了：
我无法想象那会是种什么感受。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
We arrived too late to
see that battle, but I'm
pretty sure it was horrific.
You must be pretty interested
in learning about this soldier.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
我们赶到时没能看到那场战斗，
但我确信那场面一定很惨烈。
看来你对这位士兵
很感兴趣，想了解他的故事。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
Well, I'm just glad that you
were able to know more
about this story. There's
much you can learn from
other people's experiences.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
嗯，很高兴你能
更多地了解这个故事。
从别人的经历中，
你可以学到很多东西。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
I don't regret that we
had to kill that warrior.
We did had we had to
back in those days.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
我不后悔我们不得不
杀死那位战士。
在那样的年代，
我们只能那样做。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
Oh, it's you again.
Did you want to ask me
more about that warrior?
I'm afraid I already told
you everything I know.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
哦，又是你啊。
你还想问我关于
那位战士的事吗？
恐怕我已经把知道的
都告诉你了。

scripts.text: Sorry...
scripts.translation: 抱歉...

scripts.text: I met the warrior's spirit.
scripts.translation: 我见到了那位战士的精灵。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
It's fine.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
没关系。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
What? How is that
even possible?
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
什么？这怎么可能？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou explain to the
retired soldier everything
that has happened so far.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF向退役士兵解释
目前为止发生的一切。^000000

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
That's quite a story.
Still, I'm surprised that
he didn't want to talk to
you about what happened.
I guess he still harbors
bad feelings about that day...
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
真是个离奇的故事。
不过，我还是很惊讶，
他居然不想和你谈谈
那天发生的事。
我想他可能还对那天
怀有不好的情绪...

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
Well, I guess it doesn't
really matter now. Chalk
this all up to a really good
learning experience.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
嗯，我想现在
这已经不重要了。
把这当作一次
很好的学习经历吧。

scripts.text: I feel so sorry for him.
scripts.translation: 我为他感到难过。

scripts.text: Do you believe the jewel is really cursed?
scripts.translation: 你相信那颗宝石真的被诅咒了吗？

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
Well...
I don't know what to tell
you. I mean, you can't really
put the blame on anybody.
He just lost his mind...
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
唉...
我不知道该说什么。
总之，你不能怪任何人。
他只是...失去了理智...

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
I'm not really sure if the
jewel was cursed, if that
warrior started the curse,
or if the jewel isn't cursed
at all. I'm just an old,
simple soldier.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
我不确定那颗宝石是否被诅咒，
是那个战士引发了诅咒，
还是宝石根本没有诅咒。
我只是一个普通的
老士兵。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
One thing's for sure:
if there was a curse, that
soldier should have been
able to overcome it if his will
was strong enough. It's harsh
to say it like this, but...
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
有一点是肯定的：
如果真的有诅咒，
那个战士只要意志足够坚定，
就应该能克服它。
这么说可能很残酷，但是...

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
True warriors have the
strength to endure, to
fight temptation, to keep
their focus. That guy...
He wasn't cut out to fight.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
真正的战士拥有
忍受痛苦、
抵抗诱惑、
保持专注的力量。
那个人...
他根本不适合战斗。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
You know what?
If you're so worried
about a curse, why don't
you leave that jewel with me?
Don't worry, I'll make sure
to compensate you for it.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
你知道吗？
如果你这么担心诅咒，
为什么不把那颗宝石
留给我呢？
别担心，我会补偿你的。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
I'd rather keep it to myself,
rather than risk it messing
around with other people.
I know my will's tough enough
to resist its curse, you know,
if it actually exists.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
我宁愿自己留着，
也不愿冒险让它
去祸害别人。
我知道我的意志足够坚定，
足以抵抗它的诅咒，
如果它真的存在的话。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
If there's anything
you learn from all this,
it's that you should never
succumb to your desperation.
Rage gives you nothing:
its power is an illusion.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
如果你从这一切中
学到了什么，
那就是永远不要
向绝望屈服。
愤怒带不来任何东西：
它的力量是一种幻觉。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
You know what?
If you're so worried
about a curse, why don't
you leave that jewel with me?
Don't worry, I'll make sure
to compensate you for it.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
你知道吗？
如果你这么担心诅咒，
为什么不把那颗宝石
留给我呢？
别担心，我会补偿你的。

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
I'd rather keep it to myself,
rather than risk it messing
around with other people.
I know my will's tough enough
to resist its curse, you know,
if it actually exists.

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
Well, you learned all there
is to know about the Unlucky
Emerald. It's time you forget
about the curse or whatever,
and find new adventures.
Ah, to be young again...
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
好了，关于不幸的翡翠，
你已经知道了所有该知道的。
是时候忘记诅咒或别的什么，
去寻找新的冒险了。
啊，要是能再年轻一次就好了...

scripts.text:
[Retired Soldier]
Ah, how I long for
the old days. Being
retired is just so...
It's so boring! I guess
it's time to find a hobby.
scripts.translation:
[退役士兵]
啊，我多么怀念
过去的日子。
退休的生活真是...
太无聊了！我想
是时候找个爱好了。

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
I'm just a wanderer
drifting through this
world. Please just
leave me in peace.
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
我只是一个
在这个世界
漂泊的流浪者。
请让我安静地待着。

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
That... That looks
just like the emerald
I used to own. Hmmm...
Did you come looking for me?
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
那...那看起来
就像我曾经拥有的
那颗翡翠。嗯...
你是来找我的吗？

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
Get rid of that thing right
now. It's an evil jewel that
causes tragedy wherever
it goes. I remember... I got
that jewel from monsters...
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
立刻把那东西扔掉。
它是一颗邪恶的宝石，
所到之处都会带来悲剧。
我记得...我是从魔物那里
得到那颗宝石的...

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
I was just a simple man,
dreaming of becoming the
world's greatest warrior.
I had that emerald on me
when we encountered a huge
group of vicious Cobolds.
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
我只是一个普通人，
梦想着成为
世界上最伟大的战士。
当我身上带着那颗翡翠时，
我们遭遇了一大群
凶残的哥布林。

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
No matter how many
we killed, there was
just no end to them...
And then... We... We...
I... It hurts too much
to recall what happened...
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
无论我们杀了多少，
它们似乎永远杀不完...
然后...我们...我们...
我...回忆起来太痛苦了...

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
Why have you summoned me?
I'm just the soul of a fallen
warrior, seeking peace.
Please don't bother me
if you can avoid it.
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
你为什么要召唤我？
我只是一个
陨落战士的灵魂，
在寻求安宁。
如果可以的话，
请不要打扰我。

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
You again? Why do you still
hold the jewel?! Didn't I just
what happened to me and
my comrades! We all died
that day, that day the
Cobolds overpowered us!
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
又是你？为什么你还
拿着那颗宝石？！我不是
刚告诉你我和
我的同伴发生了什么吗！
那天我们都死了，
就是哥布林击败我们的那天！

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
Just let me return
to my slumber.
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
让我回到
我的沉睡中吧。

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
Why have you called
me here again? What
is it you want from me?
Can't you leave me alone?
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
你为什么又
把我叫到这里？
你想要从我这里得到什么？
就不能让我一个人待着吗？

scripts.text: Were you really killed by Cobolds?
scripts.translation: 你真的是被哥布林杀死的吗？

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
Argh! What is it you're
trying to say?! Leave now!
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
啊！你到底想说什么？！
现在就走！

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
Still you pester me.
Unfortunately, the power
of the jewel compels me
to return to this plane...
What is it this time?
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
你还在纠缠我。
不幸的是，宝石的力量
迫使我回到这个世界...
这次又是什么事？

scripts.text: You weren't killed by Cobolds, were you?
scripts.translation: 你不是被哥布林杀死的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
How many times must I tell
you? Are you saying that
I'm lying about the deaths
of my comrades? Forget it.
The dead shouldn't talk.
It's a waste of my time.
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
我要告诉你多少遍？
你是在说我关于同伴
死亡的事在撒谎吗？算了。
死者不应多言。
这是浪费我的时间。

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
Take care, young
adventurer, and don't
reopen the wounds of
the past anymore.
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
保重，年轻的冒险者，
不要再揭开过去的伤疤了。

scripts.text: You killed your comrades!
scripts.translation: 是你杀了你的同伴！

scripts.text: Do you remember your last moment?
scripts.translation: 你还记得你最后的时刻吗？

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
Did I...? Ha. Haha!
adventurer, but that sounds
like something from a trashy
novel. Hah hah hah hah!
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
我...？哈。哈哈！
冒险者，但这听起来
像是低俗小说里的桥段。
哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
It's a little hazy...
I... We tried to kill as
many Cobolds as we 
could... Everyone was...
Everyone was dead.
Everyone but me.
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
有点模糊...
我...我们试图杀死
尽可能多的哥布林...
所有人都...
所有人都死了。
除了我。

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
I was all alone.
We killed all the
Cobolds, but I was...
Then... The next thing...
I was covered in blood.
Then, something appeared?
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
我孤身一人。
我们杀光了所有
哥布林，但我...
然后...接下来...
我浑身是血。
然后，有什么东西出现了？

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
No, it can't have been.
A human soldier like me?
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
不，不可能。
像我这样的人类士兵？

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
I was killed... No, wait.
I survived the battle with
the Cobolds. Then, some
coward killed me from
behind, and stole my
emerald. That must be it!
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
我死了...不，等等。
我在与哥布林的战斗中幸存了下来。然后，某个
懦夫从背后杀了我，并偷走了我的
祖母绿。一定是这样！

scripts.text: How did your comrades die?
scripts.translation: 你的同伴是怎么死的？

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
The Cobolds killed them!
I was too weak to protect
my comrades. Too weak...
When I came back to my
senses, they were all...
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
是哥布林杀了他们！
我太弱了，无法保护
我的同伴。太弱了...
当我恢复意识时，他们都...

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
I'm not sure what
happened. There was
blood coming into my eyes...
I remember slashing, and
stabbing, and... And slashing.
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
我不确定发生了什么。有
血涌进我的眼睛...
我记得在挥砍，刺击，还有...还有挥砍。

scripts.text: You slashed everything...
scripts.translation: 你砍杀了一切...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You slashed everything...
Even the comrades you
were supposed to protect.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你砍杀了一切...
甚至包括你本该保护的同伴。

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
I... I did...?
I... No! Shut up!
Stop it! I couldn't...
Get out of here now!
You're trying to trick me!
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
我...我做了...？
我...不！闭嘴！
别说了！我不可能...
现在离开这里！
你是在耍我！

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
What is it?
What could you
possibly have to
say to me this time?
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
怎么了？
你这次还能
对我说什么？

[The Wanderer]
Leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
别缠着我！

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
Shut up! Stop harassing
me! I can't... I don't...!
scripts.translation:
[漂泊者]
闭嘴！别缠着我！
我...我不可能...！

scripts.text:
[The Wanderer]
.........

[{0}]
This must be the place
that shaman was talking
about. Let's see now...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这里应该就是那个萨满
提到的地方。让我看看...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This must be the place
that shaman was talking
about. Let's see now...
Wait. I need that emerald...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这里应该就是那个萨满
提到的地方。让我看看...
等等。我需要那块祖母绿...

scripts.text:
[Morocc Traveler]
Ah, it's very nice and
refreshing to be near this
fountain. It's much cooler
here than back in Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克旅行者]
啊，在这个喷泉附近
真的很凉爽舒适。
这里比梦罗克那边凉快多了。

scripts.text: Nice day today, huh?
scripts.translation: 今天天气不错，是吧？

scripts.text: How's Morocc lately?
scripts.translation: 最近梦罗克怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Morocc Traveler]
Oh, yes. It's a wonderful
day! Prontera is so sunny
and cool. No wonder so
many people live over here!
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克旅行者]
哦，是的。今天真是个好天气！
普隆德拉阳光明媚，气候宜人。
难怪这么多人住在这里！

scripts.text:
[Morocc Traveler]
You're an adventurer, and
you haven't heard the crazy
rumors spreading all over
the Rune-Midgarts kingdom?
I thought you guys traveled
around and heard things.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克旅行者]
你是冒险者，
难道没听说在卢恩·米德加兹王国
流传的那些疯狂谣言吗？
我以为你们四处旅行，
应该能听到各种消息。

scripts.text: What crazy rumors?
scripts.translation: 什么疯狂谣言？

scripts.text:
[Morocc Traveler]
Uh... Rogue agents!
They're all over the place!
Why don't you talk to some
of the Rogue agents dispatched
in the other towns? Then you'll
know what I'm talking about!
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克旅行者]
呃...流氓特工！
到处都是！
你为什么不跟其他城镇
派遣的流氓特工聊聊呢？
那样你就会明白我在说什么了！

scripts.text:
[Morocc Traveler]
Shouldn't you be
looking for a Rogue
agent to talk to?
I mean, maybe you
can pitch in and
help them out.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克旅行者]
你不应该去找一个
流氓特工聊聊吗？
我是说，也许你可以
出点力，帮帮他们。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Traveler]
So the Z Gang was what
those crazy rumors were
all about. Good to hear
that they're all in jail.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克旅行者]
原来那些疯狂谣言
都是关于Z帮派的。
很高兴听到他们都进了监狱。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Traveler]
Hey, uh...
I'm just trying to
relax on my vacation.
scripts.translation:
[梦罗克旅行者]
嘿，呃...
我只是想在假期里放松一下。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
You're carrying too
much stuff on you.
Take a load off, put
your extra stuff in
Kafra Storage: that's
what's it's for~
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
你身上带的东西太多了。
减轻点负担，把多余的东西
放进卡普拉仓库吧：
那就是它的用途~

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Man, it feels much safer
hanging out in an alley
than some crowded joint.
Us Rogues... I guess you
can say we got a bit of
agoraphobia, naturally.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
天哪，在小巷里闲逛
比在拥挤的地方感觉安全多了。
我们流氓...我想可以说
我们天生有点广场恐惧症。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Hey, I don't think
you're supposed to be
here. You better get
going on your way.
It's not a threat, just
a friendly word of advice.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
嘿，我觉得你不应该
在这里。你最好赶紧离开。
这不是威胁，只是
一句善意的建议。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Hey, I don't think
I can help you out.
You're pretty much
on your own from here.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
嘿，我觉得我帮不了你。
从这里开始，你基本上
得靠自己了。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Huh. I hate clean-up
duty. It's always better
to make messes than to
hang around afterwards.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
哈。我讨厌清理工作。
制造混乱总比
事后收拾残局要好。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Yeah, we're investigating
the strange crimes that are
going on around the kingdom.
How'd you know about that?
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
是的，我们正在调查
王国各地发生的
奇怪罪行。
你怎么知道这件事的？

scripts.text: I was just...
scripts.translation: 我只是...

scripts.text: Can I help?
scripts.translation: 我能帮忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Just what...?
Speak up, pal.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
只是什么？
大声点说，伙计。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
So you wanted to help
us out? Heck, we could
use the help, I guess.
I need you to go on a bit
of a trip for me, so get
some provisions ready, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
所以你想帮我们？
好吧，我们确实需要人手。
我需要你去跑一趟，
所以准备好干粮，明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
You all ready and
everything? Good.
Now, I need you to
deliver some intel to
the other Rogues for me.
Think you can do that?
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
都准备好了吗？很好。
现在，我需要你替我
把一些情报交给其他流氓。
你觉得你能做到吗？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
First, I want you to
go to Al De Baran.
Find our guy, and help
him out any way you can.
Us Rogues are hard to
find, but you'll figure it out.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
首先，我要你去艾尔帕兰。
找到我们的人，
尽可能帮他一把。
流氓很难找，
但你会搞定的。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
I know that's probably
not enough instruction,
but that's just the first
step, anyway. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
我知道这指令可能不够详细，
但这只是第一步而已。
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Hey, you gotta get
goin' to Al De Baran,
and find one of us Rogues
working on the investigation.
I thought you wanted to help?
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
嘿，你得赶紧去艾尔帕兰，
找到正在调查的我们流氓之一。
你不是想帮忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Here's a bit of a tip~
Us Rogue agents usually
try to hide out in the
south side of towns.
Bit of a tradition.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
给你个小提示~
我们流氓特工通常
喜欢躲在城镇的南边。
算是个传统吧。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
What's this, a report
from Al De Baran? 'Kay,
let me give it a read...
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
这是什么，来自艾尔帕兰的报告？
好的，让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Huh, okay. Looks like
your next stop is gonna
be in Geffen. Look for our
Geffen agent somewhere in
the South Geffen area, okay?
Ah, and take this note too.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
嗯，好的。看来你的下一站
是吉芬。在吉芬南部区域
找到我们的吉芬特工，好吗？
啊，还有，把这个便条也带上。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received
another folded note.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你收到了
另一张折叠的便条。^000000

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Hey, why haven't you
left for Geffen? Our
agent oughta be in the
south side of town.
It's not far, so don't
throw a hissy fit.
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
嘿，你怎么还没去吉芬？
我们的特工应该在城镇南边。
不远，所以别发脾气。

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Finally, the Z Gang
case is closed. Those
guys really gave us some
trouble. Why the hell did
they stir up so much ruckus
in the kingdom, anyhow?
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
终于，Z帮的案件结束了。
那帮家伙真让我们头疼。
他们到底为什么要在王国
搞出这么大的动静？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Listen, I wanna thank
you for pitching in and
helping out. It's a small
gift, but maybe you'll
like it. If not, don't
lemme know. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
听着，我想感谢你
之前的帮忙。这是个小礼物，
也许你会喜欢。如果不喜欢，
别告诉我。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Listen, I wanna thank
you for pitching in and
helping out. It's a small
gift, but maybe you'll
like it. If not, don't
lemme know. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
听着，我想感谢你
之前的帮忙。这是个小礼物，
也许你会喜欢。如果不喜欢，
别告诉我。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
Hey, you were really
a big help earlier.
Can we count on you
again sometime? The
Rogues can always use
another friend, you know?
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
嘿，你刚才帮了大忙。
以后还能指望你吗？
流氓总是需要朋友的，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Guildsman]
I don't know who you're
lookin' for, but you
got the wrong guy.
Listen, I got work
to do, so...
scripts.translation:
[公会成员]
我不知道你在找谁，
但你找错人了。
听着，我有工作要做，所以...

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Listen, I'm working on
an important assignment
for the Rogue Guild.
Would let lemme alone
so I can do what I gotta?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
听着，我正在执行
流氓公会的重要任务。
请让我一个人待着，
让我做我该做的事。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
They sent you to help me?
Eh, thanks for comin' so
far. I've been collecting
intel here in Al De Baran.
I'm pretty sure the Z Gang's
spreading rumors around here.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
他们派你来帮我？
呃，谢谢你能来。
我一直在艾尔帕兰收集情报。
我相当确定Z帮在这里散布谣言。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
They've been telling
people there's gonna be
a war comin', but... It
seems like a load of huey.
The Z Gang's captured so
the rumor'll just die out...
scripts.translation:
[特工]
他们告诉人们
战争要来了，但...
这似乎是一堆废话。
Z帮被抓了，
所以谣言很快就会平息...

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Do me a favor, and
get this report over
the agent in Geffen?
Thanks, I'd appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
帮我个忙，
把这份报告送到
吉芬的特工那里好吗？
谢谢，我会感激不尽的。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received a
tightly folded note.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你收到了一张
折叠得紧紧的纸条。^000000

scripts.text:
[Agent]
They sent you to help me?
Eh, thanks for comin' so
far. I've been collecting
intel here in Al De Baran.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
他们派你来帮我？
呃，谢谢你能来。
我一直在艾尔帕兰收集情报。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
There's this rumor goin'
around that war's comin'
but... I don't see any real
signs of it. Trains, teleports,
airships, they still keep
on doin' what they do.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
最近有个谣言在流传，
说战争要来了，但...
我没看到任何真正的迹象。
火车、瞬间移动、飞空艇，
它们还在照常运行。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
I'm not sure who, but
someone's probably just
spreading this rumor to
get people to panick.
It's kinda workin', though...
scripts.translation:
[特工]
我不确定是谁，
但肯定有人在散布这个谣言，
想让人们恐慌。
不过...它似乎有点奏效了...

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Do me a favor, and
get this report over
the agent in Geffen?
Thanks, I'd appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
帮我个忙，
把这份报告送到
吉芬的特工那里好吗？
谢谢，我会感激不尽的。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received a
tightly folded note.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你收到了一张
折叠得紧紧的纸条。^000000

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey...
Would you please get
my report over to the
Rogue agent in Geffen?
You'd better hurry since
we gotta work quick.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿...
能请你把我的报告
送到吉芬的流氓特工那里吗？
我们得抓紧工作，
所以你最好快点。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey...
Would you please get
my report over to the
Rogue Guild? They
need to read it A.S.A.P.
You know, pronto.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿...
能请你把我的报告
送到流氓公会吗？
他们需要尽快阅读。
你知道的，越快越好。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
What's this, a report
from the Payon agent?
Um, listen, I don't think
this is for me. You might
wanna try one of the other
Rogue agents around, okay?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
这是什么，
斐扬特工的报告？
嗯，听着，我觉得
这不是给我的。
你可能得试试
周围其他的流氓特工，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey, thanks for
helping out. I sure
hope the kingdom can
enjoy a little peace
with the Z Gang out
of the picture.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，谢谢你的帮助。
我真希望Z帮消失后，
王国能享受一点和平。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Well, we've tracked
down the Z Gang. All we
gotta do now is get them!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
好了，我们已经
追踪到了Z帮。
现在我们要做的就是
抓住他们！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
I still got some
things to do around
here. Them's the breaks.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
我在这儿还有些
事情要做。
这就是现实。

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guild Agent]
Are you the one that's
been helping to take
down the Z Gang? Nice!
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会特工]
你就是那个
一直在帮忙对付Z帮的人吗？
不错！

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guild Agent]
If you got nothing
to do with me, then...
I got nothing to do
with you. Later!
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会特工]
如果你没什么事
要找我，那么...
我也没什么事
要找你。再见！

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guild Agent]
This is from the
Al De Baran agent?
Thanks! It musta been
kinda hard to find me, eh?
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会特工]
这是来自
艾尔帕兰特工的报告？
谢谢！找到我
应该挺费劲的吧？

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guild Agent]
The Z Gang's been
spreading rumors about
ghosts pouring out of
Geffen Tower. Just to be
sure, I want you to check
it out. Will you do that?
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会特工]
Z帮一直在散布谣言，
说幽灵从吉芬中央塔涌出来。
为了保险起见，
我想让你去查一下。
你愿意吗？

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guild Agent]
I want you to capture
some monsters, and get
some proof that shows that
the ghosts stay inside the
tower, and they're not
coming out. Yeah, bring...
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会特工]
我想让你捕捉一些魔物，
并获取一些证据，
证明幽灵留在塔内，
并没有出来。是的，带来...

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guild Agent]
^FF00001 Fabric^000000,
^FF00001 Golden Hair^000000,
^FF00001 Little Evil Horn^000000,
^FF00001 Horseshoe^000000, and
^FF00001 Jack O' Pumpkin^000000.
That oughta do it.

[Rogue Guild Agent]
We just need to get
a little concrete proof
so that the people can
calm down, and not panick.
Hurry it up before a riot
breaks out or somethin'.
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会特工]
我们只需要获得
一点确凿的证据，
让人们冷静下来，
不要恐慌。
在发生暴乱之前
快点搞定。

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guild Agent]
This report is from the
Rogue agent in Al De Baran?
Hey, this says that this is
for the Rogue Guild. You
better take this over there.
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会特工]
这份报告是来自
艾尔帕兰的流氓特工？
嘿，上面写着这是
给流氓公会的。你最好
把它送到那里去。

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guild Agent]
Hey, you done hunting
down the monsters in
Geffen Tower yet?
I hope you brought
the stuff...
scripts.translation:
[流氓公会特工]
嘿，你已经在
吉芬中央塔猎杀魔物了吗？
我希望你带了
那些东西...

scripts.text: Give Items
scripts.translation: 提交物品

scripts.text: I forgot what you need.
scripts.translation: 我忘了你需要什么。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Thanks. This stuff
should help the people
in Geffen calm down a bit.
The Z Gang's been doin'
all these things to make them
believe the monsters are loose.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
谢谢。这些东西应该能让吉芬的居民稍微冷静下来。
Z帮一直在搞这些鬼名堂，
让他们以为魔物跑出来了。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
They've been leavin'
horseprints that look like
they belong to Nightmares,
dressing up in Fabric and
pretending they're Whispers...
They're freakin' hooligans.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
他们留下看起来像梦魇的蹄印，
穿着布料假装成白幽灵...
这群家伙真是胡闹。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
I think the Rogue agent
in Payon should know about
all this. Take this report
over to him, will you?
Thanks a bundle, pal.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
我想斐扬的流氓特工应该知道这一切。
麻烦你把这份报告交给他，好吗？
太感谢了，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hold on, you're
missing some stuff.
You mind checking if
you left some of it
behind somewhere?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
等一下，你少了一些东西。
你介意检查一下是否把
其中一些落在别处了吗？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
^FF00001 Fabric^000000,
^FF00001 Golden Hair^000000,
^FF00001 Little Evil Horn^000000,
^FF00001 Horseshoe^000000, and
^FF00001 Jack O' Pumpkin^000000.
Don't forget this time!

[Agent]
Would you deliver
my report over to
the Rogue agent
in Payon? Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
能把我的报告交给
斐扬的流氓特工吗？谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey, the guild sent
you over to see me?
Oh, hey, you brought
me a message. Let's
take a look-see~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，是公会派你
来找我的吗？
哦，嘿，你给我带了
一条消息。让我们
看看~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Umm...

[Agent]
So... The Z Gang's
responsible for those
rumors about the ghosts
running loose in Geffen.
Huh. Those rascally guys.
Okay, this is what we do.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
所以... Z帮是那些
关于幽灵在吉芬横冲直撞
谣言的罪魁祸首。
哼。那群捣蛋鬼。
好吧，这是我们要做的。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey, while you were
gone, I heard the Z Gang
was finally captured.
Big relief to hear it.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，你不在的时候，
我听说Z帮终于被抓到了。
听到这个真是松了一口气。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
But I still want to
reassure the people in
Geffen that the monsters
in Geffen Tower are safely
locked up inside. You
bring the stuff?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
但我还是想向吉芬的居民保证，
吉芬中央塔的魔物被安全地
锁在里面。你带东西了吗？

^FF00001 Fabric^000000,
