^FF00001 Little Evil Horn^000000,
^FF00001 Horseshoe^000000, and
^FF00001 Jack O' Pumpkin^000000.
Don't forget this time!

[Agent]
Looks like there'll
be some peace and quiet
with the Z Gang all locked up.
Those guys were a double
heaping of trouble if
you ask me. Huh.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
看来Z帮都被关起来后，
会有一段安宁的时光。
在我看来，那群家伙
真是双重麻烦。哼。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Keep up the good work!
With guys like you on
our side, the Z Gang'll
caught sooner than later.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
继续保持！
有你们这样的人
在我们这边，Z帮
迟早会被抓住的。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
So busy!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
好忙啊！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
What? You want somethin'?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
什么？你有事吗？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Heh. Thought so.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
哼。我就知道。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
What's up? I got
my hands full, so
make it quick.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
什么事？我手头正忙，
长话短说。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Nothin', huh?
Guess you should
be talking a Rogue
agent in one of the
other towns.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
没事？
那你应该去找
其他城镇的流氓特工
聊聊才对。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey. What are you
doin', just loitering
around here? You lookin'
for somebody? Huh?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿。你在这儿
闲逛什么呢？
在找什么人吗？嗯？

scripts.text: I'm here to help a Rogue Agent!
scripts.translation: 我来帮流氓特工的忙！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Oh, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
哦，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Heya guy. Always good
to see a fellow Rogue.
You know I'm just messin'
around with you, right?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，伙计。看到流氓
同行总是很高兴。
你知道我刚才只是在
跟你开玩笑，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
I heard o' you guys,
Rogues workin' undercover.
Don't try to fool me: under
those clothes, you are one
hundred percent Rogue. Heh!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
听说你们流氓
都在搞卧底行动。
别想骗我：在那身
衣服底下，你百分之百
是个流氓。哼！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou deliver the
folded note to him.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你把折叠的纸条
递给了他。^000000

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Awwww, man!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
哎呀，真是的！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
I keep telling that
guy to just send me
pictures! I've told him
so many times that I've
got trouble reading!
That guy's a moron!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
我一直跟那家伙说
让他直接发图片！
我跟他说了那么多次，
我阅读有困难！
那家伙是个笨蛋！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Uh...
You mind reading
this note to me?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
呃...
你介意
帮我读一下
这张纸条吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's see,
the note says...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
让我看看，
纸条上写着...

scripts.text: Cooperate with this adventurer.
scripts.translation: 与这名冒险者合作。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
So... We're partners?
Cool. Nice to meetcha.
I'm the Payon agent.
I guess we gotta work
together from now on.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
那么...我们是
搭档了？
酷。很高兴认识你。
我是斐扬的特工。
看来从现在起
我们要一起工作了。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
You...
You can't read either?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
你...
你也不会读？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hahaha! Right on, right on.
Well, I'm pretty sure they
sent you to work with me.
When you're ready to get
to business, come back
and we'll talk, okay?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
哈哈！没错，没错。
我相当确定他们
派你来和我合作。
等你准备好
开始正事时，
回来找我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey, I asked you
to read the note,
not run away! Now...
What's it say?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，我叫你
读纸条，
不是让你跑掉！
现在...
上面写的是什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's see,
the note says...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
让我看看，
纸条上写着...

scripts.text: Cooperate with this adventurer.
scripts.translation: 与这名冒险者合作。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
So... We're partners?
Cool. Nice to meetcha.
I'm the Payon agent.
I guess we gotta work
together from now on.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
那么...我们是
搭档了？
酷。很高兴认识你。
我是斐扬的特工。
看来从现在起
我们要一起工作了。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
You...
You can't read either?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
你...
你也不会读？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hahaha! Right on, right on.
Well, I'm pretty sure they
sent you to work with me.
When you're ready to get
to business, come back
and we'll talk, okay?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
哈哈！没错，没错。
我相当确定他们
派你来和我合作。
等你准备好
开始正事时，
回来找我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Good, you're back.
We got a pretty big
job to take care of.
Lives are at stake,
all that jazz. Ready?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
很好，你回来了。
我们有一件
很大的任务要处理。
事关性命，
诸如此类。准备好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
The Z Gang poisoned
one of the water wells
here in Payon. All the
water's black now. We gotta
use Red Herbs to counter
that poison, okay?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
Z帮在斐扬这里
毒化了一口井。
现在水都变黑了。
我们必须用红色药草
来中和那种毒素，明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
So remember to
collect some ^FF0000Red Herbs^000000.
Don't forget: ^FF0000Red herbs^000000.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
所以记得去收集一些^FF0000红色药草^000000。
别忘了：^FF0000红色药草^000000。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Wait, that doesn't
sound right. Did I say
Red Herbs? I'm sorry,
I meant to say ^0000FFGreen
Herbs^000000. Bring me ^0000FF1 Green
Herb^000000, okay? *Phew~*
scripts.translation:
[特工]
等等，这听起来不对劲。我刚才说的是红色药草吗？抱歉，
我其实想说^0000FF绿色药草^000000。请给我带^0000FF1个绿色药草^000000，好吗？*呼~*

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Someone's poisoned
Payon's well water...
It's all black and
deadly now. I want you
to bring me a ^FF0000Red Herb^000000
so that we can fix this!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
有人毒化了斐扬的井水...
现在水全变黑了，而且很致命。我需要你带给我
一株^FF0000红色药草^000000，这样我们才能解决这个问题！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey, you're back!
You're much quicker
that I thought you'd be~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，你回来了！
你比我预想的要快多了~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Alright, it's gonna take
a while to neutralize all
this poison, but I think
we did it. Hey, gimmie
some time to draw a report,
and then come back later, 'kay?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
好吧，中和所有毒素需要一点时间，
但我认为我们成功了。嘿，给我点时间写份报告，
然后稍后再回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Err?
Where's that
Green Herb?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
呃？
那株绿色药草呢？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey, you're back!
You're much quicker
that I thought you'd be~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，你回来了！
你比我预想的要快多了~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Ah, a Green Herb!
Is that what I told
you to bring? 'Cause
I'm sure this is the
right one. Absolutely~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
啊，是绿色药草！
这就是我叫你带的那个吗？
因为我确信这个是对的。绝对是~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Alright, it's gonna take
a while to neutralize all
this poison, but I think
we did it. Hey, gimmie
some time to draw a report,
and then come back later, 'kay?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
好吧，中和所有毒素需要一点时间，
但我认为我们成功了。嘿，给我点时间写份报告，
然后稍后再回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey, what are you
doin' with the Red Herb?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，你拿着红色药草干什么？

scripts.text: You said a Red Herb...
scripts.translation: 你说的是红色药草...

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Oh, what?! Huh...
I guess I did. Eh, no
biggie. Hey, bring me
a Green Herb, will you?
That's the one I wanted.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
哦，什么？呃...
我想我确实说了。没事，小问题。嘿，给我带个绿色药草，好吗？
那个才是我想要的。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Alright, it's gonna take
a while to neutralize all
this poison, but I think
we did it. Hey, gimmie
some time to draw a report,
and then come back later, 'kay?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
好吧，中和所有毒素需要一点时间，
但我认为我们成功了。嘿，给我点时间写份报告，
然后稍后再回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Err?
Where's that
Green Herb?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
呃？
那株绿色药草呢？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey, you know what?
The well water is still
black. That means...
If the herb we used is
good... Then it's just
dyed black to scare people.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，你知道吗？
井水还是黑的。这意味着...
如果我们用的药草是好的...那么它只是被染黑来吓唬人的。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
So to clean up the
water, we gotta use
a Counteragent, right?
Will you help me out?
I got a Karvodailnirol...
scripts.translation:
[特工]
所以要清理水源，我们必须使用中和剂，对吧？
你能帮个忙吗？我有一瓶卡勒波迪药水...

scripts.text:
[Agent]
So if you bring me
^0000FF1 Alcohol^000000, we should
be totally good to
make a Counteragent.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
所以如果你给我带^0000FF1个酒精^000000，我们应该
就能完全做好中和剂了。

scripts.text: Wait, Karvodailnirol?!
scripts.translation: 等等，卡勒波迪药水？！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Yeah. Karvodailnirol.
What about it?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
是的。卡勒波迪药水。
怎么了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You need Detrimindexta
to make a Counteragent,
not Karvodailnirol.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
制作中和剂需要帝特立米药水，
而不是卡勒波迪药水。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Oh, really? Heh!
You're a lifesaver!
Detrimindexta, huh?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
哦，是吗？嘿！
你真是救星！
帝特立米药水，是吧？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Don't worry, I got
that one too! All you
gotta do is bring Alcohol~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
别担心，那个我也有！你只需要带酒精来就好~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Alright, just bring
me an Alcohol, and
I'll take care of the rest.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
好了，只要给我带个酒精，
剩下的交给我处理。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Everything's ready
except for the Alcohol.
Did you bring it?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
除了酒精，其他都准备好了。
你带了吗？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Great, now all we
have to do is wait.
Nice work, partner.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
太好了，现在只需要等待了。
干得漂亮，搭档。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
You don't have it?
You didn't drink
the alcohol, did you?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
你没带吗？
你该不会把酒精喝了吧？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Everything's ready
except for the Alcohol.
Did you bring it?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
除了酒精，其他都准备好了。
你带了吗？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Great, now all we
have to do is wait.
Nice work, partner.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
太好了，现在只需要等待了。
干得漂亮，搭档。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
You don't have it?
You didn't drink
the alcohol, did you?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
你没带吗？
你该不会把酒精喝了吧？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Um, I made a mistake
making the Counteragent...
I was supposed to use this
Detrimindexta, not the other
thing, Karvodailnirol, to
make the Counteragent.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
呃，我制作中和剂时搞错了...
本来应该用帝特立米药水，
而不是卡勒波迪药水，
来制作中和剂的。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Sorry, they both look
the same to me. And, well,
so do all the letters of
the alphabet. You mind
trying this out again?
Just 1 more Alcohol...
scripts.translation:
[特工]
抱歉，在我眼里它们长得都一样。而且，嗯，
字母表里的所有字母对我来说也都一样。
你介意再试一次吗？
只需要再拿1个酒精来...

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey, I promise!
I won't screw it up
this time. We'll
do this for sure~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，我保证！
这次我绝对不会搞砸的。
我们一定能成功的~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Heh heh! Looks like
we solved the case!
The water wasn't really
poisoned... Just colored
to look suspicious. See?
Completely safe to drink.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿嘿！看来我们破案了！
水其实并没有被毒害...
只是被染色了，看起来可疑而已。看吧？
完全安全，可以饮用。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Anyway, looks like
we're done here. You
mind taking my report over
to the next Rogue agent?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
总之，这里的事情结束了。你
介意把我的报告带给
下一位流氓特工吗？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Make sure to take
this to the guy in
Comodo, okay?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
记得把这个交给
克魔岛的那个人，好吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received a note that
communicates solely
through doodles.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你收到了一张
仅通过涂鸦来传达信息的
便条。^000000

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Make sure to take
this to the guy in
Al De Baran, okay?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
记得把这个交给
艾尔帕兰的那个人，好吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received a note that
communicates solely
through doodles.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你收到了一张
仅通过涂鸦来传达信息的
便条。^000000

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Be sure that the
Rogue agent over
in Al De Baran gets
my report, okay?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
一定要确保艾尔帕兰的
流氓特工收到
我的报告，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Huh, the guy in
Al De Baran wouldn't
take it? Oh! That's why!
I meant Comodo! You gotta
go to Comodo! Heh, my bad~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
咦，艾尔帕兰的那个人
不肯收？哦！我明白了！
我是指克魔岛！你得去克魔岛！嘿嘿，我的错~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Be sure that the
Rogue agent over
in Comodo gets
my report, okay?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
一定要确保克魔岛的
流氓特工收到
我的报告，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey, partner, how's
it going? I'm sorry
if I'm a bit of a hassle
to work with. I might lack
book smarts, but I make
up for it some with my saavy.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，搭档，最近怎么样？
抱歉，我可能有点麻烦。
我可能缺乏书本知识，
但我用我的机智来弥补。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
You've got too many
things on you. Why
don't you put some
of it in Kafra Storage
before talking to me, eh?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
你身上带的东西太多了。为什
么不先把一些放进卡普拉仓库
再跟我说话呢，嗯？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
You're the one
that helped take
down the Z Gang?
Heh! Good work~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
你就是那个帮助
击倒Z帮的家伙？
嘿！干得好~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Who are you? Hm.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
你是谁？嗯。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
You know, Rogues are
tricky and hard to catch,
so I'm gonna teach you to
carry yourself through some
self-discipline. Got it?
Discipline! You need it!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
你知道吗，流氓狡猾且难以捕捉，
所以我要教你通过
自我纪律来行事。明白了吗？
纪律！你需要它！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
From here on out,
I want you to yell
''Yes, sir!'' when you
acknowledge my instructions.
You got that! Loud and clear!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
从现在开始，
我希望你在确认我的指示时
大喊“是，长官！”
你听明白了吗！大声点！

scripts.text: Yes, Sir!
scripts.translation: 是，长官！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Right on, right on.
Hm. Let's try that again...
Let me hear you say it louder!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
很好，很好。
嗯。再试一次...
让我听听，声音再大一点！

scripts.text: Yes, Sir!
scripts.translation: 是，长官！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Nice!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
不错！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Okay, now for your
training instructions...
There's a rumor that a monster
has invaded the village, but
I'm sure it's just someone
trying to scare the public.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
好了，现在说说你的训练任务...
有传言说魔物入侵了村庄，
但我确信这只是有人在
试图吓唬公众。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
I'm pretty sure the, uh,
perp is wearing a mask to
fool people into thinkin'
fhe's monster. This means...
Your mission is to bring
me some monsters masks.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
我相当确定，呃，
罪犯戴着面具，
想让人误以为他是魔物。这意味着...
你的任务是给我
带一些魔物面具。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Heh...
What's your mission?!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿...
你的任务是什么？！

scripts.text: Bring monster masks!
scripts.translation: 带魔物面具！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Groove.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
酷。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Alright, bring me
^FF00002 scary lookin'
monster masks^000000.
Just 2, and make
sure they're scary.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
好的，给我带
^FF00002个看起来很吓人的
魔物面具^000000。
只要2个，
一定要吓人的那种。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
What do you think
you're doin'? I'm
pretty insulted, seeing
as you're all defiant like
this. How do you expect
to become a good Rogue?!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
你以为你在干什么？
我相当受辱，
毕竟你表现得这么叛逆。
你指望怎么成为一名优秀的流氓？！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
So... You bring
the masks like
a good little soldier?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
所以... 你像
一个听话的小士兵那样
把面具带来？

scripts.text: Uh huh.
scripts.translation: 嗯哼。

scripts.text: Yes, Sir!
scripts.translation: 是，长官！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey, remember our
little rule? I even
clued you off when
I said ''soldier!'' Heh~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，记得我们
的小规则吗？我甚至
在我说“士兵！”的时候
就给你提示了。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Okay, let me check.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
好的，让我检查一下。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Excellent!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Look, I know I gave you
a hard time. And don't worry,
I'm not gonna take your masks.
I just wanted to train you
to be the best Rogue that
you can be. Understand?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
听着，我知道我
对你很严厉。别担心，
我不会拿走你的面具。
我只是想训练你
成为最好的流氓。明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Eh? So what's this
note you keep carrying
around in your hand?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
咦？那你一直拿在
手里的这张纸条是什么？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hmmm... Mmmhmmm...
Hmmm... Mmmhmmm...
Hmmm... Mmmhmmm... Oh!

[Agent]
Aw, nuts! Why didn't
you say something?
I thought you were
here to take the Job
change test for Rogues!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
哎呀！你为什么不
早点说？
我还以为你是来
参加流氓转职考试的！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Aw man, you came all this
way to help me out, and
I thought I--I'm really,
really sorry! It's just
that I got you mixed up
with a trainee I'm expecting...
scripts.translation:
[特工]
哎呀，你大老远
跑来帮我，
结果我却--我真的
非常非常抱歉！只是
我把你和我预期的
学员搞混了...

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Do me a favor, and
not tell anyone, yeah?
Consider this... I dunno,
an insider look into the
Rogue world if you would.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
帮个忙，
别告诉任何人，好吗？
你可以把这看作...
算是窥探一下
流氓世界内部的秘密吧。

scripts.text: Yes, sir!
scripts.translation: 是的，长官！

scripts.text: I won't tell anyone.
scripts.translation: 我不会告诉任何人。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Whoa! Whoa!
You can knock
that off now.
Thanks, I really
appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
哇！哇！
你不用这么夸张啦。
谢谢，
我真的非常感激。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Thanks. I knew I could
trust you somehow!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
谢谢。我就知道
可以信任你！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Anyway, you've got one
last place to go, Morocc.
Check in with the Rogue
agent over there, will you?
Oh, and take this food
with my apologies, 'kay?
[Agent]
Wait, something
isn't quite right. You
mind coming back
a little later?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
总之，你还有
最后一个地方要去，莫洛奇。
去那边找流氓特工
报到一下，好吗？
哦，还有，拿着这些食物
算是我的赔罪，好吗？
[特工]
等等，
好像有点不对劲。
你介意稍后再
回来一趟吗？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Anyway, you've got one
last place to go, Morocc.
Check in with the Rogue
agent over there, will you?
Oh, and take this food
with my apologies, 'kay?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
总之，你还有
最后一个地方要去，莫洛奇。
去那边找流氓特工
报到一下，好吗？
哦，还有，拿着这些食物
算是我的赔罪，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey, be safe on your
way to Morocc, alright?
Good luck finding that
Rogue agent over there.
Oh, and mum's the word
on my little mistake~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，去莫洛奇的路上
注意安全，好吗？
祝你在莫洛奇顺利找到
那位流氓特工。
哦，还有，我刚才的小失误
就烂在肚子里吧~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hey, didja even bother
to bring the masks?
Go back and find them!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，你连面具
都没带吗？
回去把它们找回来！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Oh, hey, you're back?
Weren't you already on
your way to Morocc?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
哦，嘿，你回来了？
你不是已经在去
莫洛奇的路上吗？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Heh, looks like we
solved this case~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿，看来我们
破案了~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Thanks to you,
we don't have to
worry about that
crummy ol' Z Gang.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
多亏了你，
我们不用再担心
那个讨厌的Z帮了。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Until the world is
free of evil and all
that, the Rogues'll
always have work to do.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
只要世界上
还有邪恶存在，
流氓们就永远
有做不完的工作。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Why are you still
sticking around?
Don't you have
something more
important to do?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
你为什么还
赖在这里？
难道你没有
更重要的事
要做吗？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
A case? What are you...?
Ask somebody else. I don't
know what you're saying.
Leave me alone, and
just let me relax~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
案件？你在说什么...
去问别人吧。我不知道
你在说什么。
别烦我，
让我歇会儿~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Ahhh, what'd I do
for a nice jug of
frosty beer now~
...What?
scripts.translation:
[特工]
啊，要是现在能来
一大桶冰镇啤酒
就好了~
...什么？

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Oh, yeah, I'm almost
done with my investigation.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
哦，对，我的调查
快结束了。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
The Z Gang has been
causing trouble everywhere.
It's just mischief, but...
If I got my hands on them...
scripts.translation:
[特工]
Z帮到处惹事。
虽然只是恶作剧，但是...
如果让我抓到他们...

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Anyway, that gang is
drawing a lot of flak
to Morocc. I mean, they
kind of live here, so...
scripts.translation:
[特工]
总之，那个帮派
在莫洛奇惹了很多麻烦。
我是说，他们
好像住在这里，所以...

scripts.text:
[Agent]
God, I want a drink.
Listen, would you just
go report to the Rogue
Guild for me? I know it's
my responsibility, but...
It's something for you to do.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
天哪，我想喝酒。
听着，你能替我
去流氓公会报告一下吗？
我知道这是我的责任，但是...
就当是你帮我个忙吧。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Heh! Keep up
the good work~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿！继续
加油~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
I don't know who these
pranksters are, but once
I get my hands on them...
I'm gonna--! I'm gonna--!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
我不知道这些恶作剧的家伙是谁，
但要是让我抓到他们...
我要——！我要——！

scripts.text:
[Agent]
God, I want a drink.
Listen, would you just
go report to the Rogue
Guild for me? I know it's
my responsibility, but...
It's something for you to do.
scripts.translation:
[特工]
天哪，我想喝酒。
听着，你能替我
去流氓公会报告一下吗？
我知道这是我的责任，但是...
就当是你帮我个忙吧。

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Heh! Keep up
the good work~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
嘿！继续
加油~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
Hurry up, and report
for me to the Rogue
Guild. While you do that,
I think I'll enjoy a drink~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
快一点，替我去流氓公会
报告一下。趁你去的时候，
我想先喝点酒~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
*Hiccup*
Ahahaha,
this feels good!
Good ol' beeeer~
scripts.translation:
[特工]
*打嗝*
啊哈哈，
真舒服！
好喝的老啤酒~

scripts.text:
[Agent]
*Hiccup*
scripts.translation:
[特工]
*打嗝*

scripts.text:
[Agent]
What are you?
Get lost!
scripts.translation:
[特工]
你是谁？
滚开！
